jobs.title: Senior Executive Chef / Corporate Chef (Startup Experience Mandatory)
jobs.description:
**Corporate Chef | Senior Executive Chef, F&B Operations**

**Experience:**
8–12+ Years

**Preferred Candidates From:**
ITC, Rebel Foods, EatClub (BOX8), Hyperpure Kitchens, Swish, QSR chains, large restaurant groups, etc.

**Work Mode:**
Full-time, On-site | Bengaluru

**Budget:**
12-18LPA

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced Corporate Chef to lead culinary operations across our growing restaurant business.

The role will be responsible for maintaining food quality and consistency across outlets, managing central kitchen operations, developing and implementing kitchen SOPs, controlling food costs, and building efficient kitchen teams.

We are looking for someone who understands both the culinary and commercial aspects of running a multi-outlet F&B business and can build scalable kitchen operations without compromising on taste or quality.

**What You'll Work On**

- Overseeing culinary operations across central kitchen and restaurant outlets.

- Maintaining consistency in taste, presentation, portion sizes and food quality.

- Developing and implementing standardised recipes, kitchen SOPs and operating processes.

- Managing menu execution, product quality and new product introductions.

- Optimising kitchen workflows, preparation processes and manpower requirements.

- Managing food costs, wastage, yields, inventory and kitchen productivity.

- Training and developing kitchen teams, chefs and outlet kitchen managers.

- Coordinating with procurement and supply chain teams on ingredients, vendors and product quality.

- Conducting regular kitchen audits and identifying operational improvements.

- Ensuring food safety, hygiene and statutory compliance across all kitchen operations.

**What We're Looking For**

- Proven experience as a Corporate Chef, Executive Chef, Head Chef or Culinary Operations Head.

- 8–12+ years of experience in restaurant operations, QSRs, multi-outlet food businesses or central kitchen environments.

- Strong expertise in Indian vegetarian cuisine, particularly North Indian food, gravies, dals, tandoori products, chaap, kebabs and Indian breads.

- Experience managing multiple kitchens, central kitchens or large-scale food production operations.

- Strong understanding of recipe standardisation, food costing, portion control, yield management and inventory management.

- Experience developing kitchen SOPs and implementing processes across multiple outlets.

- Ability to train, manage and build high-performing kitchen teams.

- Strong understanding of food safety, hygiene, quality control and FSSAI requirements.

- Ability to identify operational inefficiencies and improve kitchen productivity without compromising food quality.

- Commercial mindset with a strong understanding of food costs, labour costs, wastage and outlet-level profitability.

- Strong leadership, communication and problem-solving skills.

**How We'll Measure Success**

- Consistency of food quality and taste across all outlets.

- Food cost performance against agreed targets.

- Reduction in food wastage and preparation inefficiencies.

- Improved kitchen productivity and manpower utilisation.

- Successful implementation and adoption of kitchen SOPs.

- Central kitchen and outlet operational efficiency.

- Kitchen team performance, training and retention.

- Reduction in customer complaints related to food quality and consistency.

- Successful execution of menu launches and product improvements.

**Who Should Apply?**

Someone who has successfully managed culinary operations at scale and understands how to build systems around food.

You should be equally comfortable developing a dish, troubleshooting a kitchen operation, analysing food costs, training a team and ensuring that the same dish tastes identical across multiple outlets.

**The goal is simple: Build a kitchen operation that can scale without compromising the food.**

jobs.description:
**Job Description – Plant Head / Factory Head**
**Location:**
Tumkur, Karnataka
  
  
**Experience:**
10+ Years
  
  
**Qualification:**
B.Tech / B.Sc. / M.Tech in Dairy Technology or Dairy Science (Dairy Technologist)
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Plant Head / Factory Head to lead our dairy manufacturing operations at Tumkur. The ideal candidate should have strong technical expertise in dairy processing, production management, quality assurance, operational excellence and team leadership.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for overseeing end-to-end plant operations, ensuring production efficiency, maintaining quality and food safety standards, optimizing costs and driving continuous improvement initiatives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Plant & Production Operations
* Oversee end-to-end dairy plant operations, including milk procurement coordination, processing, production, packaging and dispatch.
* Ensure production plans are executed efficiently to meet business requirements and delivery schedules.
* Monitor plant capacity utilization, production yields, wastage and operational efficiency.
* Ensure smooth functioning of processing equipment, utilities and production lines.
* Quality & Food Safety
* Ensure adherence to FSSAI regulations, food safety standards, hygiene protocols and quality management systems.
* Drive quality control measures across all stages of dairy processing and packaging.
* Work closely with the Quality Assurance team to minimize product deviations, rejections and customer complaints.
* Ensure implementation of HACCP, GMP, GHP and other relevant food safety practices.
* Cost & Process Optimization
* Monitor and control manufacturing costs, material consumption, utilities and operational expenses.
* Identify opportunities to improve production yields, reduce wastage and optimize resource utilization.
* Implement process improvements and operational excellence initiatives.
* Team & People Management
* Lead and manage production, maintenance, engineering and other plant teams.
* Build a performance-driven culture with clear accountability across functions.
* Identify training requirements and develop the technical capabilities of the plant workforce.
* Ensure effective manpower planning and workforce productivity.
* Maintenance & Compliance
* Coordinate preventive and breakdown maintenance activities to ensure maximum equipment uptime.
* Ensure statutory, regulatory and environmental compliance at the plant.
* Maintain operational records, audit documentation and reporting systems.
* Drive workplace safety and ensure adherence to EHS standards.
* Cross-functional Coordination
* Coordinate with Procurement, Supply Chain, Quality, Sales and other business functions.
* Ensure alignment between production plans, raw material availability, inventory and dispatch requirements.
* Present regular plant performance reports covering production, quality, costs and operational KPIs to management.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* Minimum 10+ years of experience in dairy manufacturing / dairy processing operations.
* Degree in Dairy Technology / Dairy Science is mandatory.
* Strong hands-on experience in managing end-to-end dairy plant operations.
* Experience in handling production processes such as milk processing, pasteurization, homogenization, chilling, fermentation and dairy product manufacturing.
* Good understanding of dairy quality standards, food safety regulations and statutory compliance.
* Proven experience in managing large plant teams and cross-functional operations.
* Strong expertise in production planning, cost control, process improvement and plant performance management.
* Candidates with prior experience independently managing a dairy plant or factory will be preferred.

**Key Skills:**
Dairy Processing | Plant Operations | Production Management | Quality Assurance | Food Safety | FSSAI | HACCP | GMP | Cost Optimization | Team Management | Plant Maintenance

jobs.title: Product Development Manager, Rugs and Home Textiles
jobs.description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**
Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.
  
  
What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.
  
  
**OUR CULTURE**
Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.
  
  

* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.
  
  
**Product Development Manager, Rugs and Home Textile**
Quince is a US-based, hyper-growth tech retail start-up experiencing 100%+ YoY growth and serving millions of users each month. Backed by over USD 500 million in funding, we continue to scale rapidly. At Quince, we didn’t just build a $2B+ retail brand—we completely rewrote the playbook on cross-border e-commerce.
  
  
We are seeking a
**Product Development Manager, Rugs and Home Textile**
to join our growing team at Quince. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring products are launched in a timely manner while achieving the highest quality standards.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Own and actively manage day-to-day product development timelines across new products, color and size extensions, vendor transitions, and refreshes, tracking milestones and escalating risks early.
* Serve as the central point of coordination across Merchandising, Sourcing, Fit, Technical Development, Materials, QA, Creative, and Vendors to ensure alignment on development status and dependencies.
* Ensure all required product documentation is accurate, complete, and ready prior to vendor handoff, including technical specifications, build documentation, testing requirements, and fit inputs.
* Coordinate and track all sample requests, shipments, reviews, fit requests, and revisions to drive efficiency and maintain momentum toward target timelines.
* Facilitate timely product reviews and approvals by Merchandising, Fit, and Technical teams; track testing requests and results to ensure quality outcomes are clearly communicated.
* Run in-person country development trips with Global Merchants, Global Fit, and Local PD teams to accelerate decision-making and strengthen vendor execution.
* Partner with Sourcing to support timely staging of materials and finished-goods production; coordinate delivery of photo samples to Creative to ensure marketing and launch readiness.
* Maintain clean, accurate, real-time data across all product development systems and tracking tools to ensure transparency and support fast execution.

**Qualifications required:**

* 10+ years in product development or factory-facing roles
* Deep functional category expertise, including product and material standards
* Extensive experience working directly with factories and sample rooms
* Comfortable operating independently and navigating ambiguity Highly organized, detail-oriented and analytical with focus on execution, problem-solving, improving processes and quality enhancement
* Clear communicator across language, cultural, and functional boundaries
* Proven track record of progressing within an organization and demonstrating continuous growth in roles and responsibilities
* Continuous learner and highly curious; always open to considering new perspectives; proactive when changing course and facing added challenges
* Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills
* Motivated by working in a fast-paced collaborative environment, where flexibility to stretch into or out of functional comfort zones is crucial for team success
* Bachelor’s Degree, preferred

**WHY QUINCE?**
Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.
  
  
**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY**
Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
  
  
Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.
  
  
Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
  
  
*Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds*
At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

jobs.title: Design Head - Electrical & Mechanical Engineering
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION DESIGN HEAD**

  

**1. Position Details**

**Position:** Design Head – Electrical & Mechanical Engineering

**Function:** Engineering / Product Design & Development

**Experience:** 18+ years

**Qualification:** B.E./B.Tech in Electrical / Mechanical / Mechatronics Engineering; M.E./M.Tech preferred

**Level:** Senior Leadership

**Team Responsibility:** Mechanical Design, Electrical Design and Engineering teams

  

**2. Role Purpose**

Lead the overall **electrical and mechanical engineering design function**, ensuring robust, manufacturable, cost-effective and technically compliant designs from concept through industrialization.

The role requires a senior engineering leader with **18+ years of experience**, strong exposure to **both electrical engineering and mechanical design**, and demonstrated expertise in **sheet metal design and manufacturing processes**.

Experience in any specific product line is **not mandatory**. The emphasis is on strong engineering fundamentals, cross-functional design leadership, design governance, manufacturability, quality, cost optimization and team development.

**3. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Engineering & Design Leadership**

* Lead the end-to-end electrical and mechanical design engineering function.
* Establish engineering standards, design methodologies, technical guidelines and design governance processes.
* Drive concept development, detailed engineering, design validation and release of engineering documentation.
* Ensure designs meet requirements relating to **functionality, reliability, safety, manufacturability, serviceability, quality and cost**.
* Conduct and govern technical and design reviews at appropriate project milestones.
* Ensure timely closure of engineering issues during prototype, pilot and production stages.
* Provide technical direction for complex engineering problems and critical design decisions.
* Promote standardization, modular design, reuse of proven solutions and engineering best practices.

**B. Mechanical Design & Sheet Metal Engineering**

* Provide strong technical leadership in mechanical product design.
* **Lead design involving sheet metal components, assemblies, enclosures, cabinets, panels, frames and structural parts.**
* Ensure appropriate engineering consideration for:
* Sheet thickness and material selection
* Bend radius and bend allowance
* Tolerance stack-up
* GD&T
* Fastening and joining methods
* Welding
* Riveting and clinching
* Hardware selection
* Surface finishing and corrosion protection
* Structural strength and rigidity
* Design for assembly and serviceability
* Ensure effective **DFM/DFA (Design for Manufacturing / Design for Assembly)** considering actual manufacturing capability.
* Work closely with production teams on manufacturing processes such as **laser cutting, punching, bending, press brake operations, welding, powder coating and assembly**.
* Drive simplification of parts and assemblies to reduce manufacturing complexity and improve productivity.

**C. Electrical Engineering**

* Provide engineering leadership for electrical design and integration with mechanical systems.
* Review electrical architecture, electrical schematics, component selection and engineering documentation.
* Ensure appropriate selection and application of electrical components based on functional, safety and reliability requirements.
* Guide engineering teams on:
* Power distribution
* Control circuitry
* Electrical panels and cabinets
* Wiring and cable management
* Protection systems
* Earthing and grounding
* Thermal considerations
* Electrical-mechanical interfaces
* Ensure electrical design requirements are effectively translated into mechanical packaging and enclosure requirements.
* Facilitate resolution of electrical-mechanical integration issues during development and industrialization.

**D. Design Validation & Engineering Quality**

* Establish robust **Design Verification and Validation (DVP&R)** processes.
* Drive engineering risk assessment through **DFMEA** and structured design reviews.
* Ensure design issues identified during prototype, testing or production are addressed through systematic root-cause analysis.
* Drive engineering change management through controlled **ECR/ECN** processes.
* Strengthen lessons-learned processes to prevent recurrence of design failures.
* Ensure accurate maintenance of drawings, specifications, BOMs and technical documentation.

**E. Value Engineering & Cost Optimization**

* Lead **Value Engineering / VA-VE** initiatives across electrical and mechanical designs.
* Identify opportunities for:
* Material optimization
* Component standardization
* Part-count reduction
* Alternate material selection
* Design simplification
* Manufacturing process optimization
* Supplier localization
* Partner with Procurement, Manufacturing and Quality teams to identify technically viable cost-reduction opportunities.
* Ensure cost improvements do not compromise product safety, reliability or functional performance.

**F. New Product Development & Industrialization**

* Lead engineering involvement from concept through production release.
* Support prototype development, testing, pilot builds and manufacturing readiness.
* Ensure timely release of:
* 3D models
* 2D manufacturing drawings
* Electrical drawings/schematics
* BOMs
* Technical specifications
* Design validation requirements
* Work closely with Manufacturing Engineering to achieve smooth transition from design to production.
* Review manufacturability risks before production release.

**G. Cross-Functional Leadership**

Work closely with:

* Manufacturing / Production
* Quality
* SCM & Procurement
* Methods / Industrialization
* Maintenance
* Project Management
* Sales / Application Engineering
* Suppliers and technology partners

Drive structured resolution of engineering issues with clear accountability and timelines.

**H. Team Leadership & Capability Building**

* Lead, mentor and develop multidisciplinary teams across mechanical and electrical engineering.
* Build technical depth and succession capability within the design organization.
* Define engineering competency and skill matrices.
* Identify capability gaps and implement appropriate technical development plans.
* Develop technical leads and future engineering managers.
* Establish a strong culture of **design ownership, technical rigor, innovation and continuous improvement**.
* Review team capacity against current and future project requirements.

**4. Essential Candidate Profile**

The candidate **must have**:

* **18+ years of overall engineering/design experience.**
* Engineering degree in **Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics or a closely related engineering discipline**.
* Strong practical exposure to **both electrical engineering and mechanical design**.
* **Strong sheet metal design experience. This is an essential selection criterion.**
* Experience leading engineering/design teams.
* Experience managing design from concept through manufacturing release.
* Strong understanding of **DFM, DFA, DFMEA, GD&T, tolerance analysis, BOM management and engineering change control**.
* Experience working closely with manufacturing, quality and supply-chain functions.
* Strong understanding of cost optimization and value engineering.
* Ability to conduct and challenge technical design reviews across multiple engineering disciplines.

**Specific product-line experience is not mandatory.** Candidates from different industrial/product backgrounds can be considered provided they demonstrate strong electrical-mechanical design capability and substantial sheet metal engineering experience.

**5. Preferred Technical Competencies**

* 3D mechanical design and CAD
* Sheet metal modelling
* Electrical design/schematic understanding
* GD&T
* Tolerance stack-up analysis
* DFMEA
* DFM/DFA
* DVP&R
* VA/VE
* ECR/ECN
* BOM management
* Material selection
* Manufacturing process knowledge
* Root Cause Analysis / 8D
*

jobs.title: Risk Modelling Validation & Insights Specialist
jobs.company: Australia and New Zealand Banking Group (ANZ)
jobs.description:
### Job Summary

As a Manager, Modelling Insights is responsible for leading model monitoring and portfolio performance assessment across ANZs credit risk model inventory. The role combines deep analytical expertise, portfolio risk knowledge, and strong stakeholder engagement to deliver actionable insights on model performance, emerging risks, and portfolio behaviour.

The successful candidate will leverage advanced analytics, data visualisation, and statistical techniques to assess model effectiveness, identify performance deterioration, evaluate key risk drivers, and support compliance with internal model risk management standards and regulatory expectations.

Banking is changing and we re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

**Role Type: Permanent  
Role Location: Bengaluru  
Work Hours: Morning Shift**

### What will your day look like

As a Risk Modelling Validation & Insights Specialist, you are expected to undertake the following activities that are deemed core to the role:

* Lead model monitoring and performance analysis across credit risk models, including Decision, Basel Capital, IF/Provisioning, and other risk models
* Drive deep-dive investigations into model outcomes, portfolio performance, segmentation strategies, business growth initiatives, and risk appetite changes
* Develop and enhance interactive dashboards, monitoring frameworks, and management reporting to provide timely risk and performance insights
* Identify opportunities to improve monitoring methodologies, data quality, automation, and analytics capabilities through innovative use of data science and AI/ML techniques
* Provide leadership, coaching, and technical guidance to team members, fostering a high-performing and continuously improving analytical team
* Partner with model developers, validators, portfolio managers, risk teams, and senior stakeholders to ensure effective governance and risk insight generation

### What will you bring

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:

* Strong experience in model monitoring, model validation, credit risk analytics, or model risk management within financial services
* Demonstrated knowledge of Decision Models, Basel Capital Models, IF/Provisioning Models, and associated regulatory expectations
* Proficiency in Python, SAS, R, SQL, and large-scale data analysis
* Solid understanding of Machine Learning (ML) techniques and emerging Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications in risk management, with practical experience preferred
* Strong understanding of credit risk portfolios and banking products, including mortgages, personal lending, credit cards, unsecured lending, SME, commercial, and institutional products
* Experience assessing model performance metrics, stability measures, calibration, discrimination, segmentation, and monitoring frameworks
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex analytical findings into business insights and recommendations
* Proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop teams within a collaborative and diverse environment

You re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we d love to hear from you.

The role will focus on improving operational effectiveness, redesigning workflows and operating models, leveraging data and analytics, and supporting technology-enabled transformation across payer functions.

Candidates may specialize in one or more of the following capability areas:

* Healthcare Back Office Transformation
* Healthcare Middle Office Transformation
* Payer Analytics & Data Strategy

* Support strategic, operational, and technology-led transformation initiatives across healthcare payer organizations.
* Assess existing processes and develop **process maps, workflow assessments, operating models, and improvement recommendations**.
* Conduct benchmarking, workforce assessments, research, and cost-benefit analyses to identify improvement opportunities.
* Support transformation across payer functions such as **claims, enrollment, eligibility, billing, provider data, care management, utilization management, pharmacy/PBM, network management, payment integrity, and risk adjustment**.
* Analyze large and complex healthcare datasets to identify trends, operational issues, and actionable business insights.
* Support technology-enabled operating model transformation, including workflow redesign, system implementation, platform optimization, and process automation.
* Contribute to analytics initiatives addressing **risk adjustment, quality, utilization, care management, pharmacy performance, and payment integrity**.
* Support data governance and effective communication of analytical insights to business and operational stakeholders.
* Use **GenAI** to support research, insight development, and storyboarding where appropriate.
* Evaluate opportunities to leverage automation, AI/ML, NLP, interoperability, and data exchange to improve payer processes.

* Understanding of healthcare payer operations and core functions.

* Familiarity with process mapping, workflow assessment, operating models, project management, or benchmarking.

* Familiarity with healthcare interoperability, data exchange, provider data platforms, and automation concepts.

**Preferred**

* Automation tools
* AI/ML and NLP concepts

**Core Competencies**

* Strong analytical mindset
* Problem solving
* Stakeholder communication

* Data-driven decision making
* Innovation and continuous improvement

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate combines **healthcare payer domain knowledge with strong analytical and transformation capabilities**. Candidates with deeper specialization in **payer operations, Medicare/Medicaid, PBM, risk adjustment, care/utilization management, healthcare analytics, data strategy, or payer technology transformation** would be particularly relevant depending on the specific capability area.

jobs.title: Electrical Maintenance Executive - Retail Store
jobs.description:
We are Licious and we are a Bengaluru based meat and seafood company founded in 2015by Abhay Hanjura and Vivek Gupta, our founders, foodies and friends. We pride ourselves on being Indias most successful D2Cfood-tech brand operating in 20 cities across the country delighting over 32 lac customers with our de-*licious*fresh meat and seafood!

Think you have what it takes to be the **magic ingredient** in the recipe that is Licious? Read on

  

**What makes the role meaty?**

To ensure smooth and uninterrupted maintenance operations across Licious offline retail stores by managing preventive and breakdown maintenance, vendor coordination, infrastructure upkeep, equipment reliability and statutory safety compliance.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Store Maintenance & Operations**

* Manage day-to-day maintenance activities across 8–10 offline retail stores.
* Ensure the availability and proper functioning of refrigeration equipment, display chillers, deep freezers, HVAC, exhaust systems, electrical panels, UPS, RO systems and other store utilities.
* Handle breakdowns and ensure timely resolution to minimise business disruption.
* Conduct regular store visits and maintenance audits to identify and resolve infrastructure issues.

**B. Preventive & Breakdown Maintenance**

* Develop and execute preventive maintenance schedules for all store equipment.
* Monitor equipment performance and maintain service history.
* Ensure timely closure of maintenance complaints within defined TAT and SLA.
* Identify recurring equipment failures and implement permanent corrective actions.

**C. Vendor & AMC Management**

* Coordinate with service providers and contractors for maintenance activities.
* Manage AMC, repair quotations, vendor performance and service quality.
* Ensure cost-effective maintenance without compromising equipment reliability.
* Verify vendor bills and validate completed maintenance work before processing payments.

**D. Safety & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with electrical safety, fire safety and other statutory requirements.
* Conduct regular safety inspections and maintain audit documentation.
* Ensure proper upkeep of electrical installations, fire extinguishers, emergency lighting and safety equipment.

**E. Cost & Performance Management**

* Monitor store-wise maintenance expenditure and control R&M costs.
* Identify opportunities for energy savings and equipment optimisation.
* Maintain maintenance MIS, breakdown reports, PM compliance and expenditure tracking.
* Drive continuous improvement through 5S, Kaizen and root cause analysis.

  
  

**We hope that you have..**

  

* Diploma / Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.
* 5–8 years of experience in maintenance and facilities management.
* Experience in retail stores, supermarkets, QSR or food industry preferred.
* Good knowledge of refrigeration, display chillers, deep freezers, HVAC and electrical systems.
* Strong vendor management, troubleshooting and coordination skills.
* Knowledge of CMMS, preventive maintenance and maintenance MIS.
* Good communication and reporting skills.
* Must be willing to travel extensively within the city to manage multiple outlets.
* Preventive maintenance compliance: 95% or above.
* Maintenance complaint closure within defined TAT: 90% or above.
* Equipment uptime and business continuity.
* Reduction in recurring breakdowns.
* Maintenance expenditure within approved budget.
* Vendor SLA and AMC compliance.
* Timely completion of store maintenance audits.
* Improvement in energy efficiency and maintenance cost savings.

jobs.title: Manager - Product Management
jobs.location: Bengaluru, Hubballi, Mangaluru, Mysuru, Belagavi, India
jobs.description:
Job Purpose

To drive sustainable and profitable growth of the assigned product portfolio through market-led portfolio strategy, customer

insight, product development, lifecycle management, pricing, go-to-market execution, and cross-functional collaboration.

The role is responsible for identifying market opportunities and portfolio gaps, developing differentiated customer value

propositions, building product roadmaps, managing new product development and launches, improving portfolio

profitability, and ensuring products remain competitive and relevant throughout their lifecycle.

Collaborate with Sales, R&D, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, Marketing, Procurement, Legal, Service, and

other relevant stakeholders to translate customer and business requirements into commercially successful products and

solutions.

  

3. Key Business Dimensions

- Revenue, volume, growth, market share, and profitability of the assigned portfolio.

- Number of categories, subcategories, products, variants, and SKUs managed.

- New Product Development pipeline, annual launch plan, cycle time, and launch performance.

- Revenue and margin contribution from new, strategic, differentiated, or premium products.

- Pricing, realisation, product mix, cost optimisation, and value-engineering impact.

- Geographic, channel, customer, distributor, dealer, retailer, and influencer coverage, as applicable.

- Product availability, inventory health, service levels, quality, complaints, and customer adoption.

- Product development, research, communication, training, and market-development budgets.

- Portfolio rationalisation, SKU productivity, and product master-data accuracy.

  

4. Key Result Areas and Accountabilities

A. Product and Portfolio Strategy

- Develop and execute the strategic plan for the assigned portfolio in alignment with business objectives.

- Define the role of each category, product family, product, and SKU within the portfolio.

- Identify growth opportunities across segments, applications, channels, price points, and geographies.

- Develop short- and long-term product roadmaps based on market potential, customer needs, technology trends, and business

priorities.

- Conduct portfolio gap analysis and recommend new products, variants, specifications, pack sizes, solutions, or services.

- Prioritise initiatives based on market attractiveness, competitive strength, profitability, strategic fit, and organisational

capability.

- Drive portfolio mix improvement and support annual operating, category, and long-range plans.

  

B. Market, Industry and Competitive Intelligence

- Monitor macroeconomic, regulatory, technology, customer, channel, and industry trends affecting the portfolio.

- Track market size, growth, segmentation, applications, price bands, channel dynamics, and competitive intensity.

- Build structured market-intelligence mechanisms through field inputs, research, channel partners, customers, exhibitions, and

secondary sources.

- Benchmark competitor range, specifications, features, quality, pricing, positioning, distribution, communication, service, and

launches.

- Convert market and competitive intelligence into implications for portfolio, pricing, development, and go-to-market decisions.

- Maintain competitive comparison tools and identify emerging categories, substitutes, adjacent opportunities, and disruptive

technologies.

  

C. Customer and Consumer Insights

- Develop a deep understanding of customer, consumer, channel, influencer, installer, applicator, and end-user needs, as

applicable.

- Create customer personas and segment customers by needs, applications, behaviour, value expectations, and purchase

drivers.

- Map customer journeys, pain points, barriers, expectations, interaction points, and moments of truth.

- Gather Voice of Customer through visits, interviews, focus groups, surveys, complaint analysis, feedback, and usage

observation.

- Plan qualitative and quantitative research and translate insights into requirements, propositions, experience improvements,

and communication priorities.

- Validate concepts, prototypes, features, packaging, pricing, and communication before commercial launch.

  

D. Product Roadmap and New Product Development

- Develop and maintain a prioritised product roadmap aligned with customer needs, market opportunities, strategy, and

technical feasibility.

- Define product concepts, applications, target segments, technical requirements, expected benefits, target price, volume

potential, and commercial expectations.

- Create product briefs and Product Requirement Documents with relevant stakeholders.

- Lead cross-functional development projects from concept through commercialisation using a defined stage-gate process.

- Track milestones, risks, dependencies, costs, trials, validations, certifications, and launch readiness.

- Facilitate prototype evaluation, technical validation, customer trials, pilots, and market testing.

- Conduct post-launch reviews and maintain a balanced innovation pipeline.

  

E. Product Lifecycle and SKU Management

- Manage products across introduction, growth, maturity, and decline stages.

- Define lifecycle-specific pricing, positioning, distribution, communication, promotion, and investment strategies.

- Review product and SKU performance using revenue, volume, growth, margin, availability, inventory, and strategic relevance.

- Identify slow-moving, obsolete, duplicate, low-margin, or low-potential SKUs and lead rationalisation, replacement, migration,

or phase-out plans.

- Ensure smooth transition from legacy products and maintain accurate portfolio, lifecycle, and product-master information.

- Recommend upgrades, extensions, repositioning, cost optimisation, or withdrawal based on performance.

  

F. Business Case and Commercial Viability

- Prepare business cases for new products, upgrades, localisation, capacity, portfolio extensions, and strategic investments.

- Estimate addressable opportunity, volume, revenue, price, margin, investment, payback, and key assumptions.

- Evaluate scenario sensitivity to price, volume, cost, investment, and market adoption.

- Assess technical feasibility, operational readiness, supply-chain implications, and commercial risks.

- Conduct post-launch reviews against approved assumptions and recommend acceleration, correction, continuation, or

closure.

  

G. Pricing and Profitability Management

- Develop pricing recommendations based on customer value, competitive benchmarks, cost, positioning, willingness to pay,

and business objectives.

- Track market prices, competitor movements, discounts, schemes, channel margins, and price architecture.

- Evaluate premium, penetration, competitive, cost-plus, value-based, bundle, and promotional pricing approaches.

- Assess price-change impact on volume, revenue, margin, mix, and competitiveness and conduct price-volume-mix analysis.

- Identify opportunities for price correction, premiumisation, cost reduction, and margin improvement.

- Coordinate approved price changes and maintain product pricing and profitability dashboards.

  

H. Value Engineering and Cost Optimisation

- Build a pipeline of value-engineering and cost-optimisation opportunities without compromising customer value, quality,

safety, or performance.

- Evaluate alternative materials, specifications, processes, designs, vendors, and packaging with cross-functional teams.

- Prioritise opportunities based on savings, complexity, customer impact, and technical risk.

- Ensure robust testing, validation, approvals, and change management and track realised savings.

  

I. Customer Value Proposition and Positioning

- Develop differentiated value propositions defining the target customer, problem, benefits, reasons to believe, and

differentiation from alternatives.

- Quantify customer value through performance, productivity, convenience, durability, safety, savings,

jobs.title: Regional Food Safety Microbiologist
jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**

As a leading provider of high-quality food and beverage ingredients, we work with farming communities across the globe to grow, source and produce ingredients that are good for consumers, farmers, and the world around us. We supply household food brands and manufacturers worldwide with cocoa, coffee, dairy, nuts and spices ingredients which are often grown on our own farms and estates and sourced from hundreds of thousands of farmers across ~50 countries. Along with our diverse manufacturing and innovation capabilities, this means we can provide ingredients for a range of products, from a plant-based latte mix to an almond-based snack bar or a dairy-free ice cream. Making a positive impact on people and planet is a core component of our Purpose, to be the change for good food and a healthy future. With a deep-rooted presence in the countries where our ingredients are grown, we are closer to farmers, enabling better quality, and more reliable, traceable, and transparent supply. And whoever we’re with, whatever we’re doing, we always make it real.

**JOB IN SUMMARY**

The Regional Food Safety Microbiologist for Asia Pacific will provide advanced scientific leadership and technical expertise in food microbiology, microbiological risk management, environmental monitoring, validation science and food safety systems.

The role will support the implementation of global food safety strategies and initiatives across Asia Pacific while ensuring effective deployment of microbiological control programs, environmental monitoring systems, validation programs and risk management practices. The position will support ofi's Zero Incident Mindset through the application of sound science, robust risk assessments and continuous improvement of food safety controls.

As part of the Global Food Safety COE, the role will work closely with regional Quality & Food Safety teams, site leadership, Operations, Engineering and global food safety experts to drive harmonization, capability building and consistent application of food safety standards across all product platforms.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Global Food Safety COE Deployment**

* Act as the Asia Pacific representative of the Global Food Safety COE.
* Support implementation of global food safety strategies, standards and initiatives across all Asia Pacific sites.
* Drive alignment and harmonization of microbiological risk management programs across regions.
* Support continuous improvement of global food safety standards and governance processes.
* Participate in global communities of practice and technical working groups.

**Microbiological Risk Management**

* Serve as the regional subject matter expert for food microbiology and microbiological risk management.
* Lead microbiological risk assessments for products, ingredients, processes and manufacturing environments.
* Identify current and emerging microbiological risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Support the development of preventive food safety controls using scientific and risk-based approaches.
* Provide technical leadership during significant food safety incidents and investigations.

**Environmental Monitoring Programs**

* Lead deployment and continuous improvement of environmental monitoring programs across Asia Pacific.
* Establish risk-based pathogen and indicator organism monitoring strategies.
* Support sites in trend analysis, program optimization and investigation of environmental positives.
* Drive standardization of environmental monitoring methodologies across the region.
* Provide technical guidance for environmental monitoring program design and governance.

**Thermal Process Validation Program**

* Own and lead the validation program for thermal kill steps across all relevant manufacturing sites within Asia Pacific.
* Develop validation standards, protocols and scientific methodologies aligned with global requirements.
* Review and approve thermal process validation studies and challenge testing activities.
* Partner with Operations and Engineering teams to ensure validated processes are maintained and controlled.
* Support revalidation following process, product or equipment changes.
* Drive consistency of thermal process validation approaches across product platforms and regions.
* Maintain oversight of thermal validation effectiveness and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

**Validation & Verification**

* Provide technical leadership for food safety validation and verification programs.
* Support validation of preventive controls, sanitation programs and microbiological interventions.
* Review validation protocols and ensure scientific rigor in study design and interpretation.
* Support implementation of risk-based verification activities across manufacturing sites.
* Ensure effective documentation and governance of validation programs.

**Incident Management & Root Cause Analysis**

* Lead microbiological investigations associated with food safety incidents, environmental positives and customer complaints.
* Support root cause investigations and development of corrective and preventive actions.
* Review regional microbiological trends and identify recurring issues requiring systematic improvement.
* Provide guidance during product disposition decisions and crisis management activities.

**Capability Building & Training**

* Develop and deliver advanced food microbiology and food safety training programs.
* Build microbiological capability across regional and site Quality & Food Safety teams.
* Coach and mentor food safety professionals across the region.
* Support development of technical competency frameworks for food safety and microbiology disciplines.
* Drive knowledge sharing through communities of practice and technical forums.
* Conduct Good Laboratory Practice internal audits for Micro Labs in the region
* Review new test methods and support implementation at all Micro Labs.
* Introduce rapid validated methods to improve TAT for microbiology tests at internal labs.
* Guide & Coordinate the Proficiency test program for all Micro Labs in the region.

**Regulatory, Customer & Audit Support**

* Participate in customer specifications review, understand requirements for RTE products, and provide guidance to sites on implementation.
* Be an active member of the Global Food Safety COE
* Monitor emerging scientific developments and evolving regulatory requirements.

**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATION**

* PhD in Microbiology is required.
* Additional qualifications in Food Science, Food Technology, Biotechnology or related disciplines are advantageous.
* Minimum 15 years of experience in food microbiology, food safety or food manufacturing environments.
* Advanced expertise in foodborne pathogens, environmental microbiology, thermal processing and microbiological risk assessment.
* Demonstrated experience leading validation programs for thermal kill steps and preventive controls.
* Strong knowledge of environmental monitoring programs and pathogen control strategies.
* Extensive understanding of FSSC 22000, BRCGS, GFSI requirements and regulatory food safety expectations.
* Experience supporting multi-site and multi-country manufacturing operations.
* Strong analytical, scientific and statistical interpretation skills.
* Excellent root cause analysis and problem-solving capability.
* Strong project leadership and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to influence across multiple levels of the organization without direct authority.

At ADM India Hub, we are hiring for IT and finance roles across diverse technology and business functions. We stand at the intersection of global expertise and local excellence, enabling us to drive innovation and support our larger purpose of unlocking the power of nature to enrich quality of life.

**Job Title:**
Statutory Accountant

**Type/ Location:**
Full time,
Bangalore, India

**About ADM**
:

At ADM, we unlock the power of nature to provide access to nutrition worldwide. With industry-advancing innovations, a complete portfolio of ingredients and solutions to meet any taste, and a commitment to sustainability, we give customers an edge in solving the nutritional challenges of today and tomorrow. We’re a global leader in human and animal nutrition and the world’s premier agricultural origination and processing company. Our breadth, depth, insights, facilities and logistical expertise give us unparalleled capabilities to meet needs for food, beverages, health and wellness, and more. From the seed of the idea to the outcome of the solution, we enrich the quality of life the world over.

**The Role:**

The Statutory Reporting team is responsible for the preparation and audit of financial statements of over 150 of ADM subsidiaries, worldwide.

Statutory Reporting is part of the Corporate Finance department of ADM and is responsible for the completeness and correctness of ADM’s accounting and external financial reporting under Local GAAP and/or International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS).

In this position, you will not only prepare financial statements, but also leverage your expertise in IFRS, local GAAPs, and technical accounting to manage financial reporting for multiple entities. You will also engage in cross-functional projects, contribute to automation initiatives, and gain exposure to high-impact areas.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Prepare Financial Statements:**
  Support the preparation of financial statements under IFRS and other GAAPs of ADM subsidiaries, ensuring accurate identification and adjustment of differences between USGAAP and IFRS/local GAAPs.
* **Local Regulatory Compliance:**
  To Support tax, company secretary and other regulatory compliance activities.
* **Collaboration:**
  Work closely with external and internal stakeholders including Tax, Treasury, and Controlling, providing exposure to diverse areas of financial management.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  Support the automation and standardization of financial statement preparation, in accordance with ADM's strategy to streamline processes, improve efficiency and ensure accuracy and compliance.
* **Tackle Complexity:**
  Dive into complex topics like hyperinflation accounting, business combinations under common control and consolidation, providing expertise and solutions.
* **Technical Analysis:**
  Assisting with research and prepare technical memorandums to address scenarios to support the rationale and accounting treatment for relevant topics.

**Role Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in related field such as Finance, Accounting or Auditing is preferred
* Qualified/Semi-qualified accountant (CA, CPA, ACCA) with at least 3 to 5 years of experience in preparing and/ or auditing financial statements.
* Big 4 company experience is a plus
* Deep professional experience including application of IFRS accounting - any other GAAP is a plus.
* Able to articulate financial positions with excellent communication skills.
* Assertive and able to work both independently and within a global team.
* Fluent in spoken and written English is a must (other languages being a plus).
* Excellent in MS Excel, knowledge of accounting-related functionalities in an ERP System preferred.

**Why this role matters**
Finagra is building agri supply chains across India that farmers, partners and investors can trust. Every rupee that moves through our network, from REP funding to vendor and labour payments, needs to be accounted for, compliant and visible in real time.
  
  
We're looking for our first Chief Accountant in India: a hands-on Chartered Accountant who wants to build the function, not just run it. You'll be the person our foreign parent, CFO and auditors rely on, and the person who makes sure growth never outpaces control.
  
  
**The role**
You will own Finagra India's entire finance and compliance function, from the first journal entry to board-ready reporting. You'll set up the controls, systems and team that let us scale across states with confidence.
  
  

* Reports to: CFO, with regular reporting to the foreign parent
* Location: Bengaluru, India
* Team: Accounts team plus external tax, audit and legal consultants

**What You'll Do**
Own the numbers
  
  

* Run the full accounting cycle under Indian GAAP: bookkeeping, GL review, bank reconciliations, accruals and a disciplined month-end close
* Deliver monthly MIS with budget-vs-actual variance analysis that tells leadership what changed and why
* Build a weekly dashboard covering cash position, REP funding and expenses, procurement and project status
* Lead reporting and intercompany reconciliation with our foreign parent
* Manage payroll through Deel

Keep us fully compliant
  
  

* GST: GSTR-1/3B review, GSTR-2B vs purchase register ITC reconciliation, e-invoicing, e-way bills, RCM, GSTR-9 and 9C
* Direct tax: TDS/TCS, quarterly returns, advance tax, Professional Tax and Karnataka state compliances
* FEMA/RBI: FDI inflows, FC-GPR, FLA return, ECB and repatriation of funds
* Transfer pricing: Form 3CEB and intercompany agreements
* Agri licences: track the licences and registrations we need in every state we operate in
* Coordinate statutory, tax and internal audits, with audit-ready documentation all year round

Build systems and controls that scale
  
  

* Run Tally as the books of record: multi-currency, inventory valuation, GST/TDS configuration and audit trail
* Partner with IT on the ERPNext procure-to-pay cycle and its reconciliation with Tally
* Design SOPs, maker-checker approvals and red-flag controls over cash and procurement
* Manage bank and REP account reconciliations and activity funding
* Evaluate and roll out payment software for vendor, labour and REP payments

Lead and grow the team
  
  

* Build, coach and manage the accounts team as Finagra grows
* Manage external consultants and hold them to clear standards

**What You Bring**
**Must-haves**

* Chartered Accountant (CA)
* 10+ years in accounting and compliance, including 5+ years leading a team
* Strong hands-on Tally skills and deep Indian tax and FEMA knowledge
* Fluent English, and confident reporting to a foreign parent and CFO
* A proactive, process-first mindset: you fix the root cause, not just the symptom

**Nice-to-haves**

* CPA or ACCA alongside strong Indian experience
* Background in agri, commodity trading or supply chain

**Why join Finagra**

* Build from the ground up: shape the finance function, its controls and its team, your way
* Real impact: your work keeps money flowing to the farmers, partners and REPs our model depends on
* Global exposure: work closely with an international parent and CFO on cross-border finance
* Variety: GST, FEMA, transfer pricing, systems and team leadership, all in one role

**How To Apply**
Send your CV and a short note on a finance process you built or fixed to [email address]. Tell us what changed because of it.

jobs.title: Food Quality Analyst — Long-Term Urban Ecological Observatory (LTUEO)
jobs.description:
**About the School of Environment and Sustainability (SES)**

The IIHS Long-Term Urban Ecological Observatory (LTUEO) at the Kengeri campus is an important part of the SES and integrates state of the art observation and measurement systems for biodiversity, air, water and soil, food and ecosystem services to serve the needs of sustainable management of the campus and function as a research and educational resource for the larger community.

The Food Safety Testing Lab is a part of the LTUEO and Sustainable Urban Agriculture initiative at the IIHS Kengeri campus, within the SES.

**Job Description**

IIHS seeks a meticulous and technically skilled food quality analyst/ technician to support the Food Safety Testing Lab in understanding and communicating the changing chemical and microbiological variables of food (both cooked and uncooked) on campus and in the neighboring lake, forest, and urban ecosystems.

The role will be responsible for conducting qualitative and quantitative tests to determine the physical and chemical properties of food, recording and compiling the test results, preparing charts and reports, as well as preparing and incubating plates with cultures. It will also involve defining quality assurance targets and procedures and ensuring their maintenance and continued improvement by reviewing targets, protocols, supplies, processes, equipment, and technologies for quality standards.

The candidate will be expected to spend substantial time at the IIHS Kengeri Campus and provide support as needed, on other IIHS projects under the SES.

This is a contractual engagement for an initial term of 11 months, renewable on mutual

consent and based on performance, and with the potential to turn into a regular position over time.

**Activities and Tasks**

Responsibilities would include, but not be limited to, the following:

* Collecting, processing and analysing food, vegetable, drink and dairy samples at regular intervals as a part of the campus environmental monitoring system;
* Assisting in setting up and maintaining a food quality lab, maintaining and calibrating equipment, and preparing SOPs and related documents;
* Preparing and maintaining hard-copy and computer-based data sets on all chemical and microbiological food quality environmental variables;
* Helping prepare regular updates on the food safety lab’s activities for the IIHS newsletter and other IIHS communication outputs;
* Contributing to knowledge-sharing events, publications and presentations featuring the food safety lab’s activities, observations and findings at appropriate internal and external forums as needed;
* Participating in relevant teaching and training activities; contributing to curriculum design and the development of teaching materials, including case studies, as relevant;
* Providing support to other IIHS activities including academics, research, training, practice, operations and others;
* Participating in all activities of Institution-Building at IIHS; carrying out tasks as assigned by IIHS; and traveling on IIHS work within or outside the country as and when needed.

**Structure and Reporting**

The food quality analyst will be an External Consultant coordinating with the Lead – Research, SES at IIHS, be part of the larger SES team and will be required to collaborate effectively with the Campus Development team a diverse group of internal teams and external individuals/ organisations, and students.

**Person Specification**

The candidate should have:

* A Master’s degree of Science/ Technology in Food Technology, Food Science and technology, Food Science and Nutrition, Food Safety and Quality Assurance, Food Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry/ Food Microbiology, Microbiology, or Chemistry;
* 3-4 years of experience in chemical, physical, microbiological, and sensory assessment of food, vegetables and drinks.

This is a contractual engagement for an initial term of 11 months, renewable on mutual consent, and with the potential to turn into a regular position over time. This offer is on an exclusive basis, which implies that other professional assignments (whether compensated or not) that bear a potential conflict of interest with IIHS cannot be undertaken.

The search will remain open until the position is filled.

**Location**

This position is based in the Kengeri Campus, Bengaluru and may entail travel to other locations in India.

**Review and Assessment**

The role and performance of the incumbent shall be subject to normal review and assessment systems at IIHS.

**Diversity Policy**

IIHS is an equal opportunity employer that encourages women, people with disabilities and those from economically and socially excluded communities with the requisite skills and qualifications to apply for positions.

**Contact**

Please write to us at careers@iihs.co.in if you need any clarifications while filling the online application form.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager
jobs.description:
**Role & responsibilities**

**A. Production Machinery Maintenance**

* Ensure proper maintenance of all production machinery used in instant mix and masala manufacturing.
* Handle maintenance of pulverizers, spice grinders, ribbon blenders, mixers and batch mixers.
* Maintain vibro sifters, screw conveyors, bucket elevators and material handling systems.
* Troubleshoot, electrical, pneumatic and hydraulic problems.
* Ensure minimum machine downtime and maximum production efficiency.

**B. Preventive & Breakdown Maintenance**

* Prepare and implement preventive maintenance schedules.
* Monitor daily machine performance and identify potential failures.
* Attend emergency breakdowns and ensure quick restoration of equipment.
* Maintain equipment history, breakdown reports and maintenance records.
* Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring breakdowns.
* Implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

**C. Utility Maintenance**

* Maintain air compressors and pneumatic systems.
* Monitor electrical panels, motors, pumps and distribution systems.
* Maintain, ventilation and dust collection systems.
* Ensure proper functioning of water pumps and other plant utilities.
* Monitor energy consumption and identify opportunities for energy savings.

**D. Food Safety & Quality Compliance**

* Ensure machinery and equipment comply with GMP, GHP and food safety requirements.
* Maintain hygienic conditions in production and processing areas.
* Ensure food-grade lubricants are used wherever required.
* Prevent oil leakage, metal contamination and foreign material contamination.
* Coordinate with the QA department during equipment inspection and audits.
* Ensure proper cleaning and maintenance after machine servicing.

**E. Team Management**

* Supervise maintenance technicians, electricians and fitters.
* Allocate daily maintenance jobs and monitor work progress.
* Train maintenance personnel on safety and equipment handling.
* Coordinate with production, quality and stores departments.
* Ensure proper use of tools, spare parts and maintenance resources.

**F. Spare Parts & Cost Control**

* Maintain critical spare parts inventory.
* Prepare spare parts indents and purchase requisitions.
* Coordinate with vendors and contractors for maintenance activities.
* Control maintenance expenses and optimize repair costs.
* Maintain minimum stock levels of essential spare parts.

**G. Safety & Documentation**

* Ensure compliance with industrial safety procedures.
* Implement Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) during maintenance activities.
* Ensure proper use of PPE by maintenance staff.
* Maintain maintenance checklists, equipment records and inspection reports.

Support ISO, HACCP, GMP and other statutory audits as applicable

  

**Technical Skills Required**

* Mechanical and electrical maintenance.
* PLC, VFD and control panel troubleshooting.
* Pneumatic and hydraulic systems.
* Industrial motors, gearboxes and bearings.
* Preventive and predictive maintenance.
* Fabrication, welding and fitting knowledge.
* Food processing and powder handling equipment.
* Utility and compressor maintenance.
* Breakdown analysis and troubleshooting.

  

**Expected Experience**

* 58 years of experience in food processing, FMCG or manufacturing industries.
* Hands-on experience in instant mix, spice and masala production machinery.
* Strong knowledge of preventive and breakdown maintenance.
* Experience in team handling and maintenance planning.
* Knowledge of GMP, HACCP, food safety and industrial safety practices.

jobs.description:
Program Manager Logistics, Supply Chain & Procurement   
 Program Manager Logistics, Supply Chain   
 & Procurement   
 Role   
 Program Manager / Project Manager Logistics,   
 Supply Chain & Procurement   
 Location   
 Bangalore Diamond District, Indiranagar   
 Work mode Full-time, 5 days a week from office   
 Experience 610 years in logistics, supply chain and/or   
 procurement, with at least 23 years leading teams   
 or programs   
 Reports to   
 Function   
 Head of Logistics   
 Global Logistics & Supply Chain (working closely   
 with Sourcing, Procurement, Sales and Business   
 Finance across all business units)   
 About Mstack   
 Mstack is a chemicals + AI company re-imagining how specialty and industrial chemicals   
 are sourced, developed and delivered across the world. With a team of ~225 people and   
 annual revenue of ~$180M, we connect high-quality manufacturing capacity in Asia with   
 customers across the Americas, the Middle East, Asia and, increasingly, Europe using   
 technology and data to make a traditionally opaque, fragmented supply chain faster, more   
 reliable and more transparent.   
 Our business model   
 Asset-light by design. We own no manufacturing plants. Products are made through a   
 network of contract and toll manufacturing partners, which lets us scale quickly   
 across products and geographies without heavy capital investment.   
 From trading to product ownership. Once we are confident in a product and its   
 market, we acquire ownership of the recipe and formulation. Today, roughly half our   
 revenue comes from trading and the other half from R&D-led products, contract   
 manufacturing and owned formulations and over the next 34 years we are   
 deliberately shifting the mix toward proprietary products.   
 Page 1 of 6

Program Manager Logistics, Supply Chain & Procurement   
 R&D at the core. Our R&D lab in Hyderabad's Genome Valley develops and   
 commercialises new products (two agrochemical products launched last year, with   
 more in the pipeline), and new labs are being set up in Bangalore and China.   
 Five business units   
 Each business unit runs like a focused mini-company, with its own sourcing and   
 procurement, program/logistics coordination, business finance and sales.   
 Oil & Gas and Paints & Coatings our largest businesses (~65% of revenue), serving   
 global energy-services leaders and Fortune 500 chemical companies across the US,   
 Middle East, Mexico and Brazil.   
 Agrochemicals an India-to-India business backed by in-house R&D.   
 Personal Care manufactured in India and supplied to OEMs and ODMs in China and   
 Southeast Asia, a market few Indian chemical players have cracked.   
 Food & Nutrition our newest unit, bringing specialty European ingredients to   
 Indian customers.   
 We are also expanding in China, adding Pharma, Agrochemicals and Food & Nutrition to   
 our portfolio there.   
 Global footprint   
 Mstack started in the US and has since grown into Canada, Mexico, Brazil and wider Latin   
 America, the Middle East and China, with Europe next. India is our largest base, with our   
 Bangalore headquarters, offices in Mumbai, Delhi and the Gujarat chemical belt   
 (Vadodara, Ankleshwar, Bharuch), and our Hyderabad R&D lab. Our team in Shanghai   
 covers sales, sourcing and logistics for China.   
 How we source   
 Our centralised sourcing and procurement team in Bangalore finds the right supplier, in   
 the right geography, at the right price for every customer need for example, supplying   
 a US tier-1 customer from India, China, the Middle East, Korea or Taiwan. We work in two   
 ways:   
 Customer-driven: our sales teams identify a customer need, and sourcing builds the   
 supply solution around it.   
 Product-driven: we lead with products and formulations we know deeply and take   
 them to market.   
 Volumes range widely from oil and gas commodities moving at 2030 metric tons a day   
 and epoxies at around a container a day into the US, to high-value personal care   
 ingredients shipped at 25 tons a month. That variety is exactly what makes logistics at   
 Page 2 of 6

Program Manager Logistics, Supply Chain & Procurement   
 Mstack challenging and interesting.   
 The role   
 We are looking for a Program Manager to own the end-to-end movement of goods across   
 Mstack's global supply chain from the supplier's factory gate to the customer's door.   
 You will run first-mile, middle-mile and last-mile operations across multiple countries, lead   
 a team of logistics coordinators, manage budgets and freight costs, and use data to make   
 our supply chain faster, cheaper and more predictable.   
 This is a high-ownership role at the intersection of logistics, procurement and business   
 strategy. You will work daily with sourcing, sales, finance and manufacturing partners, and   
 with transporters, freight forwarders and customs brokers turning a complex, multi-   
 geography network into a reliable engine for growth.   
 Key responsibilities   
 End-to-end logistics execution   
 First mile: plan and coordinate pickups from contract and toll manufacturers and   
 suppliers; manage material readiness, packaging, labelling, quality checks and   
 dispatch schedules.   
 Middle mile: manage domestic linehaul and international freight (FCL, LCL, ISO tanks,   
 bulk and air), container bookings, port operations, transshipment and warehousing   
 with freight forwarders and CHAs.   
 Last mile: ensure on-time, in-full delivery to customers across the US, LATAM, the   
 Middle East, China, Southeast Asia and India, including destination customs clearance   
 and final delivery coordination.   
 Trucker and carrier coordination: build and manage a reliable network of   
 transporters, truckers and fleet partners; handle vehicle placement, real-time   
 tracking, detention and demurrage, and resolution of transit exceptions.   
 Handle dangerous-goods (DG/hazmat) shipments safely and in compliance with   
 applicable regulations.   
 Documentation and compliance   
 Own shipping and trade documentation end to end: commercial invoices, packing   
 lists, bills of lading, certificates of origin, MSDS/SDS, COAs, e-way bills, shipping bills   
 and insurance.   
 Page 3 of 6

Program Manager Logistics, Supply Chain & Procurement   
 Ensure compliance with exportimport regulations, customs requirements, Incoterms   
 and country-specific rules in each market we serve.   
 Maintain audit-ready records and work with finance on freight invoicing, duty   
 drawbacks and reconciliations.   
 Procurement and vendor management   
 Partner with the sourcing team on supplier selection, lead times and landed-cost   
 evaluation.   
 Run RFQs and negotiate rates and contracts with freight forwarders, shipping lines,   
 transporters, CHAs and warehouses.   
 Track vendor performance on cost, service levels, transit time and damage, and drive   
 continuous improvement.   
 Budgeting and cost management   
 Own the logistics budget for your programs: forecast freight and handling spend,   
 track actuals against plan and explain variances.   
 Identify and deliver cost savings through route optimisation, load consolidation, mode   
 selection and better contracts.   
 Build landed-cost and cost-to-serve models that inform pricing and sourcing   
 decisions.   
 Analytics and strategy   
 Define and track KPIs: OTIF, transit times, freight cost per ton, demurrage/detention,   
 documentation accuracy and vendor scorecards.   
 Build dashboards and reports for leadership; turn data into clear recommendations.   
 Develop the logistics strategy for new lanes, geographies and business units as   
 Mstack expands into Europe and beyond.   
 Identify opportunities to digitise and automate logistics workflows in partnership   
 with our tech teams.

jobs.title: Factory Manager / Plant Manager (Food Manufacturing)
jobs.description:
***Role:-*** Factory Manager / Plant Manager

(Food Manufacturing)

***Employment Type:-*** Full time, Permanent

***Location:-*** Jigani, Bangalore

***Experience:-***  8 to 12 years in food/FMCG manufacturing, incl. 5+ years leading a plant.

***Direct reports:-*** Production Officer, QC, Stores & Warehouse In-charge, Dispatch team

  

***About US:-***

  

We are a long-established brand with a proven track record of strong, long-standing customer base. We are looking to expand our product portfolio. While deeply rooted in our legacy, our focus remains on innovation and growth.

  

***The Role:-***

  

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Factory Manager to run day-to-day operations at our food plant in Jigani. You will know the shop floor, understand food safety deeply, and build a strong culture of hygiene, safety and continuous improvement.

  

***Responsibilities:-***

  

* **Production:** Plan and run production to meet volume, quality and delivery targets. Track KPIs (OEE, yield, wastage, downtime, cost per unit, OTIF) and act fast on gaps. Make the best use of materials, utilities and manpower, and support new product trials with R&D.
* **Food safety and quality:** Own the plants food safety system and FSSAI compliance, including batch traceability, mock recalls, root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* **Safety and compliance:** Ensure compliance with the Factories Act, Legal Metrology, Pollution Control Board, fire safety and other laws. Build a zero-harm safety culture, manage effluent and waste, and be the plants contact for inspectors.
* **Maintenance:** Keep equipment and utilities (DG sets, water treatment) reliable through planned maintenance. Plan and manage capex projects on time and budget.
* **People:** Lead and develop supervisors, operators and contract workers. Plan shifts and training, handle grievances fairly, and drive discipline and accountability.
* **Cost, inventory and dispatch:** Manage the plant budget and cost targets. Control stock with FIFO/FEFO to minimise expiry. Plan daily dispatches, manage transporters, and handle paperwork (invoices, e-way bills) and returns.
* **Reporting and improvement:** Share regular MIS reports with management. Lead Lean, 5S, Kaizen and Six Sigma initiatives, and bring in automation and ERP/digital tools.

  

***Required Qualification:-***

  

* Bachelors degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Dairy Technology, Chemical/Mechanical Engineering or related field.
* 8 to 12 years in food, beverage or FMCG manufacturing, with 5+ years as Plant/Factory Manager or equivalent, including hands-on shop-floor experience.
* Strong knowledge of FSSAI, HACCP, GMP and ISO 22000 / FSSC 22000, plus working knowledge of the Factories Act, labour and environmental laws.
* Experience managing a large multi-shift workforce, including contract labour.

  

***Preferred:-***

  

* MBA/Masters in Operations; FSSC 22000 / ISO 22000 / BRCGS Lead Auditor or FoSTaC certification; Lean Six Sigma belt.
* Experience with SAP or another ERP, and knowledge of the local regional language.

  

***Key skills:-***

  

* Leadership that motivates teams and leads by example on the shop floor.
* A food safety mindset, treating hygiene and safety as non-negotiable.
* Data-driven problem solving (5 Why, Fishbone, FMEA) and calm decision-making in breakdowns or recalls.
* Good planning, budgeting and communication with management, regulators, auditors and staff.
* Knowledge of Kannada and Hindi.

  

***How success is measured:-***

  

* Production vs plan and on-time-in-full (OTIF) delivery.
* OEE, yield, wastage and cost per unit vs budget.
* Customer complaints, zero recalls and zero lost-time injuries.
* Inventory accuracy, low expiry write-offs, and team attrition and training.

  

***Working conditions:-***

  

* Based at the plant, with shop-floor presence across shifts as needed.
* Must follow hygiene and GMP rules (protective clothing, health checks) and be available for emergencies.

* Supply chain, manufacturing, FMCG, seafood, meat or agri-export exposure
* GS1 standards, serialization, packaging aggregation or EPCIS
* SAP or other ERP/WMS integration experience
* Hands-on experience with scanners, sensors or other connected devices in a production or field setting
* Hindi, Kannada or another regional language for plant-floor conversations

**How we work**

We work hybrid. Most work is remote, and we meet in person 4–8 days a month (usually 1–2 days a week) at our Bengaluru HQ in Whitefield, or at customer sites. You'll need to live within commuting distance of Whitefield. Site visits are part of the role: typically once a month to customer plants, warehouses and processing centres, mostly day trips around Bengaluru during working hours. Some sites are meat and seafood processing facilities. Occasional outstation trips are planned in advance, travel and stay are arranged and paid by us, and your first visits are with a teammate.

**What we offer**

* Competitive fixed pay plus variable pay tied to revenue
* Real ownership in a small, award-winning team working on food safety at national and global scale

**Hiring process**

A 30-minute intro call → a technical conversation → a mock discovery and demo with our team → a conversation with our founders.

**How to apply**

Click the Apply link to go to our short application form. It takes about 10 minutes: your CV, a few practical details, and two brief questions in your own words. We'd rather explore your experience properly in conversation than ask you to write essays, and we appreciate your interest.
