jobs.title: Head of Finance & Accounts
jobs.description:
**Job Description: Head of Finance & Accounts**

**Company:** Hatti Food & Beverages Pvt. Ltd. (Hatti Kaapi)  
**Designation:** Head, Finance & Accounts  
**Department:** Finance & Accounts  
**Job Location:** Bengaluru  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Reporting To:** Managing Director / CEO

  

**Job Summary**

Hatti Food & Beverages Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a highly qualified, experienced, and strategic Finance Head to lead the company's Finance & Accounts function.

  

The ideal candidate should have substantial experience in the FMCG, Food & Beverage, Retail, or Manufacturing industry, with a strong understanding of financial management, business planning, accounting, taxation, statutory compliance, and commercial operations.

  

The candidate will be responsible for developing financial strategies, driving profitability, strengthening financial controls, managing working capital, ensuring regulatory compliance, and providing strategic financial insights to support business growth.

  

The role requires a hands-on finance leader with the ability to manage multi-location operations, improve financial processes, and work closely with senior management on business decisions.

  

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

  

**1. Financial Planning & Strategic Management**

* Develop and implement financial strategies aligned with the company's business objectives and growth plans.
* Lead annual budgeting, financial forecasting, and long-term financial planning.
* Monitor financial performance and provide periodic reports and recommendations to Management.
* Analyse revenue, expenditure, profitability and business performance across outlets and business units.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to support strategic business decisions.
* Evaluate new business opportunities, expansion plans, capital investments and financial feasibility.

  

**2. Financial Reporting & MIS**

* Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and management reports.
* Ensure timely preparation and presentation of Profit & Loss statements, Balance Sheets and Cash Flow statements.
* Develop and implement financial MIS, dashboards and performance tracking systems.
* Monitor outlet-wise, region-wise and business-unit-wise financial performance.
* Analyse budget versus actual performance and highlight deviations with corrective action plans.
* Ensure accuracy, transparency and timely closure of financial records.

  

**3. FMCG / Food & Beverage Commercial Finance**

* Manage financial operations in a multi-location retail, FMCG and food service environment.
* Monitor product costing, food costs, gross margins, contribution margins and operating expenses.
* Implement effective inventory valuation and stock reconciliation processes.
* Monitor raw material procurement costs, wastage, stock movement and inventory holding.
* Work closely with Procurement, Operations and Supply Chain teams to improve cost efficiency.
* Establish effective controls over outlet-level cash collections, expenses, billing and settlements.
* Monitor outlet profitability and identify opportunities for margin improvement.

  

**4. Working Capital & Treasury Management**

* Manage cash flow, fund allocation, liquidity and working capital requirements.
* Monitor accounts receivable, accounts payable, and outstanding balances.
* Ensure timely vendor payments and effective credit management.
* Develop cash flow forecasts and optimise the utilisation of financial resources.
* Maintain banking relationships and coordinate with financial institutions for funding requirements.
* Monitor fund utilisation and ensure adequate liquidity for business operations.

  

**5. Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable GST, Income Tax, TDS, TCS, and other statutory requirements.
* Oversee timely filing of statutory returns, payments and reconciliations.
* Coordinate with external auditors, tax consultants, and statutory authorities.
* Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and regulatory requirements.
* Establish strong internal financial controls and ensure proper documentation.
* Monitor changes in taxation laws and regulatory requirements affecting the business.

  

**6. Internal Controls & Risk Management**

* Establish and strengthen internal financial control systems and accounting procedures.
* Develop financial policies, approval matrices, and expense control mechanisms.
* Monitor financial risks, operational leakages and potential irregularities.
* Conduct periodic financial reviews and internal audits across outlets and departments.
* Ensure proper reconciliation of bank accounts, vendor accounts, customer accounts, and inventory.
* Implement corrective measures to minimise financial losses and improve operational efficiency.

  

**7. Accounts & Finance Team Leadership**

* Lead, guide and develop the Finance & Accounts team.
* Define responsibilities, establish performance expectations and monitor team deliverables.
* Ensure timely processing of vendor payments, employee reimbursements, payroll accounting, and financial transactions.
* Build efficient accounting processes and improve departmental productivity.
* Coordinate with HR, Operations, Procurement, Sales and other departments for financial requirements.

  

**8. Audit & Business Coordination**

* Manage statutory, internal, and tax audits.
* Coordinate with auditors, consultants, bankers and other external stakeholders.
* Ensure audit schedules, supporting documents and reconciliations are completed on time.
* Present financial performance, business risks and recommendations to senior management.
* Support management in business expansion, investment evaluation and financial decision-making.

  

**Educational Qualifications**

* Chartered Accountant / CMA / MBA in Finance from a reputed institution with strong relevant experience.
* Strong knowledge of accounting standards, taxation, and financial management.

  

**Experience Requirements**

* 5 - 10 years of overall experience in Finance & Accounts.
* At least 3 years in a senior finance leadership or managerial position.
* Strong and preferably mandatory experience in FMCG, Food & Beverage, Retail, Manufacturing, or a multi-location business.
* Experience in managing large-scale financial operations, budgeting, costing, taxation, audits, and financial reporting.
* Experience in ERP implementation, accounting automation, and process improvement will be an added advantage.

  

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strategic financial planning and business partnering.
* Advanced financial analysis and interpretation.
* Strong knowledge of GST, Income Tax, TDS, and statutory compliance.
* Budgeting, forecasting and financial modelling.
* Working capital and cash flow management.
* Inventory valuation, product costing and margin analysis.
* Internal financial controls and risk management.
* ERP / Accounting software knowledge.
* Advanced MS Excel and financial MIS reporting.
* Strong leadership, negotiation, and decision-making skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.

  

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Improvement in overall business profitability and operating margins.
* Accuracy and timely closure of monthly financial statements.
* Effective working capital and cash flow management.
* Timely statutory compliance and audit completion.
* Reduction in operational costs and financial leakages.
* Improvement in inventory control and reconciliation.
* Timely and accurate financial MIS and management reporting.
* Strengthening of internal financial controls and processes.

  

**Interested candidates with strong FMCG / Food & Beverage finance experience and a proven track record in leading finance functions are encouraged to apply.**

jobs.title: ODC Manager (Outdoor Catering Manager)

The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end event planning, operational execution, food quality, manpower deployment, vendor coordination, cost control and customer satisfaction.

* Develop and maintain reliable vendor relationships.

  

**7. Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain event-wise operational records, budgets, quotations, and expense statements.

* Track event revenue, expenses, profitability, and customer feedback.
* Submit post-event reports highlighting operational performance, challenges, and improvement areas.

* Identify opportunities to improve service quality, operational efficiency and business profitability.
* Take ownership of assigned events and ensure successful execution.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong experience in Outdoor Catering (ODC) and event operations.
* Excellent event planning and execution skills.
* Strong manpower and team management abilities.
* Knowledge of food production, menu planning, and catering service standards.
* Experience in budgeting, costing, and profitability management.
* Vendor management and negotiation skills.
* Good client relationship and communication skills.
* Strong coordination, problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel and operational MIS reporting.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple events simultaneously.

  

**Candidate Profile**

* Graduate in Hotel Management, Hospitality Management, Catering Technology, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 3 -10 years of relevant experience in catering, hospitality, or food service operations, preferably with substantial ODC experience.
* Prior experience independently handling large-scale catering events and corporate assignments.
* Experience managing large teams and multiple vendors.
* Willingness to travel and work flexible hours, including weekends and holidays, depending on event requirements.

  

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Successful and timely execution of assigned events.
* Event-wise revenue and profitability.
* Food quality and customer satisfaction.
* Manpower productivity and resource utilisation.
* Cost control and reduction of operational wastage.
* Vendor performance and logistics efficiency.

jobs.title: Assistant Account Manager

This role will be instrumental in ensuring financial accuracy, regulatory compliance, efficient working capital management, and supporting strategic business growth through financial insights.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Accounting & Operations

MIS Reporting & Financial Analysis

Banking & Treasury

Internal Controls & Process Improvement

Qualifications

Experience

jobs.title: Key Account Manager - International Business
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Key Account Manager (KAM), International Business  
**Function:** Account Management, Sales & Business Growth - Pet Food  
**Location:** Bengaluru, India (On-Site)  
   
**About Dogsee:**  
At Dogsee, we are passionately crafting a global revolution in the pet industry. Our mission is to elevate canine wellness through a commitment to quality, ethics, and innovation. With a foundation of love for dogs, we create 100% human-grade treats that nourish pets' health and happiness.  
   
Through strategic partnerships, innovative Go-To-Market strategies, and a dedicated team, Dogsee has achieved a robust presence in 30+ countries. We are continuously redefining global pet care standards, earning international recognition for Indian pet brands. Guided by our mission, we aim to foster cultural resonance, prioritize pet health, and inspire positive industry change.  
   
**Role Summary:**  
We are seeking a highly motivated and dynamic **Key Account Manager (KAM)** to lead the charge in driving sales growth, expanding business, and delivering exceptional client experiences across international markets. This individual will take full ownership of assigned international clients, ensuring client retention, exceeding sales targets, and exploring new growth opportunities.  
   
As the primary point of contact for key accounts, the KAM will focus on nurturing long-term client relationships while leveraging insights to maximize account revenue. The role demands tight alignment with sales targets and KPIs, coupled with proactive efforts to expand Dogsee's presence in global markets.  
   
In addition to managing existing accounts, the KAM will identify and onboard new distributors, resellers, and buyers across diverse geographies, helping Dogsee achieve its ambitious international growth objectives. This role also entails active collaboration with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless operations, timely delivery, and outstanding client satisfaction.  
   
**Key Responsibilities:**  
   
**Sales Growth & Expansion:**

* Develop and execute sales strategies to meet or exceed quarterly and annual revenue and growth targets.
* Actively identify new business opportunities and onboard distributors, resellers, and retail buyers in international markets.
* Expand Dogsee's client base by identifying untapped markets and regions with high growth potential.

**Account Management & Client Relations:**

* Build, nurture, and sustain strong relationships with international clients to drive loyalty and repeat business.
* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned key accounts, addressing inquiries, resolving issues, and ensuring an outstanding customer experience.
* Conduct regular business reviews with clients to discuss performance, sales trends, and areas for mutual growth.

**Strategic Business Planning:**

* Collaborate with clients on Joint Business Planning (JBP) initiatives to create mutually beneficial growth strategies.
* Leverage market insights and sales data to identify new opportunities and refine account strategies.

**Target Alignment & Reporting:**

* Tightly monitor and align activities with assigned sales and revenue targets.
* Track key performance indicators (KPIs) and generate actionable reports to assess account performance and profitability.

**Operations Coordination:**

* Work closely with cross-functional teams, including logistics, supply chain, and finance, to ensure seamless execution of shipments and order fulfillment.
* Oversee the preparation of shipping documentation, ensuring adherence to international trade regulations and Incoterms.

**Market Intelligence:**

* Stay updated on industry trends, competition, and customer preferences to provide insights for business decision-making.
* Gather market feedback to guide product development and innovation tailored to international markets.

**Collaboration & Cross-Functional Leadership:**

* Work with the marketing team to create campaigns and materials that resonate with international clients and end-users.
* Provide input for product innovations based on market demands and client feedback.

**Proactive Problem Solving:**

* Identify challenges in sales or operations and proactively implement solutions to ensure smooth processes and high client satisfaction.

**Skills and Qualifications:**

* **Education:** MBA in Marketing, International Business, or related fields.
* **Experience:** 2-5 years of experience in Key Account Management, International Sales, or Business Development within FMCG, B2B, or the pet industry.
* **Sales and Business Growth:** Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed sales targets and KPIs in an international setting.
* **Communication & Negotiation:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills; proven ability to negotiate deals and build lasting relationships.
* **Problem-Solving:** Analytical thinker with a solution-oriented mindset and the ability to handle complex, fast-paced situations.
* **Market Knowledge:** Familiarity with international trade regulations, Incoterms, and shipping documentation.
* **Tech-Savvy:** Proficiency in MS Office, CRM tools, and data analysis tools.

**What We're Looking For:**

* Self-motivated and result-driven individuals who thrive in challenging environments.
* Strong leadership and interpersonal skills to work effectively with diverse, global teams.
* Passion for pets or a background in the pet industry is a bonus!

**Why Join Dogsee?**

* Be part of a fast-growing global brand revolutionizing the pet industry.
* Work in a dynamic, collaborative environment that values innovation and creativity.
* Make a tangible impact on pets lives while contributing to Dogsee's global success story.

**Application Process:**

* If you're excited to grow with a company that's redefining pet care, send your resume and cover letter to anusha@khanalfoods.com. Let's work together to make pets happier, healthier, and more loved!

jobs.description:
AXA XL is seeking talented individuals to support our business across all product lines and geographies. This dynamic, global opportunity involves collaborating with Underwriting Assistants/Underwriters based in producing offices across multiple locations.  **What you'll be doing**

* Ensure data integrity across policy administration systems through standardized data intake procedures, operational reconciliation workflows, and well-organized procedures for managing changes.
* Ensure privacy and internal control compliance; support audits and regulatory reporting.

Analysts engage in risk, compliance, and financial crimes projects to serve Promontory clients within the banking and finance industry - helping them meet and exceed regulatory expectations. Analysts are expected to positively contribute to Promontory's success in a variety of areas, including BSA, anti-money laundering surveillance and reporting assistance, OFAC sanctions compliance, and other areas relevant to today's heightened regulatory climate.

Analysts must possess excellent writing, research, analytical, and critical thinking skills, and other applicable experience that leads to success in the role, such as strong work ethic and natural curiosity. Analysts must be able to judiciously analyze, assess, and write clearly and concisely. The nature of this work requires individuals to be flexible, learn new skills, work within time constraints, and meet uncompromising quality requirements and production expectations while working closely with others in a dynamic team environment.

* Apply logic and strong reasoning skills to conduct research for case analysis.
* Use sound decision-making skills to make recommendations based on research results.
* Compose comprehensive supporting narratives
* Interpret and apply project policies and procedures to direct work.
* Maintain high work product quality as outlined by each project specifications.
* Ensure work adheres to defined engagement policies and procedures
* Manage work efficiently to meet production goals and project deliverables.
* Contribute to developing individual and project goals and execute on tactical strategies for goal attainment.

**Required Education:**

Bachelor's Degree

**Preferred Education:**

Master's Degree

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise:**

* 1+ year prior AML experience REQUIRED.
* Compliance experience at a financial institution is STRONGLY PREFERRED.
* Retail banking experience is PREFERRED.
* The ability to work independently, take initiative, and able to adapt to change
* Ability to quickly understand and maintain current know3ledge of banking regulations, concepts, and issues.
* Quickly learn new applications and client systems to conduct research.
* Exercise sound judgment and observe the highest degree of confidentiality.
* Adept at multi-tasking and meeting deadlines in high-pressure environment.
* Results oriented team player with strong initiative and flexibility.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Superior writing skills with the ability to convey ideas clearly and succinctly.
* Exemplary customer service towards both internal and external parties.
* Exceptional research and processing skills with the ability to analyze large data sets, decipher higher risk attributes (transactional, geographical, product, customer type, etc.), and disposition appropriately.
* Demonstrate competency with computers, including proficiency with all Microsoft Office products, and should have prior experience with a variety of computer database and testing systems.

**Common Areas of Involvement:**

**Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Alerts**

* Review alerts generated by client systems for anomalous or potentially suspicious activity
* Review Know Your Customer (KYC) data for the focal client
* Analyze account transaction histories to identify activity indicative of money laundering, terrorist funding, or other potentially unusual or suspicious activity
* Conduct due diligence research on focal party and key counterparties
* Compare research and analysis to alert typology and close or escalate based on the review

**Office of Foreign Asset Controls (OFAC) Sanctions Screening**

* Review sanctions screening alerts generated by client systems as possible OFAC matches
* Compare customer profile and OFAC match profile details to identify mismatches
* Utilize phonetics, spelling, and knowledge of short names nicknames to support name mismatches
* Utilize client provided Politically Exposed Person (PEP) guidance for close family members to ensure alignment to client policy

* Verify supporting documentation for all profile information
* Determine Source of Wealth and Source of Funds
* Conduct risk assessment and risk rating based on the bank risk methodology

Testing covers areas such as consumer protection and disclosure, complaint handling, anti-money laundering and anti-terrorist financing obligations, and privacy.**

  

**Most test attributes pass or fail on the evidence. Some do not: the evidence is partial, the requirement is open to interpretation, or a pass on the test hides a customer outcome that is plainly wrong. The analyst is expected to notice these, record what the evidence does and does not show, and raise them rather than force a result. These are the cases the role exists to get right.**

  

**Test plan design, final conclusions, and finding ratings remain. The analyst executes, documents, and drafts.**

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

**Test Execution:**

  

* **Execute approved test scripts against regulatory requirements, including sample selection, evidence gathering, and attribute testing.**
* **Complete testing within the timelines set in the monitoring plan.**
* **Raise evidence gaps or access issues early so the test is not delayed.**

  

**Documentation and Workpaper:**

  

* **Prepare workpapers that are complete, clearly referenced, and reperformable by a reviewer.**
* **Record conclusions with the evidence and reasoning behind them what was tested, what was found, and why it passes or fails.**
* **Respond to reviewer comments promptly and close them out fully.**

  

**Findings and Judgement:**

  

* **Draft findings with condition, criteria, cause, and impact for review.**
* **Separate a documentation gap from a substantive compliance failure, and say which it is.**
* **Flag customer-outcome concerns observed during testing, even where the attribute technically passes.**

  

**Regulatory Knowledge:**

  

* **Maintain working knowledge of the regulatory requirements in scope, and help keep the obligations inventory mapped to tests.**
* **Support updates to test scripts when regulatory requirements change.**

  

**Experience & Qualifications:**

  

**Level and Tenure:**

  

* **Junior Associate / Senior Associate (ASA), 2- 3 years.**
* **4- 6 years in compliance, audit, quality assurance, or risk at a financial institution.**
* **Degree in business, law, finance, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.**

  

**Required Skills and Experience:**

  

* **Experience executing testing or quality reviews against defined requirements and documenting results.**
* **High attention to detail and consistency.**
* **Constructive scepticism: tests the evidence rather than accepting the explanation, and stays even-handed. Assessed at interview through a case exercise.**
* **Clear written English for workpapers and draft findings.**

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a hands-on, meticulous **Senior Quality Assurance Engineer for final Inspection & Line inspection** with expertise within high-precision manufacturing environments (Aerospace, Automobile, or Precision Machining only).

The ideal candidate will command comprehensive knowledge of GD&T, strong quality documentation practices (PPAP, FAIR, FMEA), and experience utilizing high-precision conventional measuring and inspection tools to ensure zero-defect delivery to global OEM clients.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Final Inspection & Quality Gatekeeping**

* **Final Product Verification:** Perform rigorous dimensional, visual, and functional final inspections of complex precision-machined components against strict engineering drawings and CAD models.
* **Non-Conformance Management:** Identify, isolate, and document non-conforming products during final inspection; lead root cause analysis (RCA) and drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) with the shop floor and machining teams.
* **Customer Specifications Compliance:** Ensure all final products meet exact customer requirements, international quality standards, and industry-specific regulations.

**2. Inspection Tools & Verification**

* **Quality Records & Traceability:** Maintain meticulous documentation trails, material test certificates (MTC), dimensional inspection logs, and dispatch clearance certificates.
* **Quality Audits & Compliance Support:** Assist in internal and external quality audits (AS9101, ISO 9001, IATF 16949, or customer-specific audits) and maintain audit readiness at all times.

**Candidate Profile & Qualifications**

* **Industry Experience:**

+ Mandatory 5 to 9 years of relevant quality assurance and inspection experience strictly from **Aerospace, Automobile, or High-Precision Machining** industries.

* **Technical Proficiencies:**

+ Thorough mastery of Engineering Drawings, Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T), and blueprint reading.
+ Strong working knowledge of quality management documentation including FAIR (AS9102), PPAP, APQP, FMEA, and 8D problem-solving methodologies.

* **Educational Background:**

+ Bachelors Degree / Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline.

* **Core Competencies:**

+ High attention to detail with zero-tolerance for quality slippages.
+ Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
+ Good communication skills for cross-functional coordination and customer quality interactions.

**What We Offer**

* An opportunity to work with cutting-edge aerospace and automotive precision manufacturing technology.
* A growth-oriented environment with clear career progression paths in quality leadership.
* Competitive compensation aligned with industry standards.

Bangalore, India (Full-Time In-Office)

We are dedicated to creating unique and exceptional gaming experiences. Our studio is a place where
**data-driven strategy meets deep engineering ownership**
, and where engineers don’t just build features , they shape product outcomes.

We are looking for
**high-IQ, product-minded engineers**

You’ll be the person who
**collapses the gap between idea and evidence**
.

From the first whiteboard discussion to the first playtest to the first feature shipped, you own that arc end-to-end. You’ll work closely with Product, Design, Art and Engineering to turn
**hypotheses → prototypes → production systems**
.

This is not a pure coding role. It’s not a pure product role.

It’s for someone who is operates credibly in both

* **Ideation & Concept Testing**

* **Prototyping & 0→1 Ownership**

* **Feature Development & System Ownership**
  : Take validated ideas to production, ensuring clean execution, minimal drift, and strong launch readiness.
* **Core Game Systems**
  : Build scalable, config-driven systems (progression, economy, live ops, FTUE) optimized for fast iteration.
* **Experimentation & Data**
  : Ship features with instrumentation, run experiments, and iterate based on real player behavior and metrics.
* **Product Thinking**
  : Evaluate what to build (and what not to) using data, player insight, and first-principles thinking.

**What You'll Bring:**

***Must-Haves:***

* Strong engineering background (CS fundamentals, system design, debugging); ability to quickly pick up new tools and technologies
* Strong product instincts, you’ve built or shipped something and
  **learned from its success/failure**
* High IQ with the ability to address significant problems from first principles and in a well-structured way.

* Outstanding communication, collaboration, and leadership skills, with the ability to inspire teams and influence stakeholders at all levels.

***Nice-to-Haves:***

* Experience in mobile F2P product roles; shipped or operated a live-service title.

* Hands-on A/B testing, UA creative iteration, and basic ad monetization mechanics.
* Experience with game engines like Unity or similar interactive systems

**Why You'll Love It Here:**

* **Impact:**

* **Ownership:**
  You will be given the autonomy and resources to build and lead a high-performance creative product vertical.
* **Innovation:**
  You will be at the forefront of the industry, empowered to explore and implement cutting-edge technologies like AI.
* **Culture:**
  You will join a passionate, collaborative, and data-informed team that values both creative excellence and business results.
* **Benefits:**
  We offer a competitive salary, a comprehensive benefits package, and a work environment that strongly supports your professional growth.

Own country payroll compliance validation for new and enhanced payroll engines. Translate legislation into testable payroll rules, independently calculate expected results, and ensure statutory and payroll calculations are accurate before release.

**Country Compliance & Rule Validation**

  

Research and interpret official payroll, tax, social security, pension and labour requirements for assigned countries.

Translate legislation into business rules, formulas, eligibility, thresholds, ceilings, effective dates and rounding rules. Assess statutory changes and identify impacted employee populations, calculations, reports and effective periods.

Validate gross-to-net, tax, employee/employer contributions, proration, overtime, leave without pay, bonus, arrears, retro and final settlement. Independently calculate expected results and maintain reliable reference or golden test cases.

Investigate variances through gross, taxable income, contribution base, tax, deductions, net pay and employer cost. ability to research unfamiliar jurisdictions is more important than superficial multi-country exposure.

**Product Manager Healthcare Provider**

**Domain:** Healthcare / Digital Health / Enterprise Platforms (Provider Background)

**Location:** Bengaluru

**Experience:** 12-16 Years (Minimum 6+ Years in Product Management)

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced **Product Manager** to lead the definition, execution, and evolution of digital healthcare products and platforms within a large-scale Healthcare & Wellness ecosystem.

This role will partner closely with business leaders, technology teams, clinical stakeholders, and product teams to define product strategy, manage roadmaps, drive stakeholder alignment, and deliver measurable business outcomes. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in healthcare product management, digital transformation, enterprise platforms, and customer-centric product development.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Roadmap Management

* Define and drive product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with business objectives.
* Translate healthcare business priorities into actionable product initiatives and feature roadmaps.
* Develop and maintain product roadmaps considering customer needs, business priorities, technology dependencies, and delivery feasibility.
* Identify opportunities for product innovation, platform enhancements, and new digital capabilities.
* Drive roadmap reviews and prioritization discussions with business and technology stakeholders.
* Ensure product investments deliver measurable business and customer value.

Stakeholder Management & Business Alignment

* Serve as the primary bridge between business stakeholders, technology teams, and delivery organizations.
* Collaborate with healthcare business leaders to understand business goals, operational challenges, and customer needs.
* Facilitate cross-functional discussions to align priorities and resolve competing requirements.
* Provide recommendations on product priorities, feature investments, and roadmap trade-offs.
* Drive stakeholder engagement and ensure transparency across product initiatives.

Product Prioritization & Governance

* Establish product prioritization frameworks based on business value, customer impact, regulatory requirements, and delivery feasibility.
* Consolidate business requirements into a structured and prioritized product backlog.
* Evaluate new product initiatives and enhancements based on business outcomes and strategic alignment.
* Partner with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects, and Engineering teams during requirement refinement and planning.
* Monitor roadmap execution, risks, dependencies, and delivery progress.

Product Execution & Delivery

* Work closely with engineering, architecture, UX/UI, operations, and delivery teams to ensure successful product implementation.
* Define business requirements, success criteria, and feature priorities.
* Participate in sprint planning, release planning, UAT, product demonstrations, and go-live readiness activities.
* Enable timely decision-making and requirement clarifications throughout the product lifecycle.
* Drive adoption, change management, and business readiness for new product capabilities.

Digital Transformation & Innovation

* Lead product initiatives focused on digital transformation and healthcare platform modernization.
* Support development of integrated digital healthcare solutions across patient, provider, and operational workflows.
* Evaluate opportunities to leverage AI, automation, analytics, and emerging technologies.
* Ensure product strategies consider scalability, interoperability, security, compliance, and user experience.
* Promote reusable and scalable platform capabilities aligned with long-term business goals.

Product Performance & Value Delivery

* Define and monitor product KPIs covering adoption, utilization, engagement, customer satisfaction, operational efficiency, and business impact.
* Utilize customer feedback, product analytics, and stakeholder insights to drive continuous improvement.
* Measure and communicate business value delivered through product initiatives.
* Identify opportunities for optimization, enhancement, and future investments.

Required Experience & Competencies

* 12-16 years of overall experience with at least 8 years in Product Management, Product Strategy, or Digital Transformation roles.
* Strong experience managing enterprise-scale digital products and healthcare technology platforms.
* Proven experience working with business leaders, product teams, and technology organizations.
* Expertise in product strategy, roadmap planning, backlog prioritization, and product lifecycle management.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams in Agile product development environments.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Ability to balance business priorities, customer needs, technology constraints, and regulatory requirements.
* Experience driving product adoption and delivering measurable business outcomes.

Preferred Experience

* Experience in **Healthcare, HealthTech, Digital Health, Hospital Operations, or Provider-focused technology ecosystems**.
* Exposure to healthcare platforms such as:
* HIS (Hospital Information Systems)
* EHR/EMR
* Practice Management Systems (PMS)
* Telehealth Platforms
* Diagnostics & Laboratory Systems
* Patient Engagement Solutions
* Digital Wellness Platforms
* Understanding of healthcare interoperability standards such as **HL7, FHIR, and ABDM**.
* Experience with healthcare digital transformation, platform modernization, and data-driven product initiatives.
* Exposure to AI-enabled healthcare products, automation, analytics, and patient-centric digital solutions.

Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, Healthcare Management, or a related discipline.
* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is preferred.
* Product Management certifications such as **SAFe Product Manager, CSPO, Pragmatic Institute, or equivalent** are desirable.

Role Accountability

The Product Manager will be responsible for product vision, roadmap planning, stakeholder alignment, prioritization, and value realization across healthcare digital platforms and solutions.

The role requires a strong balance of strategic thinking and execution excellence, working collaboratively with business, clinical, and technology teams to deliver innovative healthcare products that improve customer experience and business outcomes.

jobs.description:
**Job Description: Trainer SolidWorks**

As India builds its ambitions across semiconductors, aerospace, defense, space, cybersecurity and advanced manufacturing, a critical requirement is the ability to translate technological ambition into practical engineering capability. This calls for specialized talent, hands-on expertise, access to advanced technology platforms and a closer connection between knowledge and industrial application.

**Ramaiah Institute for Advanced Skills and Technology (RIASAT)** is Ramaiahs advanced skills, digital engineering and industrial R&D platform, built to bridge the gap between **academic learning, industry readiness, technology development and deep-tech commercialization**. RIASAT develops day-zero productive talent and builds real-world engineering capabilities for critical and emerging industries through specialized skilling, applied engineering, technology platforms, industrial R&D and hands-on industry engagement.

RIASAT works across the deep-tech value chain, from education and skilling, design and engineering, and technology development to testing, characterization and industrial application with a focus on **Semiconductors, Aerospace & Defence, Space, Cybersecurity, MedTech and Advanced Manufacturing**. Its ecosystem of academic, research and technology collaborations brings specialized expertise and real-world engineering environments into this journey.

With **IISc, IIT Madras and CMTI**, RIASAT is working across areas such as semiconductor packaging and micro-assembly, SMT and PCB assembly, semiconductor testing, systems integration, precision engineering and advanced manufacturing. Work with **Dassault Systmes/SOLIDWORKS** and **Dhruva Space** extends this into digital product design and simulation, virtual twins, technology validation, and the development of electronics and deep-tech systems for space applications. With **Elbit Systems**, the collaboration creates capability development in cybersecurity and defence technology, domains where specialized technical expertise is critical.

  

**Role Purpose:**

We are seeking an experienced Technical Trainer specializing in SOLIDWORKS 2026 (R2026x) integrated with the Dassault Systmes 3DEXPERIENCE platform. In this role, you will train engineering teams, designers, and students on modern connected CAD workflows. You will guide learners through core 3D modeling, large assembly management, cloud-based Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), and the latest 2026 AI-assisted design and collaboration tools.

  

**Reporting to:** Senior Manager – Dassault Program

  

**Location:** Bangalore

  

**Trainer Capability**

* **Classroom Delivery & Hands-On Coaching:** Strong stage presence to lead engaging, face-to-face sessions using live workstation demos, whiteboarding, and real-time, over-the-shoulder troubleshooting during lab exercises.
* **Curriculum Design & Lab Readiness:** Skilled at structuring practical training modules, evaluating learner progress through hands-on assessments, and preparing physical lab workstations and 3DEXPERIENCE tenants before every batch.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Deliver structured training on product design engineering workflows using Dassault Systmes tools.
* Train learners on sketching, parametric modelling, assembly design, drafting, design intent and engineering documentation.
* Coach students and professionals to create complete digital product prototypes from concept to detailed design.
* Conduct project-based exercises such as machine components, automotive parts, consumer products, industrial equipment parts and assemblies.
* Explain engineering design fundamentals such as fits, tolerances, materials, manufacturability, fasteners, assemblies and design standards.
* Evaluate assignments, capstone projects and design portfolios.
* Support RIASAT in conducting demos, workshops, open-house sessions and industry-facing training programs.
* Help create training manuals, project datasets, lab exercises and assessment rubrics.
* Mentor students in job roles such as CAD Engineer, Product Design Engineer, Design Associate, Drafting Engineer and Digital Prototyping Engineer.

  

**Required Qualification and Experience**

* BE/B.Tech/ME/M.Tech in Mechanical, Product Design, Automotive, Aerospace or Industrial Design
* 4–10 years of experience in product design, mechanical design, CAD engineering, digital prototyping or engineering services.
* Hands-on experience in SolidWorks 2026
* Experience in industry projects involving part design, assembly design, drafting and product documentation.
* Prior training experience is preferred but not mandatory if the candidate has strong communication and mentoring ability.

  

**Mandatory / Preferred Certification**

* Preferred: Dassault Systmes SolidWorks CSWA & CSWP certification i
* Additional certifications in mechanical design, product development, GD&T, drafting or CAD automation will be an advantage.

  

**Key Skills**

* Strong 3D modelling and assembly design skills.
* Understanding of product design lifecycle.
* Ability to explain engineering concepts clearly to students and professionals.
* Strong communication and classroom management skills.
* Ability to conduct practical, project-based learning.
* Ability to align training outcomes with industry job roles and commercial training expectations.

  

**Expected Outcomes**

  

The trainer should enable learners to independently create 3D models, assemblies, engineering drawings, product visualizations and design documentation suitable for academic projects, industry assignments and entry-level engineering roles.

  

**Apply Now:** Be a part of this phenomenal journey of transformation by sending your resume to **talent@ramaiahacademy.com**.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

Do you want to shape the future of fintech and healthtech? Energized by challenges and inspired by bold goals? Ready to elevate your career alongside driven and talented colleagues? If that sounds like you, explore a career at Alegeus today.

**Opportunity Happens Here**.

**Responsibilities**

Alegeus is modernizing into an API first, open integration platform that powers partners, employers, and participants across consumer-directed-healthcare. You will own the Integrations product surface so that partners can integrate faster with higher reliability, enabling new experiences and AI/agentic workflows. Integration

**Ownership Scope**

You will own all external integration modalities at Alegeus, including:

* Data integrations: Public APIs, webhooks, event streams, real-time interfaces, and asynchronous messaging patterns
* File-based integrations: EDI, CSV, batch processing, and secure file transfer (e.g., SFTP)
* Experience integrations: front-end microservices, embeddable widgets, and partner-facing UI extensions
* This role ensures that the above is designed, delivered, and evolved as one cohesive platform, not disconnected channels, with shared standards for security, versioning, observability, reliability, and partner experience.

**Outcomes you'll own**

* Reduce partner time to first value and increase adoption across key use cases.
* Ship a coherent v2 API set with clear versioning, deprecation, and a reliable release cadence.
* Launch a webhook/event framework (subscribe, replay, DLQ, idempotency) with partnergrade SLAs.
* Deliver a developer experience that delights: dev portal, docs, SDKs, samples, error taxonomy, sandbox, chatbot, etc.
* Establish product analytics KPIs (adoption, latency, reliability, errors, partner NPS) with dashboards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the roadmap for Data, File and Experience integrations; define problem statements, success metrics, and crisp PRDs.
* Partner with design/engineering/Product owners to deliver secure, scalable interfaces and reference implementations.
* Work directly with marquee partners to map JTBD and translate into stable contracts/schemas.
* Drive packaging, auth models (OAuth/OIDC), rate limits, quotas, SLAs, and change management.
* Orchestrate launches: docs, changelogs, guides, enablement, and internal readiness.

**Required Qualifications**

* 6-10+ years in PM with SaaS integrations as your product (not just "has APIs").
* Hands-on track record shipping public REST APIs and webhooks at scale; familiarity with async patterns, retries, backoff, and event semantics.
* Strong grasp of DX: information architecture for docs, quickstarts, SDK stewardship, error design.
* Data exchange expertise: realtime + bulk, schema evolution, validation, and observability for integrations.
* Excellent partner-facing skills: discovery, solutioning, negotiating tradeoffs, clear communication.

**Nice to have**

* Healthcare, claims/eligibility, fintech/payments, or benefits ecosystem experience.
* API monetization/packaging, partner marketplaces, or appecosystem playbooks.
* Observability for integrations (schema drift detection, tracing, deadlettering, replay tools).

**How we'll measure success**

* Adoption of v2 endpoints webhook subscriptions; reduction in partner integration time.
* Reliability (SLO attainment), latency improvements, and error rate reductions for integration flows.

jobs.title: Tracxn - Senior Associate Product Manager
jobs.description:
**ABOUT TRACXN**

Tracxn is a leading global market intelligence platform tracking 7.9M + private companies across 3,000+ sectors and 50+ geographies. We turn deep data into decision-ready insights, powering deal sourcing, market mapping, and due diligence for 850+ clients worldwide, including VC firms, Private Equity, Investment Banks, and Corporates.

  

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

As an Associate Product Manager at Tracxn, youll support the product team in defining requirements, analyzing performance, and executing product initiatives across the lifecycle. Youll collaborate with design, engineering, and senior PMs to translate ideas into impactful product features.

This role is ideal for early-career professionals eager to learn product fundamentals, work on a global B2B SaaS platform, and grow into a full-fledged Product Manager.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Feature Specification:** Assist Product Managers in defining feature specifications and writing detailed product requirement documents (PRDs).
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with design, engineering, and operations teams to ensure smooth execution across the product lifecycle.
* **Performance Analysis:** Review and analyze key product metrics to track performance and identify improvement areas.
* **Design Support:** Collaborate with the UX team to create wireframes, mockups, and design documentation.
* **Data & Insights:** Use data and API tools (like Postman) to extract insights and validate product decisions.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure alignment on priorities, timelines, and deliverables.
* **Documentation Management:** Maintain reports, knowledge repositories, and other operational resources for effective tracking and learning.
* **Process Improvement:** Identify workflow bottlenecks and suggest enhancements to improve efficiency and product quality.

  

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

* **2–5 years of work experience who have graduated from a Tier 1 college.**
* An engineering background is a must.
* Strong interest in B2B SaaS products and technology, with empathy for users and a problem-solving mindset.
* Ability to structure and analyze ambiguous problems effectively.
* Excellent communication skills to clearly convey ideas through workflows, feature descriptions, and documentation.
* A long-term desire to build a career in Product Management and grow into a full-fledged PM role.
* Preferred: prior exposure to SQL, Postman, or other data/API tools.
* Preferred: internship or project experience in product management, UX, or a related field.

  

**WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT AT TRACXN**

* Fixed work timings — 9 hrs 5 days. Respect for personal time; no taking work home.
* A transparent, meritocratic culture where everyone explains the “why” behind their decisions.
* A candid and collaborative environment that values learning, curiosity, and open discussions.
* Managers and mentors who invest in your growth with timely, actionable feedback.
* Continuous learning through real-time projects and cross-functional exposure.

jobs.title: Process Engineer 4
jobs.description:
**The group you’ll be a part of**
In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam’s etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry.
  
  
**The impact you’ll make**
As a Process Engineer at Lam, you will operate on cutting-edge technology, harnessing atomic precision, material science, and surface engineering to push technical boundaries. Your role involves developing new and advanced process formulations, defining equipment hardware to meet processing requirements, evaluating test data, and coordinating design requirements to ensure compatibility of processing methods. Your expertise and knowledge play a crucial role our customers success, making an impact on the next generation of semiconductor breakthroughs.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Conduct process engineering research, development, and evaluation in support of Lam’s cutting-edge semiconductor equipment and systems.
* Review and enhance processing techniques and methods applied in the manufacture and fabrication of products.
* Develop and sustain new processes and process improvements to reduce production costs and increase yields.
* Compile and analyze test data to establish next steps in process development and determine appropriate limits and variables for process specifications.
* Collaborate internally to plan, collect data, analyze results, and report on customer demos for existing process applications.
* Partner cross-functionally and with customers to understand roadmaps, process flow, inflection points, requirements, and business challenges.
* Contribute to next generation product development and release activities supporting the semiconductor roadmap.
* Provide leadership, clear direction, and guidance to process technicians to support execution activities.

**Minimum Qualifications**
**Who we’re looking for**

* Master’s degree in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry or Physics or related field with 6+ years of experience; or a PhD with 3+ years’ experience; or equivalent experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with working in a laboratory and on semiconductor equipment with experience in surface preparation and analytical techniques.
* In-depth understanding of Statistical Process Control (SPC) and/or Design of Experiments (DOE).
* Highly proficient in MATLAB, Python, or other similar scientific computing language.
* Working knowledge of statistical analysis and problem-solving methodologies.
* Experience with statistical tools (JMP, Minitab, etc.)
* Background in Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD), Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD), Plasma Enhanced Chemical Vapor Deposition (PECVD), or Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD).
* Background in Plasma Physics, Reactive Ion Etching (RIE), Atomic Layer Etching (ALE), Inductively Coupled Plasma (ICP), Capacitively Coupled Plasma (CCP).
* Knowledge of Material synthesis and material characterization.
* Experience working in a collaborative and matrixed environment with diverse teams, semiconductor customers, and/or partners.
* Experience in semiconductor, process design, deposition, etch dielectrics or conductor, metal films, etc.

**Our commitment**
We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.
  
  
Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees.
  
  
*Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On-site Flex’ you’ll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.*

The Asset Geologist supports development planning, reservoir characterization, subsurface uncertainty reduction, and value optimization for shale and tight assets. This role develops integrated geologic interpretations and decision-support products by combining geological, geophysical, petrophysical, engineering, production, and external benchmark data. The successful candidate will work closely with global asset teams and technical specialists to support field development decisions, improve well performance, identify development opportunities, and improve understanding of subsurface risk and uncertainty. The role is expected to influence development decisions and business outcomes through direct collaboration with global asset teams and technical specialists. This role provides opportunities to apply digital technologies, analytics, and workflow improvements that accelerate technical decision making and business value delivery.

### Responsibilities

* Develop integrated geologic frameworks, reservoir characterization studies, maps, and interpretation products that support field development planning and reservoir management.
* Integrate geological, geophysical, petrophysical, production, completion, and engineering datasets to improve understanding of reservoir performance and development opportunities.
* Support well planning activities, including landing target recommendations, spacing evaluations, development sequencing, and risk mitigation.
* Conduct uncertainty assessments and recommend surveillance, appraisal, and data acquisition programs that improve decision quality.
* Evaluate well performance trends and integrate geologic learnings into development recommendations and forecasting workflows.
* Perform competitor benchmarking and external analog evaluations to identify value-creation opportunities and improve development planning assumptions.
* Collaborate with reservoir engineers, production engineers, geophysicists, petrophysicists, drilling and completions teams, commercial teams, and operations partners.
* Deliver technical recommendations that clearly communicate assumptions, risks, opportunities, and business impacts.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of subsurface workflows through digital tools, analytics, automation, and standardization efforts.
* Share technical knowledge and support capability building across the Earth Science community.

### About you

We know our greatest resource is the ingenuity, creativity and innovation of our people. Applications from motivated, talented individuals with a keen interest in the energy industry are encouraged.

To be considered for this role, applicants should have:

### Required Qualifications

* Masters degree or higher in geology, geophysics, geological engineering, or a related earth science discipline.
* 5-15 years of experience in reservoir characterization, development geology, integrated interpretation, or field development planning.
* Experience integrating seismic, well logs, petrophysical data, production information, and engineering data into development recommendations.
* Working knowledge of subsurface interpretation and modeling platforms such as Petrel or similar software.
* Strong technical foundation in stratigraphy, sedimentology, structural geology, basin analysis, reservoir quality evaluation, or related disciplines.
* Demonstrated ability to frame uncertainty, evaluate risks, and influence technical decisions.
* Strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills.

### Preferred Qualifications

* Experience supporting shale and tight developments.
* Advanced experience with subsurface interpretation and modeling workflows.
* Experience with competitor benchmarking and development optimization studies.
* Familiarity with data visualization, automation, analytics, scripting, or digital workflow development.
* Experience supporting integrated asset development planning and business decision making.
* Experience working with global asset teams, technical centers, or distributed delivery teams.

### Selection Criteria

* Demonstrated technical depth in reservoir characterization, geologic framework mapping, integrated interpretation, and development geology.
* Ability to connect geologic interpretation to production performance, development planning, risk mitigation, and economic outcomes.
* Strong judgment in uncertainty framing, data acquisition recommendations, and risk-based decision support.
* Ability to influence cross-functional development decisions through clear technical logic and practical recommendations.
* Strong collaboration across geology, geophysics, petrophysics, reservoir engineering, production engineering, drilling and completions, operations, and commercial teams.

R&D & New Product Development

Founders

Earthful is a clean-label, plant-based nutrition brand for women's health, backed by Fireside Ventures and V3 Ventures, and recently featured on Shark Tank India. Every product we sell starts as a brief written here. This role owns that journey from idea to a product on the shelf: the formulation, the trials, the evidence behind the claims, and the partners who make it.

**Role Overview**

You'll own new product development and improvement of existing products across supplements, functional foods, and wellness, working through contract manufacturers, third-party formulators, and ingredient vendors. You'll work directly with the founders on what to build, with Regulatory & Compliance on claims and labels, with Procurement on ingredients and packaging, and with Brand, Design, and Growth on launch. The job rewards people who can combine scientific judgment with speed, cost discipline, and follow-through.

**What You'll Own**

**Concept to Formulation Brief**

• Turn product concepts and consumer insight into clear, testable briefs for formulators and manufacturing partners

• Research ingredients, formats, and dosages for new wellness and supplement products

• Benchmark competitor products across India and global markets on formulation, claims, pricing, and positioning

• Develop across formats: powders, gummies, capsules, tablets, sachets, and others as the range grows

**Formulation & Product Trials**

• Own formulation development, from first sample to approved pilot batch

• Track every iteration — sensory trials, stability results, scale-up outcomes — and decide what moves forward and what is rejected

• Evaluate products on taste, mixability, texture, aroma, appearance, and usability

• Maintain structured documentation of trials, observations, and formulation changes

**Ingredient & Claims Research**

• Evaluate functional ingredients for dosage, evidence, usage restrictions, and clean-label suitability

• Build the claim substantiation file for each product — literature, references, and product rationale — before artwork is finalized

• Stay current on trends in women's health, gut health, protein, sleep and stress, and preventive wellness

**Vendor & Manufacturer Coordination**

• Coordinate with ingredient suppliers, contract manufacturers, and testing labs on samples, timelines, COAs, specifications, MOQs, and trial batches

• Support sourcing of ingredients and packaging components for new launches

• Compare vendors on quality, responsiveness, cost, and scalability, and give Procurement the technical input to negotiate

**Quality & Compliance Support**

• Own product specifications, ingredient sheets, and test reports for every product you develop

• Provide accurate label inputs, and work with Regulatory & Compliance on classification and claim alignment before launch

**Launch Readiness**

• Work with Brand, Design, Operations, and Growth so every product is ready on the launch date

• Translate technical product details into simple consumer-facing benefits

• Brief internal teams through launch decks, product notes, and FAQs

**Cost & Existing Product Improvement**

• Hold each formulation to a target cost of goods set at the brief stage, and flag early when a design choice puts it at risk

• Use consumer reviews, complaints, and operational feedback to prioritize improvements to existing products

• Use AI tools for literature and competitor research, verifying dosage, regulatory limits, and citations before anything is relied upon

• Education qualification - B Pharma, M Pharma, Pharmacognosy, Food technology

**What We're Looking For**

• 6–8 years of hands-on experience in NPD, R&D, or product development in supplements, nutraceuticals, functional foods, or FMCG wellness - who can independently lead the development activities.

• Working knowledge of FSSAI regulations for nutraceuticals and functional foods, and of claim substantiation

• Hands-on formulation experience in more than one format (powders, gummies, capsules, tablets, sachets)

• Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills and disciplined documentation habits

• Consumer-first thinking and curiosity about what makes a product work in the market

• Comfortable in a fast-moving startup with high ownership and direct access to the founders

jobs.title: Chassis - Steering Engineer
jobs.description:
Chassis - Steering Engineer

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Automotive Steering System Design Engineer with 3-9 years of relevant experience in the design, development, integration, and validation of vehicle steering systems. * The candidate should have strong technical knowledge of Electric Power Steering (EPS), steering columns, steering gears, tie rods, steering geometry, vehicle packaging, steering performance, and vehicle-level integration.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Steering System Design Development**

Design and develop complete steering systems for Passenger Cars, SUVs, EVs, or Commercial Vehicles.

Define steering-system architecture based on vehicle requirements.

Support selection and development of:

a.    Electric Power Steering (EPS)

b.    Column-EPS (C-EPS)

c.    Pinion-EPS (P-EPS)

d.    Rack-EPS (R-EPS)

e.    Hydraulic Power Steering (HPS), where applicable

Define steering-system performance and functional requirements.

Support steering-system development from concept through production release.

**2. Steering Component Design**

Design, develop, and integrate components including:

1.    Steering wheel

2.    Steering column

3.    Intermediate shaft

4.    Universal joints

5.    Steering gear / rack and pinion

6.    Tie rods

7.    Inner and outer ball joints

8.    EPS motor and ECU interfaces

9.    Steering mounting brackets

10.    Steering boots and associated components

**3. Steering Geometry Engineering**

Define and evaluate steering geometry.

Work on key steering parameters including:

a.    Steering ratio

b.    Turning radius

c.    Ackermann geometry

d.    King Pin Inclination

e.    Caster

f.    Trail

g.    Scrub radius

h.    Rack travel

i.    Wheel angle

Perform steering-effort and system-level engineering calculations.

Evaluate steering kinematics across the complete wheel and suspension travel range.

**4. EPS Electronic Steering Integration**

Support EPS selection, packaging, and integration.

Coordinate EPS motor, ECU, torque sensor, and vehicle electrical interfaces.

Work with Controls and Electrical/Electronics teams for EPS functionality.

Support steering assist, returnability, on-center feel, and steering response development.

Knowledge of Steer-by-Wire, ADAS steering functions, and automated-driving interfaces will be an advantage.

**5. CAD Design Vehicle Packaging**

Develop and review steering-system 3D models and 2D drawings.

Perform vehicle-level packaging studies.

Check steering-column and intermediate-shaft routing.

Perform clearance and interference analysis throughout steering and suspension travel.

Ensure integration with:

a.    Suspension

b.    Brakes

c.    Wheels and tyres

d.    Instrument panel

e.    Powertrain

f.    Battery systems for EV applications

Conduct tolerance stack-up studies and apply GDT requirements.

Preferred CAD Tools: CATIA V5 / CATIA 3DEXPERIENCE / Siemens NX

**6. CAE Vehicle Dynamics**

Work closely with CAE and Vehicle Dynamics teams for:

1.    Structural analysis

2.    Durability analysis

3.    Steering-system stiffness

4.    Steering kinematics

5.    NVH analysis

6.    Vehicle handling

7.    Steering response

8.    Steering effort

Experience with Adams Car, ANSYS, Abaqus, HyperMesh, MATLAB/Simulink, or equivalent tools will be an advantage.

**7. Testing Validation**

Prepare DVPR for steering-system components and complete vehicle systems.

Support component-, subsystem-, and vehicle-level validation.

Evaluate:

a.    Steering effort

b.    Steering response

c.    Returnability

d.    On-center feel

e.    Free play

f.    Turning radius

g.    Parking effort

h.    Noise and vibration

i.    Durability

j.    High-speed stability

Analyze test results and identify root causes for steering-related issues.

Recommend design modifications and corrective actions.

**8. Supplier Cross-Functional Coordination**

Prepare steering-system technical specifications.

Conduct technical reviews with steering-system suppliers.

Review supplier drawings, specifications, DFMEA, validation plans, and test reports.

Support supplier design and development activities.

Coordinate with Suspension, Brakes, Vehicle Dynamics, ADAS, Controls, Electrical/Electronics, CAE, Testing, Manufacturing, and Vehicle Integration teams.

Support engineering changes and design release activities.

**Required Technical Skills**

Automotive steering-system architecture

Electric Power Steering (EPS)

Rack Pinion Steering

Steering column and intermediate shaft

Steering geometry

Ackermann geometry

Steering ratio and turning radius

Steering effort calculations

Vehicle dynamics fundamentals

Suspension and steering integration

Vehicle-level packaging

GDT and tolerance stack-up

DFMEA

DVPR

Engineering change management

Root-cause analysis

EV / Advanced Steering Skills - Preferred

Electric Power Steering integration

EPS control interface

ADAS steering integration

Lane Keep Assist steering interface

Automated-driving steering functions

Steer-by-Wire fundamentals

Functional-safety awareness for electronically controlled steering systems

**Preferred Software Knowledge**

CAD: CATIA V5 / 3DEXPERIENCE / Siemens NX

Vehicle Dynamics: MSC Adams / Adams Car

CAE: ANSYS / Abaqus / HyperMesh

Controls: MATLAB / Simulink

PLM: Teamcenter / ENOVIA or equivalent

**Preferred Experience**

Experience in Passenger Cars, SUVs, EVs, or Commercial Vehicles.

Experience in complete steering-system development from concept, design and packaging through validation and production release.

Experience working with steering/EPS suppliers.

Exposure to vehicle dynamics, ADAS, EPS calibration, or Steer-by-Wire is preferred.

Key Competencies

Strong automotive steering-domain knowledge

Steering-system design and integration

Vehicle packaging

Engineering calculations

Vehicle dynamics understanding

Root-cause analysis

Supplier technical coordination

Cross-functional engineering coordination

jobs.title: Chassis- Brakes Engineer
jobs.description:
**Chassis- Brakes Engineer**

  

**Job Summary**

  

  
* We are looking for an experienced Automotive Brake System Design Engineer with 3-9 years of relevant experience in the design, development, integration, and validation of vehicle braking systems.
  
* The candidate should have strong knowledge of foundation brakes, hydraulic brake systems, brake actuation, ABS/ESC, parking brake systems, brake performance, vehicle integration, and brake system validation.
  

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**1. Brake System Design & Development**

  

  
* Design and develop complete vehicle braking systems for Passenger Cars, SUVs, EVs, or Commercial Vehicles.
  
* Define braking-system architecture and performance requirements.
  
* Perform brake-system sizing based on vehicle mass, GVW, axle loads, tyre size, vehicle speed, and braking targets.
  
* Define front-to-rear brake force distribution and brake balance.
  
* Support braking-system design from concept through production release.
  

  

**2. Brake Component Design**

  

  
* Design, develop, package, and integrate components such as:
  
* Disc brake assemblies
  
* Brake calipers
  
* Brake discs / rotors
  
* Brake pads
  
* Drum brakes
  
* Master cylinder
  
* Brake booster
  
* Brake pedal assembly
  
* Hydraulic brake lines and hoses
  
* ABS / ESC hydraulic control unit
  
* Parking brake systems
  
* Electric Parking Brake (EPB)
  

  

**3. Brake Performance Engineering**

  

  
* Perform engineering calculations and assessments for:
  
* Braking force
  
* Brake torque
  
* Stopping distance
  
* Brake balance
  
* Pedal force
  
* Hydraulic pressure
  
* Brake thermal capacity
  
* Disc sizing
  
* Heat generation and dissipation
  
* Brake fade performance
  
* Support performance evaluation under different vehicle loading and operating conditions.
  

  

**4. ABS / ESC & Electronic Brake Integration**

  

  
* Support vehicle-level integration of ABS and ESC systems.
  
* Coordinate with Controls, Electrical/Electronics, Vehicle Dynamics, and suppliers for brake-control integration.
  
* Support wheel-speed sensor and related component packaging.
  
* Knowledge of Brake-by-Wire, Electronic Brake Booster, or Integrated Brake Systems will be an advantage.
  
* For EV applications, understanding of regenerative braking and friction-brake blending is preferred.
  

  

**5. CAD Design & Vehicle Integration**

  

  
* Develop and review 3D models and 2D drawings for brake components.
  
* Perform packaging studies for brake assemblies, wheels, tyres, suspension, steering, and surrounding components.
  
* Conduct clearance and interference checks.
  
* Perform tolerance stack-up and apply GD&T requirements.
  
* Support engineering change and design release activities.
  
* Preferred CAD Tools: CATIA V5 / CATIA 3DEXPERIENCE / Siemens NX
  

  

**6. CAE & Thermal Analysis**

  

  
* Work closely with CAE teams for:
  
* Brake thermal analysis
  
* Structural analysis
  
* Fatigue analysis
  
* Disc stress and deformation analysis
  
* Brake component durability
  
* NVH analysis
  
* Experience with tools such as ANSYS, Abaqus, HyperMesh, or equivalent CAE software is preferred.
  

  

**7. Brake Testing & Validation**

  

  
* Prepare and execute DVP&R for brake-system components and vehicle-level braking performance.
  
* Support brake dynamometer and vehicle testing.
  
* Evaluate:
  
* a. Stopping distance
  
* b. Brake fade and recovery
  
* c. Pedal feel
  
* d. Brake efficiency
  
* e. Hot and cold braking performance
  
* f. Parking brake performance
  
* g. Brake noise and vibration
  
* h. Wet brake performance
  
* i. High-speed braking
  
* Analyze test results and initiate corrective actions for identified issues.
  

  

**8. Engineering & Supplier Coordination**

  

  
* Prepare technical specifications and engineering requirements.
  
* Review supplier technical proposals, drawings, specifications, and validation reports.
  
* Conduct design reviews and supplier technical discussions.
  
* Support DFMEA, DVP&R, root-cause analysis, and issue resolution.
  
* Coordinate with Suspension, Steering, Vehicle Integration, Vehicle Dynamics, CAE, Electrical/Electronics, Controls, Testing, Manufacturing, and Supplier teams.

jobs.title: AGM - Quality Control
jobs.description:
Job Title: Assistant General Manager (AGM) – Quality Control (QC)  
Department: Quality Control  
Industry: Pharmaceuticals – API / Bulk Drug Manufacturing  
Reports To: Head of Quality / Site Quality Head / VP – Quality  
Job Purpose:  
To lead and manage overall Quality Control laboratory operations—covering raw material, in-process, intermediate, finished API, and stability testing—while ensuring 100% compliance with cGMP, GLP, Data Integrity (ALCOA+), and global regulatory standards (USFDA, EDQM, WHO, CDSCO).  
Key Responsibilities:

* Laboratory Operations: Direct end-to-end sampling, analytical testing, and timely release of Raw Materials (RM), Packing Materials (PM), In-Process samples, Intermediates, Finished APIs, and Water/Environment monitoring samples to meet production and dispatch schedules.
* Instrumentation & Calibration: Ensure timely qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ), calibration, and preventive maintenance of analytical instruments including HPLC, GC, LC-MS/MS, GC-MS, ICP-OES, XRD, FTIR, UV, and Karl Fischer.
* Stability Management: Oversee the stability program (charging, pulling, testing, and trend evaluation) in accordance with ICH guidelines and regulatory filing commitments.
* Regulatory Audits & Compliance: Serve as the primary auditee for QC during regulatory inspections (USFDA, MHRA, EU-GMP, TGA, PMDA, WHO) and customer audits, ensuring continuous audit readiness.
* Data Integrity & Computerized Systems: Enforce strict compliance with 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles across all standalone instruments, CDS (Empower/Chromeleon), and LIMS; oversee periodic audit trail reviews.
* QMS & Investigations: Lead root-cause investigations for Out-of-Specification (OOS), Out-of-Trend (OOT), and laboratory incidents; review and approve Deviations, Change Controls, and CAPAs.
* Method Transfer & Validation: Oversee Analytical Method Validation (AMV), Method Verification, and Analytical Method Transfer (AMT) from R&D/ADL to commercial QC.
* Documentation Control: Review and approve QC SOPs, Specifications, Standard Testing Procedures (STPs), and Certificates of Analysis (CoAs).
* Standards & Inventory Management: Manage qualification, storage, and inventory of reference/working standards, impurities, columns, and reagents.
* Team Leadership & Budgeting: Lead, mentor, and manage shift schedules for QC Managers and Analysts; prepare annual Capex/Opex budgets and drive cost optimization without compromising quality.

Qualifications & Experience:

* Education: M.Sc. (Chemistry / Analytical Chemistry / Organic Chemistry) or M.Pharm.
* Experience: 15–20+ years in Pharmaceutical Quality Control, with extensive experience in API / Bulk Drug manufacturing and at least 4–5 years in a senior leadership role.
* Regulatory Exposure: Proven track record of successfully handling stringent regulatory audits (USFDA, EDQM, EU-GMP, etc.).

Key Skills & Competencies:

* Expertise in chromatography (HPLC, GC), spectroscopy, and trace-level impurity analysis (nitrosamines, genotoxic impurities, elemental impurities).
* Thorough knowledge of ICH guidelines (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q7) and major pharmacopeias (USP, EP, BP, IP).
* Strong analytical troubleshooting, crisis management, and cross-functional leadership skills.
