**Organisation:** GCV Life Pvt. Ltd. (GCViDEAL)**Job Title:** Executive/ Manager - Product Development & Commercialisation

**Job type:** On site

**Location:** Chakala, Mumbai

**About the Role**

Responsible for managing and coordinating the end-to-end product development, formulation development, manufacturing, quality, regulatory and supply-chain activities for nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, personal care and allied product categories.

The role involves translating client requirements and market opportunities into commercially viable products through coordination with contract manufacturers, ingredient suppliers, packaging vendors, internal business development teams and quality/regulatory functions.

**Key Responsibilities**A. Product Development & NPD

· Manage the product development lifecycle from initial concept and client requirement assessment to formulation finalisation, sampling, validation and commercial manufacturing.

· Evaluate new product opportunities based on market trends, consumer requirements, ingredient innovations and commercial feasibility.

· Coordinate with contract manufacturers and technical teams for new product development across nutraceutical, functional food, pharmaceutical and personal care categories.

· Drive formulation development, optimisation and improvement in terms of ingredient selection, active concentrations, excipient systems, flavour profiles, stability and product performance.

· Evaluate innovative delivery formats, including gummies, powders, sachets, tablets, capsules, liquids, RTDs and other functional formats.

· Coordinate prototype development, sample evaluation, sensory assessment and subsequent formulation modifications.

· Prepare and manage New Product Development (NPD/NPDP) documentation and development timelines.

· Coordinate technical feasibility assessments for new ingredients, formulations, processing technologies and product formats.

B. Contract Manufacturing, Technical Coordination and Scale up

· Identify, evaluate and coordinate with third-party manufacturing partners based on technical capabilities, product requirements, quality standards, certifications and commercial feasibility.

· Conduct manufacturing facility visits and technical assessments to evaluate production capabilities, infrastructure, processes and quality systems.

· Coordinate product development and commercial manufacturing activities with external manufacturing partners.

· Review manufacturing feasibility, process limitations, production capacities, minimum order quantities and lead times.

· Monitor manufacturing progress, identify bottlenecks and coordinate corrective actions to ensure timely execution.

· Establish manufacturing timelines and align internal and external stakeholders on development, procurement, production and dispatch schedules.

· Coordinate with manufacturing partners for process improvements, production optimisation and resolution of technical issues.

C. Quality Assurance & Quality Control Coordination

· Coordinate manufacturer QA/QC teams to establish and maintain product quality standards.

· Review product specifications, Certificates of Analysis (COAs), raw material documentation and finished product quality parameters.

· Establish and coordinate quality checkpoints across product development, sampling, manufacturing and finished goods evaluation.

· Coordinate product testing, analytical evaluation, stability studies and quality investigations.

· Review product samples for sensory attributes, physical characteristics and compliance with agreed specifications.

· Identify quality deviations and coordinate corrective and preventive actions with manufacturing partners.

· Ensure alignment between approved product specifications, manufacturing requirements and final commercial batches.

· Support quality documentation and product release-related activities.

D. Regulatory Affairs & Compliance

· Coordinate regulatory requirements for product development, manufacturing and commercialisation.

· Support FSSAI compliance, including product documentation, ingredient permissibility, product categorisation and labelling requirements.

· Review product labels, ingredient declarations, nutritional information, claims and regulatory artwork.

· Coordinate with regulatory teams and manufacturing partners for required licences, certifications, declarations and technical documentation.

· Support preparation and review of Free Sale Certificates, product descriptions, technical dossiers and other export-related documentation.

· Coordinate regulatory feasibility assessments for domestic and international product opportunities.

· Ensure product development and commercialisation activities remain aligned with applicable regulatory requirements.

E. Product Costing & Commercial Feasibility

· Coordinate product costing exercises for new and existing products.

· Evaluate ingredient costs, excipient systems, manufacturing charges, packaging costs and other associated expenses.

· Work with manufacturers and suppliers to obtain commercial quotations and develop product cost sheets.

· Identify opportunities for formulation optimisation, alternative ingredient sourcing and manufacturing efficiencies to improve product economics.

· Evaluate MOQ, batch sizes, production yields and manufacturing feasibility against commercial requirements.

· Support business development teams with technical and commercial inputs during client discussions and product proposals.

· Assess product feasibility from both technical and commercial perspectives before proceeding with development or commercial production.

F. Product Portfolio & Market Research

· Conduct market research to identify emerging nutraceutical ingredients, product formats, consumer trends and innovation opportunities.

· Evaluate new ingredients and technologies for potential inclusion in the company's product portfolio.

· Analyse competitor products, market positioning, formulation approaches and potential differentiation opportunities.

· Identify opportunities for portfolio expansion through innovative formulations, ingredient combinations and delivery formats.

· Coordinate technical evaluation and commercial feasibility of new product concepts.

· Support product positioning through technical information, formulation inputs and product development insights.

G. Commercial strategy

· Identify, evaluate and develop strategic relationships with third-party manufacturing partners based on technical capabilities, product requirements, quality standards, certifications and commercial feasibility.

· Develop commercial strategies to generate business through manufacturing partners by leveraging GCV's product portfolio, proprietary ingredients, formulation capabilities and innovation pipeline.

· Identify opportunities to introduce GCV-developed formulations and ready-to-launch products into manufacturers' existing client networks and business portfolios.

· Engage with manufacturers to understand their existing capabilities, client base, market reach and potential business opportunities for GCV.

H. Cross-functional Coordination & Project Management

· Act as a central coordination point between business development and external vendors.

· Develop and monitor project timelines covering formulation, sampling, procurement, packaging, testing, manufacturing and dispatch.

· Conduct regular follow-ups with stakeholders to ensure timely completion of project milestones.

· Identify project risks, operational bottlenecks and interdepartmental dependencies and drive resolution.

· Coordinate internal project reviews and development meetings.

· Ensure appropriate documentation, communication and accountability throughout the product development and supply lifecycle.

· Provide management with project updates, manufacturing status, supply risks and development progress.

**Requirements**

● B.Sc./ M.Sc. degree in food technology, biotechnology, microbi

jobs.title: Formulation Chemist
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
Bilvani is a BeautyTech startup transforming cosmetic personalization through smart manufacturing technology. The company creates customized cosmetic products in real time using intelligent dispensing and formulation machines, allowing customers to design beauty products that match their unique preferences. Bilvani’s platform combines personalized beauty, smart manufacturing, and technology-driven customization to deliver an innovative, premium retail experience. By shifting from mass-produced inventory to on-demand beauty manufacturing, Bilvani is redefining how cosmetic products are developed and delivered in retail environments.
  
**Role Description**
The Formulation Chemist will be responsible for developing, optimizing, and validating cosmetic formulations that work seamlessly with Bilvani’s intelligent dispensing and manufacturing systems. Day-to-day tasks include conducting lab-scale experiments, evaluating raw materials, performing stability and compatibility studies, and ensuring formulations meet performance, safety, and regulatory standards. The role involves close collaboration with R&D, engineering, and product teams to translate customer personalization parameters into robust, scalable formulations suitable for real-time creation in retail settings. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Vadodara, requiring hands-on laboratory work and regular interaction with cross-functional teams to support ongoing product innovation.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong analytical skills to interpret test data, troubleshoot formulation issues, and optimize product performance.
* Solid laboratory skills, including handling cosmetic raw materials, preparing batches, using common lab equipment, and following safety protocols.
* Experience in quality control, including developing and executing test methods, maintaining documentation, and ensuring consistency across batches.
* Background in research and development (R&D) for cosmetics or related fields, with experience in experimental design and innovation projects.
* Hands-on experience in formulation of skincare, makeup, or other cosmetic products, with understanding of emulsion, pigment dispersion, and stability principles.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Chemistry, Cosmetic Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Knowledge of cosmetic regulations, safety standards, and basic microbiological considerations is an advantage.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a startup environment, manage multiple projects, and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Product Manager – Nutraceuticals Division
jobs.description:
About Vieroots

Vieroots is a pioneering health-tech and wellness company specializing in personalized, genomics-driven preventive healthcare. By combining epigenetic lifestyle modifications (EPLIMO) with targeted nutritional supplementation, we empower individuals to optimize their healthspan and prevent lifestyle diseases. We are looking for an entrepreneurial, end-to-end Product Manager to spearhead the entire product lifecycle for our Nutraceuticals Division.

Role Overview

The Product Manager – Nutraceuticals will own the vision, strategy, formulation roadmap, launch, and lifecycle management of Vieroots’ nutritional supplement portfolio. You will act as the central bridge between our scientific/genomics team, R&D partners, regulatory affairs, supply chain, and marketing/sales teams—taking concepts from scientific insight to commercially successful, high-efficacy products.

Key Responsibilities

\* Product Strategy & Roadmap: Define and execute the multi-year product roadmap for the nutraceuticals division, aligning product launches with Vieroots’ personalized genomics and epigenetic recommendations.

\* End-to-End Product Development: Lead the full product development lifecycle (NPD)—from ideation, market research, and ingredient sourcing to formulation, stability testing, packaging design, and commercial scale-up.

\* Scientific & R&D Collaboration: Partner closely with in-house geneticists, nutritionists, and external R&D labs/contract manufacturers (CDMOs) to develop evidence-based, bioavailable, and differentiated formulations.

\* Regulatory & Quality Compliance: Ensure all formulations, claims, labels, and manufacturing processes strictly comply with FSSAI guidelines and relevant international nutraceutical standards (e.g., GMP, ISO, USFDA norms where applicable).

\* Vendor & Supply Chain Coordination: Identify, evaluate, and onboard contract manufacturers and raw ingredient suppliers; oversee cost optimization, COGS management, and vendor quality audits.

\* Go-To-Market (GTM) & Positioning: Craft compelling product positioning, value propositions, and scientific dossiers; collaborate with marketing, digital, and sales teams to drive product launches, medical/practitioner education, and customer adoption.

\* Lifecycle & P&L Management: Monitor post-launch performance, customer feedback, clinical efficacy data, and unit economics; drive product iterations, line extensions, and SKU rationalization.

Qualifications & Experience

\* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Pharmacy (B.Pharm / M.Pharm), Food Technology, Biotechnology, Nutrition, Life Sciences, or a related field. An MBA in Product Management or Marketing is a strong plus.

\* Experience: 2–5 years of experience in product management, new product development (NPD), or brand management within the nutraceutical, dietary supplements, functional foods, or consumer healthcare/pharma industries.

\* Domain Expertise: Proven track record of taking nutraceutical or OTC health products from concept to market launch. Deep familiarity with FSSAI nutraceutical regulations, ingredient bioavailability, and formulation challenges.

\* Analytical & Commercial Acumen: Strong understanding of pricing strategy, COGS, margin optimization, and market trend analysis.

\* Soft Skills: Exceptional cross-functional leadership, project management, and communication skills—capable of translating complex scientific/genomic concepts into clear consumer benefits.

Preferred Qualifications

\* Prior experience working in personalized nutrition, preventative healthcare, or direct-to-consumer (D2C) wellness brands.

\* Familiarity with nutrigenomics, epigenetics, or metabolic health supplements.

What We Offer

\* Opportunity to shape the product portfolio of a fast-growing, science-first personalized wellness brand.

\* High autonomy and end-to-end ownership across R&D, operations, and commercial strategy.

\* Collaborative, innovation-driven work culture with competitive compensation and growth opportunities.

* Salary Range is - 45000.00 - 70000.00

jobs.title: Formulation Analytical Development Manager
jobs.description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.
  
  
**JOB PURPOSE:**
Provide senior individual-contributor technical leadership for OTC formulation science, product design, development, scale-up, technology transfer, regulatory technical support, and lifecycle management across consumer healthcare products and dosage forms.
  
  
The Principal Scientist, OTC Formulation is a individual-contributor technical authority responsible for shaping formulation strategy and resolving complex technical challenges across OTC consumer healthcare development programs. The role reports to the Senior Principal Scientist, OTC Product Development / Formulation Science, and operates through technical depth, cross-functional influence, senior review, governance, and mentorship rather than direct line management.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Formulation and Product Development
* Define formulation strategy and technical development approach for complex OTC products across relevant consumer healthcare categories.
* Translate consumer, commercial, regulatory, quality, and manufacturing requirements into robust target product profiles and formulation strategies.
* Provide senior technical leadership for dosage-form design, pre-formulation, excipient selection, active compatibility, product performance, and risk-based formulation decisions.
* Resolve complex formulation challenges including palatability, dose delivery, solubility, dissolution, rheology, microbial robustness, preservative effectiveness, packaging interaction, and stability.
* Embed QbD, design of experiments, critical quality attributes, critical process parameters, control strategy, and technical risk management into development programs.
* Technical Leadership and Delivery
* Ensure formulation decisions support consumer experience, labelled use, dose delivery, product performance, and OTC self-care suitability.
* Partner with Medical, Regulatory, Claims, Consumer Science, Commercial, Quality, Packaging, Supply, and external partners to support evidence readiness and product delivery.
* Provide technical review of formulation rationale, development data, stability conclusions, regulatory technical content, and lifecycle change assessments.
* Contribute to innovation, external technology assessment, competitive benchmarking, design-to-value, productivity, sustainability, and lifecycle improvement opportunities.

**Why you?**
**Basic Qualifications:**
We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:
  
  

* Master’s degree in Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent senior technical experience may be considered.
* Typically 8-10+ years of formulation, product development, or technical leadership experience in OTC, consumer healthcare, pharmaceutical, or other regulated product environments.
* Demonstrated accountability for formulation strategy, technical problem solving, and delivery of multiple products, platforms, dosage forms, or lifecycle programs.
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, work with external partners, and coach or mentor scientists through technical authority rather than formal line-management authority.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:
  
  

* Experience supporting multiple geographic markets, APAC regulatory environments, or OTC monograph/local-standard frameworks.
* Experience with pain, respiratory, allergy, gastrointestinal, dermatology, wellness, or adjacent self-care categories.
* Experience with contract development or manufacturing organizations, external laboratories, packaging partners, or external innovation partners.
* Knowledge of QbD, design of experiments, technical risk assessment, design-to-value, sustainability, and structured problem-solving tools.

**Core Competencies:**

* Strategic formulation leadership and advanced scientific judgment.
* Complex technical problem solving and risk-based decision making.
* Cross-functional influence and stakeholder management.
* Clear technical communication, documentation, and governance mindset.
* Knowledge sharing, and capability building as an individual contributor.
* Consumer-focused innovation, business acumen, and continuous improvement mindset.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Quality and impact of formulation strategy, technical direction, and risk-based decisions.
* Delivery of key technical milestones across development, scale-up, launch, and lifecycle programs.
* Robustness, stability, manufacturability, scalability, and consumer acceptability of developed products.
* Resolution of complex formulation, process, analytical, packaging, stability, and manufacturing issues.
* Quality of technical documentation, regulatory support, control strategy, and lifecycle change assessments.
* Contribution to innovation, productivity, sustainability, external technology assessment, and formulation-science capability building.

**Job Posting End Date**
2026-12-25
  
  
**Equal Opportunities**
Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  
  
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  
  
The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager - Fermentation & Upstream Processing
jobs.description:
**Position Overview:**

This position involves managing and optimizing upstream manufacturing operations, including microbial fermentation, media preparation, inoculum development, and microbial algae cultivation. The role focuses on overseeing day-to-day production activities, optimizing fermentation parameters, improving biomass productivity, and ensuring consistent batch performance while meeting production targets and quality standards. The candidate should have exposure to the production of omega oils, particularly DHA and EPA, from microbial algae, along with a strong understanding of fermentation processes, process optimization, and scale-up. The role also requires effective coordination with downstream processing, quality assurance, quality control, maintenance, and engineering teams to ensure safe, efficient, and compliant manufacturing operations.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Manage day-to-day upstream manufacturing operations, including media preparation, sterilization, inoculum development, fermentation, and microbial algae cultivation.
* Supervise and monitor fermentation processes to ensure consistent biomass growth, product yield, and adherence to production schedules.
* Operate and oversee fermenters, bioreactors, seed vessels, media preparation systems, sterilization systems, and associated auxiliary equipment.
* Support upstream production of microbial biomass for the manufacture of omega oils, including DHA and EPA, derived from microbial algae.
* Monitor and optimize critical process parameters such as temperature, pH, dissolved oxygen, agitation, aeration, nutrient feed, and fermentation duration.
* Perform media optimization, inoculum optimization, and process parameter optimization based on strain performance and production requirements.
* Troubleshoot fermentation-related issues, identify root causes of process deviations, and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure proper execution of batch manufacturing activities, including batch documentation, process monitoring, yield tracking, and timely batch completion.
* Take responsibility for the successful execution of assigned batches, ensuring process consistency, productivity, and compliance with established specifications.
* Support process development, technology transfer, and scale-up activities from laboratory or pilot scale to commercial manufacturing scale.
* Coordinate with downstream processing teams to ensure the timely transfer of fermentation broth or biomass for subsequent extraction and purification operations.
* Collaborate with quality assurance, quality control, maintenance, and engineering teams to address process deviations, equipment breakdowns, and operational challenges.
* Ensure compliance with applicable GMP requirements, SOPs, safety protocols, hygiene standards, and relevant regulatory requirements.
* Maintain accurate production records, batch manufacturing records, equipment logbooks, and other relevant documentation.
* Monitor raw material and media requirements, coordinate procurement planning with relevant departments, and minimize material wastage.
* Assist in production planning, manpower allocation, shift scheduling, and resource utilization to achieve manufacturing targets within the approved budget.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, cost reduction, increased biomass productivity, improved fermentation yields, and enhanced operational efficiency.
* Lead and guide upstream production personnel, ensuring adherence to operating procedures, safety practices, and quality standards.
* Support the evaluation and implementation of new technologies, automation systems, and process improvements in upstream manufacturing.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned by management.
* Duties and responsibilities are not limited to the work listed above and may include other assignments as necessary

Qualifications, Competencies, and Position Requirements

* Strong technical knowledge of upstream bioprocessing, microbial fermentation, and bioreactor operations.
* Practical understanding of microbial algae cultivation and fermentation-based production of omega oils, particularly DHA and/or EPA, is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of media formulation, inoculum development, sterilization, aseptic techniques, and fermentation process control.
* Ability to monitor, analyze, and optimize critical process parameters to improve biomass productivity and product yield.
* Knowledge of troubleshooting, root cause analysis, process deviation management, and corrective and preventive actions.
* Familiarity with GMP, SOPs, batch manufacturing documentation, and industrial safety practices.
* Strong leadership, communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
* Good organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple production activities.
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and support continuous improvement initiatives.
* Willingness to work in shifts, including night shifts, as required.
* Willingness to travel as required by the role.

***Education and Experience:***

* M.Tech, M.Sc., or Ph.D. in Biotechnology.
* Minimum of 5 years of relevant industrial experience in upstream manufacturing, microbial fermentation, or bioprocess operations, preferably in the nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, food biotechnology, or microbial oil industry.
* Hands-on experience in industrial-scale fermentation, bioreactor operations, media optimization, and process parameter optimization is preferred.
* Exposure to microbial algae cultivation and the production of omega oils, particularly DHA and EPA, is desirable.
* Knowledge of GMP requirements, SOPs, batch manufacturing documentation, process troubleshooting, and quality standards is preferred.

***Travel:***

* Ability to travel as required by role.

***Location:***

**Engagement type:** Consultant, project-based

**Work location:** Chennai office (on-site)

**Domain:** Pharmaceutical drug formulation and new product development (oral solid dosage)

**Duration:** Project-based, to be defined at onboarding (extendable)

**1. Role Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Pharmaceutical Formulation Consultant to develop new tablet and capsule products. The consultant will work from our Chennai office for the project duration. The role covers hands-on formulation preparation along with market research that supports product selection and positioning.

**2. Eligibility**

* **Freshers are not eligible to apply.**
* **Minimum 3+ years of hands-on, practical experience in formulation** (lab-level preparation and trials for tablets and/or capsules).
* Candidates with only theoretical or academic exposure, or with experience limited to QC, QA, or regulatory work, will not be considered.

**3. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Formulation Development (Tablets & Capsules)**

* Design and develop oral solid dosage formulations (immediate-release, and modified or sustained-release where applicable) for new products.
* Conduct pre-formulation studies: API characterisation, solubility, compatibility, and excipient selection.
* Personally prepare lab-scale formulation trials and optimise them using QbD / DoE principles.
* Select the manufacturing process (direct compression, wet or dry granulation, capsule filling) and define critical process parameters.
* Evaluate and troubleshoot trial batches: hardness, friability, disintegration, dissolution, assay, and content uniformity.
* Run stability studies as per ICH guidelines and interpret the results.
* Prepare formulation documents: Master Formula, development reports, and technical data packages.
* Support scale-up and tech transfer to the manufacturing site.

**B. Market Research**

* Carry out market and competitor analysis for target molecules and dosage forms (market size, demand trends, key players, pricing).
* Identify new product opportunities, including generics, 505(b)(2), nutraceutical-pharma crossover, and niche or unmet-need segments.
* Review the patent landscape, exclusivity status, and reference listed drug (RLD) details.
* Assess the regulatory pathway and market-entry feasibility (India CDSCO and, where relevant, regulated markets).
* Prepare product feasibility reports and a recommended product pipeline with a go / no-go view.

**C. Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate lab records and development documentation.
* Share regular progress updates and present findings to management.
* Deliver a final project report with formulation, data, and recommendations.

**4. Required Qualifications**

* M.Pharm (Pharmaceutics / Industrial Pharmacy) or Ph.D. in Pharmaceutical Sciences. B.Pharm with strong practical experience may be considered.
* **3+ years of practical formulation experience** in oral solid dosage forms (tablets and capsules).
* Demonstrated involvement in product development trials, from pre-formulation through optimisation.

**5. Required Skills**

* Strong working knowledge of excipients, granulation, compression, coating, and capsule-filling technologies.
* Hands-on use of formulation equipment (blenders, granulators, tablet press, capsule filling machine, coating pan).
* Knowledge of ICH, QbD, and cGMP, plus regulatory requirements for product filing.
* Familiarity with analytical methods: dissolution, HPLC, and related quality tests.
* Ability to conduct market research using IQVIA, patent databases, regulatory databases, and similar sources.
* Strong analytical, report-writing, and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and deliver to timelines.

**6. Preferred**

* Experience with modified-release or complex generics.
* Exposure to regulated-market filings (US FDA, EMA, WHO-GMP).
* Prior consulting experience.

**7. Deliverables**

* Pre-formulation and feasibility reports
* Optimised tablet and capsule formulations with trial batch data
* Stability data summary
* Market research and product opportunity report
* Final technical and project report

**8. Terms**

jobs.description:
We are Reckitt
  
  
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
Research & Development
  
  
In Research and Development, we're full of highly skilled talents that include Scientists, Engineers, Medical, Clinical and Regulatory professionals - all working to create a cleaner, healthier world. With nine Centres of Excellence, we continually seek out new opportunities by using science, our entrepreneurial flare and our fearless innovation to develop and enhance our existing portfolio, never compromising on quality or performance.
  
  
We do the right thing, always, by ensuring we act with responsibility and integrity, by complying with regulatory legislation across the globe, whilst ensuring our products are safe for our consumers and are to the highest quality.
  
  
The size of our organisation means you'll have the opportunity to learn and work in different functions within R&D, giving you exposure to different disciplines, teams and environments. You will also have access to our Research and Development Academy, designed to develop our team and allow you to grow in our great organisation.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Regulatory Associate, you’re at the forefront of shaping the synergy between our innovative products and the regulatory framework that guides them. Seeking a meticulous and proactive individual, this role offers you the chance to be the regulatory lead on pivotal projects, honing your communication skills, and nurturing robust partnerships — all while delivering critical tasks that influence our global presence. Your contributions will be impactful and meaningful, as you begin to navigate and influence the regulatory scenery that defines our industry.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  

* Collaborate with the team while taking on independent responsibility for regulatory innovation and compliance activities.
* Interpret and implement regulations and guidelines as needed to foster industry compliance.
* Engage with trade associations, contributing to and utilising our resources to influence favourable legislation.
* Understand the regulatory necessities of diverse projects, actively participate in them, and remain alert to project advancements and their benefits.
* Manage updates and actions in your area, ensuring tasks are completed effectively and efficiently.

The experience we're looking for
  
  

* Proven track record with at least 3 years in regulatory affairs, showcasing full proficiency in this role's requirements.
* Proficient in multitasking, executing tasks under pressure, and making objective decisions when faced with complex issues.
* Acute business acumen accompanied by commercial awareness.
* Demonstrated ability to cultivate insights from consumer interactions and translate them into strategic actions.
* Skilled in collaborating with teams across various functions, fostering an environment of partnership building.
* Agility to adapt to the ever-evolving technological landscape, complemented by a mindset that seeks to improve and advance current processes.
* Experience with product lifecycle management, intellectual property, and innovative workflows.

The skills for success
  
  
Task Execution Under Pressure, Business Acumen, Commercial Awareness, Objective Setting, Accountability, Consumer Insight, R&D, Product Lifecycle Management, Intellectual Property, Business Partnership, Collaboration and partnership building, Adapt to changes in technological development plans, Ability to challenge the status quo and propose improvement, Innovation Processes.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

jobs.title: Asst Manager - ISO Certification
jobs.description:
**About TechnoSysCon**

TechnoSysCon is a premier Management & ISO consultancy based in Pune, Indias automotive and IT hub. Promoted by a team of subject matter experts, we partner with leading organizations across India and abroad—including major automotive, manufacturing, and technology firms—to build sustainable management systems through end-to-end training, documentation, implementation, and auditing.**Role Overview**We are looking for a detail-oriented **Assistant Manager – ISO Certification** to lead client engagements across multiple management system standards. In this client-facing role, you will guide organizations from initial gap analysis through documentation, process optimization, internal auditing, and final certification.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **End-to-End ISO Implementation:** Lead gap assessments, develop tailored documentation (manuals, SOPs, process maps), and guide clients through the implementation of management systems such as **ISO 9001 (QMS)**, **ISO 14001 (EMS)**, **ISO 45001 (OH&S)**, **ISO 27001 (ISMS)**, and **IATF 16949 / AS 9100**.
* **Auditing & Compliance Assurance:** Plan and execute comprehensive internal audits, mock certification audits, and management reviews to ensure strict compliance with international standards and statutory regulations.
* **Client Training & Capacity Building:** Design and deliver engaging Awareness and Internal Auditor training workshops for client leadership and cross-functional teams.
* **Process Optimization:** Collaborate with clients to integrate lean manufacturing, TQM, or operational best practices that drive measurable business improvement alongside certification.
* **Certification Liaison:** Support clients during external third-party certification audits and assist in closing non-conformities (NCs) effectively.

  

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* **Core Competencies:** Deep understanding of PDCA cycles, risk-based thinking, root cause analysis (RCA), and regulatory compliance frameworks.
* **Soft Skills:** Exceptional client-handling, presentation, and stakeholder communication skills, with willingness to travel to client sites as needed.

  

**Why Join TechnoSysCon?**

* **Diverse Industry Exposure:** Work directly with top-tier automotive, engineering, food safety, and IT enterprises across India and international markets.
* **Mentorship & Mastery:** Collaborate alongside seasoned subject matter experts and expand your credentials across 20+ global standards (including ESG, Carbon Footprint, Lean, and TPM).
* **High-Impact Autonomy:** Own client projects from blueprint to certification in a supportive, growth-focused consulting environment.
* **Complementory Certification** for ISO Internal Audit.

  

**Learn more about us:** **www.technosyscon.com/index.html**

jobs.title: Senior Programme Lead – Sustainable Food Systems (Political Economy)
jobs.company: Council on Energy, Environment and Water
jobs.description:
At CEEW, we are deliberate about what we stand for as an employer. So, if the below description strikes a chord, we would love to hear from you!

**At CEEW, we build careers in public policy**

* We offer strong visionary leadership – with emphasis on research and impact at scale
* We actively promote leadership by initiative
* We celebrate talent and ambition
* You will be surrounded by smart people who will challenge you and help you grow
* You will learn faster than your peers in other organisations
* Curiosity and irreverence, as well as responsibility, come together at CEEW
* You will get above-market remuneration
* We provide a safe space for all
* At CEEW, your life is your example for others

**Designation offered**
  
Senior Programme Lead

**Reporting to**
  
Sustainable Food Systems (Political Economy)

**Location**
  
New Delhi, India

### **Purpose**

Systems change in food systems reform is impeded by entrenched political economy dynamics. We are looking for a leader who can not only navigate this political economy, but also orchestrate difficult, real change – rewriting political economy equations and enabling systemic transformation. They will build and lead a team working at the interface of political economy, public policy, and institutions, and will advance the Council’s research, policy engagement, and impact by helping the programme understand and navigate political economy while actively orchestrating systems-level change in India’s food systems.

### **Responsibilities and Duties**

**Strategy**

* Co-evolve the strategy for the programme’s political economy work, building on existing in-house thinking, the political economy landscape across food systems reform, our skillset and niche, the evolving sectoral narrative, and emerging government priorities.
* Work closely with the team to bring alignment within the team on the strategy.
* Build a network of contacts across government, political leadership, and public institutions to create sustained pathways for policy and institutional change.
* Spearhead coalition building with public institutions, political leadership, and civil society partners, in coordination with internal project streams, creating a high-leverage venue for catalytic action on political economy transitions.
* Lead the thinking on how policy, institutions, and narratives shape decision-making in food systems; scope and develop new ideas and programmes to shift this political economy towards sustainability transitions.

### **Research**

* Lead research and intelligence-gathering on the political economy of food systems reform, including the role of institutions, regulatory environments, incentives, and narratives in shaping decision-making.
* Develop intelligence and strategies to shape the political economy of food systems towards sustainability transitions, and identify levers and entry points for orchestrating change.
* Map stakeholders, interests, and power structures across government, political leadership, and public institutions relevant to food systems reform, ensuring alignment and collaborative execution.
* Lead research in the programme area as a principal investigator. Guide and provide relevant inputs to the wider research agenda.
* Assess and improve existing methodologies and frameworks employed by SFS relevant to political economy analysis, and build institutional capacity on such methodologies.
* Keep a tab on policy and political developments in agriculture and food systems.
* Strong writing skills with the ability to write coherently and concisely: emails, opinion pieces, policy briefs, and reports

### **Leadership and Mentoring**

* Take end-to-end ownership of the programme. Ideate new research concepts with team members, develop project proposals and budgets, build relationships with donors that align with the institution’s interests, secure resources for building and expanding the work programme, deliver high-quality, timely outputs, engage with sectoral stakeholders, strive for impact, and develop CEEW’s thought leadership.
* Build and lead your team. Hone the team members to the best of their abilities. Stretch and strive and set leadership by initiative.
* Lead the strategic outreach of the programme. Lead external meetings, conferences, and seminars with government, political leadership, and public institutions, and be the face of CEEW in your programme area, while also creating platforms for your team for public engagement.
* Strategise the communication and outreach of research outputs along with the outreach team.
* Build strong relationships based on trust and credibility with key policymakers, political leadership, and sector stakeholders.

### **Selection Criteria and Key Skills**

* **Education:** PhD or Master’s degree in public policy/political science/international relations/ agriculture/rural development/food systems/public affairs/mass communication/journalism or any other relevant field relevant to food systems transformation.

### **Professional experience**

* At least 10 years of relevant experience in undertaking and leading research, policy engagement, and project management, in one or more of the following areas. Candidates who have prior experience in the following fields will be given a strong preference:
  + Political economy and public policy
  + Working in or with governments, political leadership, or public institutions
  + Agriculture, rural development, or food systems
  + Public affairs, strategic communications, or journalism, with an understanding of how policy, institutions, and narratives shape decision-making
* Ability to navigate diverse stakeholders and strategise systems-level change
* Proven track record in building relationships and coalitions with government, political leadership, and public institutions
* Experience in designing and leading interdisciplinary and inter-programmatic work
* Strong track record of team management and project management, including timely delivery of outputs
* Have demonstrated thought leadership in the areas relevant to the ToR

### **Skills and Competencies**

* Curiosity and an ability to think creatively.
* Willingness to learn new research and project management skills.
* Willingness to travel for field visits and stakeholder interviews (if needed).
* Ability to effectively work in a team while driving research with minimum assistance, when time demands independently.
* Ability to adapt to a new environment and deliver under tight deadlines in a professional environment.
* Striving for rigour in research and quality in work output.
* Ability to dig deeper into details, while also keeping a sense of the broader objectives and big picture.

### **Compensation**

Competitive compensation – commensurate to the experience and matching the best of standards adopted by the industry or other similar organisations for similar roles.

### **Application process**

CEEW is an equal opportunity employer, and the selection process does not discriminate on the basis of age, gender, caste, ethnicity, religion, or sexuality. Female candidates are encouraged to apply.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Interested applicants are advised to apply at the earliest possible. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified by us. We appreciate your interest.

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Lead
jobs.description:
**About us**

Morulaa HealthTech is a Chennai-based, women-led medical device company and part of SaYog Group. We help global medical device manufacturers register, import and sell their products in India, and we act as their importer of record. We are now setting up overseas offices in Dubai and the USA. We need a senior QA/RA professional to own regulatory approvals and quality compliance across our growing portfolio of partner products.

**Role purpose**

The Lead - QA & RA owns the regulatory and quality function end to end. This covers registration strategy and submissions for new partner products in India and selected export markets, keeping our ISO 13485 quality management system audit-ready, and keeping products compliant through their lifecycle. The role works closely with overseas manufacturers, MDLR licensing authorities, the US FDA, notified bodies and our internal sales and operations teams.

**Key responsibilities**

**Regulatory affairs**

* Plan the regulatory strategy and registration roadmap for each new partner product, covering classification, pathway, timelines and documents needed.
* Prepare, review and submit registration, manufacturing and import licence applications under MDLR (Medical Devices Rules, 2017), and track them through to approval.
* Review and compile technical files, Device Master Files, Plant Master Files and STED documents received from overseas manufacturers. Identify gaps and drive remediation.
* Perform gap assessments against EU MDR 2017/745, including GSPR, clinical evaluation, PMS, labelling and IFU (including e-IFU).
* Respond to queries from MDLR licensing authorities, the US FDA, notified bodies and other regulators quickly and accurately.
* Lead US FDA submissions and compliance (510(k)/De Novo, establishment registration and listing, UDI, QMSR), and support other markets as Morulaa expands.
* Manage change notifications, licence renewals and post-approval changes for registered products.
* Track regulatory and standards updates and brief management and the team on what they mean for the business.

**Quality assurance**

* Own and maintain Morulaa's ISO 13485:2016 QMS, including procedures, document control, records and continual improvement.
* Plan and lead internal audits. Host external, customer and partner audits and close findings on time.
* Run complaint handling, non-conformance, CAPA and vigilance/field safety processes, and report adverse events to authorities as required.
* Oversee risk management files in line with ISO 14971.
* Review design and technical documentation (DHF, design verification/validation and labelling) against applicable standards such as IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-1-2, IEC 62366, IEC 62304 and ISO 20417/15223-1.
* Coordinate external testing (biocompatibility, sterilisation, electrical safety, calibration) with accredited labs.
* Conduct Management Review Meetings and report quality KPIs to the Directors.

**Leadership and collaboration**

* Lead, train and mentor QA/RA team members, and build the function as the business grows.
* Act as the regulatory point of contact for overseas manufacturers and partners.
* Work with sales, supply chain and finance so that products are imported, labelled and sold in full compliance.
* Run regular internal training on regulations, QMS and data integrity.

**Qualifications and experience**

**Essential**

* Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy or a related discipline.
* Minimum 7-8 years' experience in medical device regulatory affairs and quality assurance, including at least 2 years in a lead or supervisory role.
* **Core experience must be with a medical device manufacturer.** **The candidate's foundation (typically the first 4-5 years) should be in an in-house QA/RA role at a medical device manufacturing company**, with direct exposure to the shop floor, production QMS, design control, CAPA and regulatory submissions for the company's own products. Later experience at a regulatory consultancy or IT/engineering services firm (e.g. HCL, TCS, Infosys) is acceptable. Profiles whose experience is entirely in consulting or services companies will not be considered.
* Strong hands-on experience with MDLR (Medical Devices Rules, 2017), including manufacturing and import licences, registration dossiers and query handling.
* Strong hands-on experience with US FDA submissions and requirements (510(k)/De Novo, 21 CFR Part 820/QMSR, establishment registration and device listing, UDI, medical device reporting). Strong working knowledge of ISO 13485:2016 and ISO 14971.
* Proven track record of preparing technical files and obtaining product approvals or certifications (for example MDLR licences or FDA clearances).
* Experience with Class II/IIb/III devices.

**Preferred**

* Certified ISO 13485 Lead Auditor.
* Experience with FDA inspections, and with other stringent regulators such as EU MDR (notified bodies), Health Canada, TGA, PMDA or SFDA.
* Additional experience working with overseas manufacturers, or in an importer/distributor or regulatory consulting setting, after a manufacturing foundation.
* Product experience in one or more of these areas: patient monitoring accessories, respiratory devices, dialysis, IVF, cardiovascular or single-use sterile devices.
* Six Sigma Green Belt or similar training in problem-solving.
* Familiarity with PLM or SAP systems.

**Key skills and competencies**

* Regulatory strategy and submission planning
* Technical writing and document review with strong attention to detail
* Analytical, structured problem-solving
* Ability to manage several registrations and deadlines at once
* Clear written and verbal communication with regulators and international partners
* Team leadership and cross-functional collaboration
* Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

**Key performance indicators**

* Registrations and licences obtained on schedule
* First-time-right submissions (few queries and rejections)
* Zero major non-conformities in external audits
* CAPAs and complaints closed within target timelines
* Licences and certificates renewed before expiry, with no lapses

**What we offer**

* A senior role building the QA/RA function at a growing, globally focused, women-led group
* Exposure to a wide range of international products and markets, including our Dubai and US expansion
* Competitive compensation in line with experience

**How to apply**

Send your CV to hr@morulaa.com with the subject line "Lead - QA & RA".

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹500,000.00 per year

Syngenta Crop Protection keeps plants safe from planting to harvesting. From the moment a seed is planted through to harvest, crops need to be protected from weeds, insects and diseases as well as droughts and floods, heat and cold.

Syngenta Crop Protection is headquartered in Switzerland.

The approach should identify key stakeholders (government, research institutes, NGOs, media, investors, academics etc) and their influencers across the region and form the basis for detailed action and engagement plans.
* Support the Head of Corporate Affairs in developing and implementing regional Corporate Affairs strategies, priorities and programs, ensuring effective execution in India and alignment with regional objectives, business priorities and global reputation management frameworks.
* Support external communications and media relations in India in collaboration with appointed PR agencies, including communication planning, media engagement, press releases, media briefings and other external communication materials, ensuring consistency with Syngenta’s corporate positioning and messaging.
* Deliver pro-active reputation management (identification, informing, educating and influencing), particularly with key government stakeholders relevant issues (e.g. technology acceptance, public private partnerships and collaborations, regulatory policy and implementation in concert with regulatory affairs through a “License to Operate” environment) with disciplined and consistent stakeholder management activities including the use of direct engagement and the full array of communication and influence channels – media, public forums, industry groups, speeches and keynotes etc.
* Maintain regular dialogue on key issues with key government, industry and NGO contacts to ensure Syngenta’s position on key issues and our contribution to the management of these issues is well understood and accepted. Ensuring wherever possible the alignment between stakeholder objectives and Syngenta’s own objectives.
* Lead and manage relationships with key State Agriculture stakeholders, including State Agriculture Departments, Agricultural Universities, Research Institutions, and state-level industry bodies, to support business priorities, policy advocacy, and stakeholder engagement objectives.
* Contributes to strengthening the organization’s technical knowledge of the regulatory and policy environment by effectively engaging with government ministries and regulatory authorities, while applying strong technical expertise to interpret and navigate registration requirements, processes, and compliance nuances.

Are you ready to inspire? #MakingWinners #InspireXT #SupplyChainExperts

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Food & Beverage Industry Subject Matter Expert (SME) with 15+ years of industry experience and strong domain expertise in Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), product specification management, packaging development and regulatory compliance.

The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of end-to-end F&B product lifecycle processes, including product development, formulation, ingredient management, raw material specifications, packaging specifications, finished goods, quality management and product commercialization.

The candidate will play a critical role in providing functional and domain expertise for PLM transformation initiatives, helping translate business requirements into scalable digital solutions. The role will involve working closely with business stakeholders, product development teams, R&D, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Packaging, Manufacturing and IT teams.

A sound understanding of global food regulatory frameworks, particularly EU and USA regulations, is essential.

**Key Responsibilities**

PLM & Product Lifecycle Management

  

* Provide subject matter expertise across the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation and product development to commercialization and product maintenance.
* Understand and define PLM processes covering product development, formulation, ingredient management, product specifications, quality and change management.
* Drive standardization of PLM processes, workflows, approval mechanisms and governance across business functions.
* Define business requirements and translate them into functional specifications for PLM platform implementation.
* Support PLM transformation initiatives, process optimization and digitalization programmes.

Product Specification Management

  

* Demonstrate strong expertise in managing product specifications across raw materials, ingredients, intermediates, finished goods and packaging materials.
* Understand specification attributes, technical data, nutritional information, allergen declarations, composition, physical and chemical properties and quality parameters.
* Define and manage specification lifecycle processes, including creation, review, approval, version control and obsolescence.
* Understand specification relationships, hierarchies, inheritance, dependencies and cross functional data requirements.
* Establish governance for specification accuracy, completeness, traceability and data integrity.

Packaging Management

  

* Provide functional expertise in primary, secondary and tertiary packaging processes and specifications.
* Understand packaging materials, structures, dimensions, weights, artwork, labeling, packaging components and material compliance.
* Support packaging development, packaging change management, supplier collaboration and packaging approval processes.
* Understand packaging sustainability, recyclability, material composition and environmental compliance requirements.
* Work with packaging engineering, procurement, quality and regulatory teams to define packaging specifications and associated workflows.

Global Regulatory & Compliance Requirements

  

* Possess a sound understanding of food safety, product labeling, ingredient declarations, packaging compliance and regulatory requirements across global markets.
* Understand supplier declarations, Certificates of Analysis (CoA), Certificates of Compliance (CoC), Statements of Composition and Declarations of Conformity (DoC).
* Work with regulatory teams to ensure product and packaging specifications capture relevant compliance attributes and documentation.
* Familiarity with EU regulatory frameworks, including:

* EU Regulation 178/2002 – General Food Law.
* EU Regulation 1169/2011 – Food Information to Consumers.
* EU Regulation 1935/2004 – Food Contact Materials.
* EU Regulation 10/2011 – Plastic Materials Intended to Come into Contact with Food.
* EU Regulation 2025/40 – Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR).
* REACH and applicable chemical substance compliance requirements.
* Familiarity with USA regulatory frameworks, including:

* FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA).
* FDA 21 CFR requirements applicable to food and food packaging.
* Food allergen labelling requirements under FALCPA and FASTER Act.
* FDA food contact substance requirements.
* Nutrition Facts and ingredient declaration requirements.
* Applicable food packaging and labelling compliance requirements.

Business Process & Stakeholder Management

* Engage with R&D, Product Development, Packaging, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Procurement and Supply Chain stakeholders.
* Conduct business workshops, discovery sessions, process assessments and fit-gap analysis.
* Document AS-IS and TO-BE business processes, functional requirements and process flows.
* Define business rules, approval workflows, roles and responsibilities.
* Support solution demonstrations, functional validation, UAT and business acceptance.
* Act as the domain bridge between business stakeholders and technology implementation teams.

PLM Platform Implementation & Transformation

  

* Provide functional leadership during PLM platform implementation and transformation programmes.
* Support configuration of product, ingredient, specification, packaging and regulatory management capabilities.
* Define functional requirements for data migration, integrations and reporting.
* Support product data governance, master data management and specification harmonization.
* Participate in solution design reviews, sprint planning, testing, defect resolution and deployment.
* Support user training, change management and post-implementation stabilization.

**Key Deliverables**

  

* Business process assessment and AS-IS / TO-BE documentation.
* Functional requirements and PLM solution design inputs.
* Product, ingredient, raw material and finished goods specification models.
* Packaging specification and lifecycle management processes.
* Regulatory and compliance requirement mapping for EU and USA markets.
* Functional workflows, approval processes and change management definitions.

Profile Requirements

jobs.description:
**Operations Manager Life Sciences Research**

  

**PROFILE SUMMARY:**

  

* **We are looking for an Operations Manager to lead and manage a team of 180+ life-science researchers and quality control (QC) professionals who build and maintain a curated intelligence database of drugs, clinical trials, deals and companies for a leading global pharma intelligence platform.** The database is organised into therapeutic-area, modality and target/pathway modules, providing pharma and biotech clients with in-depth insights into their competitive landscape.
* As Operations Manager, you will own the end-to-end delivery and operational performance of the Life Sciences Division across 20+ modules, covering the maintenance of live modules and the development of new ones. You will be accountable for service levels, scientific integrity and data quality, workforce planning, resource utilisation, people development and the client relationship.
* This role reports to the Principal Head of the Life Sciences Division and combines operational leadership with strong therapeutic-area and drug-development expertise. **The primary focus is managing people, processes, quality, delivery and client relationships, with scientific oversight provided in partnership with subject matter experts.** **You will lead through the divisions management team and translate scientific and business requirements into scalable, high-quality research operations.**

  

**THE WORK - WHAT OUR TEAMS DO:**

  

* This work sits within a secondary, desk-based clinical research function. We do not run trials, recruit patients, monitor sites or handle patient-level data. Instead, our teams systematically identify, appraise, extract and structure publicly available clinical and preclinical evidence into decision-grade datasets that global pharma and biotech companies use to benchmark their pipelines.
* Each module runs to a documented scope with formal inclusion and exclusion criteria. The work begins with SOP-driven surveillance of trial registries, scientific literature, conference disclosures, company pipelines, press releases and regulatory announcements. Each drug, trial, deal or company is then screened against the module's scope criteria. Our teams extract detailed trial-level data (design, arms, endpoints, eligibility, subgroup results, milestones) and drug-level data (developers, targets, mechanism of action, therapeutic class, formulation, delivery, CMC and preclinical pharmacology). Records are classified against proprietary ontologies and maintained under defined version-control and governance rules, with internal QA, error-trend analysis and ongoing scope calibration.
* Our portfolio spans 20+ modules including Oncology, Neuroscience, Cardiovascular-Renal-Metabolic, Immunology, Inflammation, Autoimmune, Cell Therapy, Cancer Vaccines, Oncolytic Viruses, Checkpoint, DNA Damage Response, Antibody Drug Conjugates, Bispecific, Targeted Protein Degradation, Microbiome, Cytokine, RNA, Gene Therapy etc.

  

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES / RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, scientific rigour, continuous learning and professional conduct.**

  

**Delivery Management**

  

* **Own end-to-end delivery across the divisions module portfolio, meeting agreed volumes, turnaround times, coverage and service level agreements (SLAs).**
* Develop annual and quarterly operational plans aligned with client priorities and company objectives; translate these into delivery targets, capacity forecasts and resource plans.
* Oversee recurring surveillance, module maintenance, new module builds and priority projects; **intervene early when performance, timelines or delivery commitments are at risk.**
* Manage resource allocation, cross-team dependencies, workload distribution and hand-offs between research and QC teams.
* Manage the divisions headcount and resource utilisation in line with approved budget and plans; identify cost efficiencies without compromising quality or delivery.
* Own operational risk management, escalation protocols and business continuity planning, including contingencies for staffing and peak workloads.

  

**Quality Assurance, SOP Governance & Compliance**

  

* **Own division-wide quality performance and ensure consistent adherence to agreed accuracy, completeness, consistency and relevancy benchmarks.**
* **Oversee the QC governance framework, including sampling, audits, error escalation and the effectiveness of quality checks across teams.**
* **Review client feedback and quality trends; drive root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, targeted training and follow-up to verify sustained improvement.**
* **Govern SOPs, process documentation**, publication controls and version control; ensure consistent implementation of agreed changes across modules.
* Ensure adherence to client and company requirements for information security, data protection, confidentiality and operational compliance.

  

**Client & Stakeholder Management**

  

* Support the Principal Head in managing operational relationships with international client stakeholders, addressing escalations related to delivery, quality, resources and operational issues, and ensuring timely resolution and follow-through.
* Support the Principal Head in conducting client governance meetings, business reviews and planning discussions by preparing and presenting operational performance updates, delivery forecasts, risks and improvement plans.
* **Proactively manage stakeholder expectations, communicate material changes and risks, and ensure that commitments and agreed actions are tracked to closure.**

* **Resolve escalated client concerns through timely communication, evidence-based analysis and corrective action; strengthen the long-term client relationship.**
* **Partner with senior management and relevant internal functions to support business growth, assess new opportunities and plan resources for scaling delivery.**

  

**Process Improvement**

  

* Lead division-wide improvements to remove bottlenecks, increase productivity, reduce rework and improve delivery predictability without compromising scientific quality.
* Define operational KPIs covering productivity, quality, turnaround, backlog, rework, capacity and utilisation; establish review mechanisms and drive action against performance gaps.
* Identify, evaluate and oversee adoption of AI-assisted workflows and automation with appropriate human review, scientific validation and data quality controls.
* Standardise best practices across modules, measure the impact of process changes and scale successful improvements across the division.

The QIMA and EFRAC Story

Operating in over 100 countries, we serve the consumer products, food, and life sciences industries and help more than 30,000 brands, retailers, manufacturers, and growers achieve quality excellence.
  
  
EFRAC, part of QIMA group is a laboratory testing services company focusing on food safety, pharmaceutical quality control, and environmental monitoring.
  
  
What sets us apart is our unique culture. Our 5,000 Qimates live and make decisions every day by our QIMA Values. With client passion, integrity, and a commitment to making things simple, we disrupted the Testing, Inspection, and Certification industry. Are you ready to hop on this exciting ride with us and help us achieve our mission?
  
  
**Job Description**
The Role in Brief
  
  
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented ISO 22000 Auditor to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for conducting audits of food safety management systems in accordance with ISO 22000 standards. This role requires a comprehensive understanding of food safety principles, risk management, and the ability to assess compliance effectively.
  
  
**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include**

* Perform comprehensive audits of food safety management systems (FSMS) in accordance with ISO 22000 standards.
* Assess documentation, including food safety policies, procedures, and records, to ensure compliance with ISO requirements.
* Analyze the effectiveness of the FSMS, including hazard analysis and critical control points (HACCP), to identify potential risks.
* Detect areas of non-compliance or weaknesses in the FSMS and provide recommendations for corrective actions.
* If applicable, oversee the collection of samples for testing to verify compliance with safety standards.
* Prepare detailed audit reports summarizing findings, observations, and recommendations for improvements.

**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Develop and implement audit plans for ISO 22000 compliance.
* Conduct thorough audits of food safety management systems, assessing processes, procedures, and documentation.
* Prepare detailed audit reports that highlight findings, non-conformities, and areas for improvement.
* Maintain accurate and organized records of all audit activities and compliance assessments.
* Collaborate with food business operators and staff to enhance understanding of ISO 22000 standards.
* Provide recommendations and support for corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Stay informed about industry trends and changes in regulations to ensure compliance with ISO 22000 standards.
* Recommend enhancements to audit processes and tools to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
* Engage in ongoing professional education to remain current with ISO standards and food safety practices.
* Attend relevant workshops, training sessions, and industry conferences.

Profile Requirements
  
  
**To Succeed In This Role, You Have**

* A food-related or bioscience degree (minimum a bachelor’s degree or equivalent) OR Atleast a successfully completed food-related professional higher education.
* At least 2 years of work experience in food industry
* A minimum of two (2) year work experience, which may include consulting activities, in food safety and/or quality management within the food industry sector OR at least 5 (10 man-days) third-party or second-party audits that includes HACCP, QMS and Food Safety requirements.
* HACCP course (minimum 16 hours) recognized by the International HACCP Alliance; and ISO 22000:2018 course (minimum of 16 hours) + Lead Auditor course (on QMS) of 40 hours of duration including the exam. OR Lead Auditor Course (FSMS (ISO 22000 or FSSC 22000) of 40 hours of duration including the exam.
* Minimum: 20 days as auditor of Quality Management Systems, Food Safety Management Systems or other Food Safety Standards (i.e. GFSI).
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

* Check raw material quality, freshness, specifications and supplier COAs.
* Conduct physical, chemical and sensory inspections.
* Monitor milk quality parameters, including fat, SNF, acidity and adulteration.
* Identify and segregate rejected or non-conforming raw materials.
* Maintain incoming material inspection records.

2. In-Process Quality Control – Dairy Products

* Monitor quality during the manufacturing of milk, paneer, curd, yoghurt, ghee, butter, khoa and other dairy products.
* Monitor pasteurisation temperature and holding time.
* Check milk fat, SNF, acidity, pH and moisture.
* Monitor coagulation, fermentation, cooling and processing parameters.
* Ensure product consistency, texture, colour and taste.
* Monitor chilling, cold storage and hygienic handling practices.

3. In-Process Quality Control – Indian Sweets

* Monitor quality during the manufacturing of Rasgulla, Rasmalai, Gulab Jamun, Kaju Katli, Barfi, Peda, Kalakand, Milk Cake, Besan Laddu, Motichoor Laddu and other traditional sweets.
* Monitor sugar syrup concentration using a refractometer (Brix).
* Check cooking temperature and processing time.
* Monitor moisture, texture, colour, taste and consistency.
* Check frying temperature and frying oil quality.
* Ensure uniformity in product size, weight, shape and appearance.
* Monitor cooling, handling and storage conditions.

4. Finished Product Quality Inspection

* Conduct final quality inspections before product release.
* Perform sensory evaluation for appearance, colour, taste, aroma and texture.
* Check product weight, moisture, pH, acidity, fat and Brix wherever applicable.
* Verify packaging quality, sealing and product labelling.
* Monitor batch number, manufacturing date and expiry date.
* Coordinate microbiological testing.
* Ensure finished products meet approved quality specifications.

5. Food Safety, Hygiene & Sanitation

* Ensure compliance with FSSAI regulations and applicable food safety requirements.
* Monitor personal hygiene and food handling practices of production employees.
* Conduct regular production-floor hygiene inspections.
* Ensure proper cleaning and sanitation of equipment, utensils, processing areas and machinery.
* Monitor pest control, waste disposal and water quality.
* Prevent cross-contamination and allergen contamination.
* Verify cleaning and sanitation records.

6. Food Safety Management Systems

* Implement and monitor HACCP-based food safety systems.
* Ensure compliance with GMP, GHP and SSOP.
* Support implementation and maintenance of ISO 22000 standards.
* Identify potential biological, chemical and physical hazards.
* Monitor Critical Control Points (CCPs) and applicable OPRPs.
* Maintain food safety monitoring and verification records.
* Ensure calibration of laboratory and quality inspection instruments.

7. Laboratory Testing & Analysis

* Perform routine physical and chemical testing of raw materials and finished products.
* Conduct milk testing for fat, SNF, acidity and adulteration.
* Perform moisture, pH, acidity and Brix analysis.
* Monitor frying oil quality and deterioration.
* Coordinate microbiological testing, including total plate count, yeast and mould, coliforms and other applicable parameters.
* Maintain laboratory records and test reports.
* Coordinate external laboratory testing when required.

8. Quality Audits & Documentation

* Conduct daily quality inspections and internal hygiene audits.
* Identify non-conformities and process deviations.
* Perform root cause analysis using 5 Why and Fishbone techniques.
* Implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).
* Maintain raw material inspection reports, production quality records, CCP monitoring sheets, laboratory reports, cleaning records and audit documentation.
* Support internal, external, FSSAI and customer audits.
* Maintain product traceability and recall-related records.

9. Coordination with Production & Operations

* Coordinate with production teams to maintain consistent product quality.
* Identify and resolve quality issues during manufacturing.
* Communicate deviations and recommend corrective measures.
* Coordinate with procurement, warehouse and operations teams.
* Monitor customer complaints, product rejections and quality improvement activities.
* Conduct food safety and hygiene awareness training for production employees.

Required Skills & Technical Knowledge

* Strong knowledge of FSSAI regulations and food safety standards.
* Practical knowledge of dairy processing and Indian sweets manufacturing.
* Hands-on experience in HACCP, GMP, GHP, SSOP and ISO 22000.
* Knowledge of milk testing, including fat, SNF, acidity and adulteration.
