jobs.description:
Food Safety & Production Supervisor

**Company:** Amadora Gourmet Ice Cream Pvt Ltd **Location:** Velachery Central Kitchen, Chennai **Reports to:** Head of Operations **Type:** Full-time, on-site (factory-based, with periodic store visits) **Apply to:** jobs@amadora.in

About Amadora

Amadora makes premium artisanal ice cream, baked goods, sauces, bars and cakes from scratch — no premixes, no compounds. Everything is produced at our central kitchen in Chennai on Pastomaster and Carpigiani equipment and distributed to franchise and company-owned stores across Chennai, Bengaluru and Hyderabad. As we scale, the discipline of the factory floor is what protects the brand.

The Role

We are looking for a food technologist who has worked as a Food Safety Executive and is ready to own both sides of the floor: making sure production runs the way the process says it should, and making sure food safety norms are followed without exception, every single day.

This is a hands-on shop-floor role, not a desk role. You will be present during production, checking that steps are followed as written, catching deviations while they are still small, and holding the line on hygiene, traceability and equipment condition. Alongside the daily work, you will drive our ISO certification programme and partner with the Training team to take food safety standards out to the stores.

Key Responsibilities

1. Daily production supervision

* Verify that every batch is produced to the approved recipe, sequence, temperature and time parameters — pasteurisation, ageing, batch freezing, blast freezing, hardening and packing.
* Run and sign off start-of-shift, in-process and end-of-shift checks; ensure line clearance between batches and between allergen and non-allergen runs.
* Check equipment and tooling condition before use — moulds, scoops, containers, gaskets, blades — and enforce immediate quarantine and physical removal of any damaged, chipped or worn item from the production area.
* Monitor CCPs and record readings in real time; escalate deviations immediately rather than at end of day.
* Verify raw material and packaging at receipt (COA, temperature, condition, shelf life) and enforce FEFO in cold rooms and dry stores.
* Support the production plan — yields, batch sizing, changeover time, wastage — and flag where process adherence and output targets are in conflict.

2. Food safety and hygiene compliance

* Own day-to-day implementation of HACCP, GMP and GHP across the facility.
* Manage personal hygiene, health checks, gowning and handwashing compliance for all production staff.
* Schedule and verify cleaning and sanitation (CIP and manual), pest control, water testing, swab testing and calibration; maintain the records.
* Run the foreign-material control programme: metal, glass, hard plastic, wood and mould-fragment controls, with defined inspection and breakage procedures.
* Manage the finished-goods and shelf-life testing programme, micro sampling and third-party lab coordination.
* Maintain FSSAI licence conditions and Schedule 4 compliance; be the point person for FSSAI and customer audits.
* Investigate customer complaints and internal non-conformances to root cause, define CAPA, and verify that the corrective action actually holds a month later.
* Maintain full batch traceability and be able to run a mock recall to closure.

3. ISO / FSSC certification

* Lead preparation for ISO 22000:2018 (and FSSC 22000 where applicable) — gap assessment, documentation, PRPs, HACCP plan, internal audits, management review and closure of certification body findings.
* Build and maintain the food safety management system documentation: manual, procedures, formats, records.
* Train and hand-hold the production team through the changes the certification requires, so the system survives after the certificate is issued.

4. Store food safety, with the Training team

* Work with the Head of Training to convert factory food safety standards into simple, teachable store-level procedures — cold chain, thawing, display, scooping hygiene, cleaning schedules, expiry management, allergen handling.
* Co-create training content, checklists and audit formats for franchise and company-owned stores.
* Conduct periodic store food safety audits, score them, and drive closure of findings with the operations and training teams.
* Support franchisee-side FSSAI compliance and readiness for regulatory inspections.

5. Documentation and reporting

* Maintain daily, weekly and monthly food safety and production compliance dashboards.
* Report non-conformances, wastage, complaint trends and audit scores to management with clear cause and action.

Qualifications and Competencies

**Required**

* B.Tech / M.Tech / B.Sc / M.Sc in Food Technology, Food Science, Dairy Technology or a related discipline.
* 3–6 years of experience, including a proven stint as a Food Safety Executive or Officer in a food manufacturing environment.
* Working knowledge of HACCP, GMP, GHP, FSSAI regulations and Schedule 4.
* Experience preparing for or maintaining ISO 22000 / FSSC 22000 certification.
* Comfortable with documentation and record discipline — you can build a format, and you can also make people fill it correctly.
* Physically comfortable working in a cold-chain environment, including chillers and blast freezers, and around early production shifts.

**Preferred**

* Dairy, frozen dessert, bakery or chocolate manufacturing background.
* Certified HACCP Level 3 / ISO 22000 Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor.
* Multi-site or retail-outlet audit exposure.
* Working Tamil and English; Kannada or Telugu a bonus given our other markets.

**Competencies we care about**

* Willingness to stop a batch. The right answer is sometimes expensive, and we want someone who says it anyway.
* Firm without being adversarial — you will be enforcing standards on colleagues you work beside every day.
* Bias for root cause over blame; interest in why the process allowed the mistake, not just who made it.
* Attention to detail that holds up on day 200, not just day 20.

What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)

* **Month 1–3:** You have mapped every production line end to end, documented the actual process against the written SOP, and produced a prioritised gap list covering process adherence, hygiene, equipment condition and record-keeping.
* **Month 3–4:** Daily production and food safety checks are running consistently across all shifts, with real-time recording and same-day escalation of deviations — verified by you, not self-reported.
* **Month 6:** The ISO 22000 documentation set is complete, PRPs and the HACCP plan are implemented, and the first full internal audit cycle has been completed with CAPAs closed.
* **Month 6–9:** A store food safety standard, training module and audit checklist are live with the Training team, and the first round of audits is complete across Chennai stores.
* **Month 9–12:** ISO certification audit cleared, with no major non-conformances outstanding.
* **Through the year:** A measurable fall in food-safety-related customer complaints and internal non-conformances, with a traceability and mock-recall capability that closes within the target window.

Why Amadora

You will be the person who owns food safety at a brand that makes everything from scratch — which means real process, real risk and real ownership, not a premix line where the standards were set by someone else. You will build the system, certify it, and take it out to every store. Direct access to the founder and the leadership team, and a company growing fast enough that what you build now becomes how it operates at three times the size.

Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

**Position Overview:**

This position involves developing innovative food and beverage products with a specific focus on food formulation and microencapsulation technologies. The role includes developing and optimising food formulations, working with microencapsulated ingredients, evaluating encapsulation techniques, and improving ingredient stability, functionality, solubility, dispersibility and controlled release properties in food applications.

The candidate will be responsible for executing laboratory-scale trials, ingredient selection, formulation optimisation, product testing and supporting the scale-up and commercialisation of new products. The role also involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to translate innovative ingredient technologies into commercially viable food products.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop, optimise and validate food and beverage formulations based on product requirements and application needs.
* Work on microencapsulation of functional food ingredients, including flavours, colours, vitamins, minerals, oils, probiotics and other bioactive ingredients.
* Explore and work with microencapsulation techniques such as spray drying, coacervation, emulsification and other relevant encapsulation technologies.
* Identify and evaluate suitable core materials, wall materials, carriers and encapsulating agents for different food applications.
* Conduct laboratory-scale experiments and optimise formulation and process parameters to improve encapsulation efficiency, stability and product performance.
* Evaluate the physicochemical properties of encapsulated ingredients, including particle size, moisture content, solubility, dispersibility, encapsulation efficiency and stability, wherever applicable.
* Incorporate microencapsulated ingredients into different food matrices and evaluate their functionality, compatibility and performance.
* Conduct ingredient calculations, proximate analysis, sensory evaluation and shelf-life studies.
* Evaluate and select suitable wall materials and carrier materials based on ingredient compatibility, encapsulation efficiency, stability and intended food application.
* Develop and optimise formulations based on food safety, regulatory requirements, quality standards and commercial feasibility.
* Coordinate with R&D, quality, production and other cross-functional teams for product trials, process optimisation and scale-up.
* Maintain experimental records, prepare technical reports and document product development activities.
* Stay updated on emerging encapsulation technologies, functional ingredients and innovations in food science.

**Qualifications:**  
Master’s or Ph.D. in Food Science, Food Technology, Food Engineering, Dairy Technology, Culinary Arts, or related field

**Responsibility and Decision-Making Authority:**  
Empowered to make project and cross-functional decisions in partnership with peers.

**Experience:**  
Minimum 1–3 years of relevant experience in food product development, food formulation or applied food science R&D, with at least 1 year of hands-on experience in microencapsulation technology, encapsulated ingredient development or application of microencapsulated ingredients in food formulations.

Hands-on experience in spray drying, coacervation, emulsion-based encapsulation or application of microencapsulated ingredients in food products will be preferred.

jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
For 115 years, L’Oréal, the world’s leading beauty player, has devoted itself to one thing only: fulfilling the beauty aspirations of consumers around the world. With our broad portfolio of 37 international brands and ambitious sustainability commitments in our L’Oréal for the Future program, we offer every person around the world the best in terms of quality, efficacy, safety, sincerity and responsibility, while celebrating beauty in its infinite plurality. Present in India since 1994, L'Oréal India is a 100% subsidiary of L'Oréal S.A.
  
  
Today, L'Oréal India is present on all distribution channels with 27 brands, available in consumer channels (L'Oréal Paris, Garnier, Maybelline New York, NYX Professional Makeup); in hair and beauty salons (L'Oréal Professionnel, Matrix, Kérastase, Redken); in selective distribution (Kiehl's, Lancôme, Yves Saint Laurent), CeraVe and La Roche-Posay in pharmacies and drugstores, and perfumes and make-up sold through L'Oréal International Distribution (Armani, Prada, Valentino, Ralph Lauren, Diesel, Victor & Rolf, Mugler, Azzaro, Maison Margiela, Cacharel, Guy Laroche, Urban Decay, Paloma Picasso, Youth To The People).
  
  
L'Oréal India employs more than 1,800 people in its head office in Mumbai, four regional offices, two production plants in Chakan (Maharashtra) and Baddi (Himachal Pradesh), two Research and Innovation centers in Mumbai (Maharashtra) and Bengaluru (Karnataka) and one India Technology Hub in Hyderabad. In India, L'Oréal's Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiatives are built around three pillars: empowerment, environment and education. In addition to the group's CSR commitments, L'Oréal's brands (L'Oréal Paris, Garnier, Maybelline New York, Kérastase, Matrix, L'Oréal Professionnel) are also leading community impact initiatives in India.
  
  
**A Day in the Life**
As an experienced professional, you will shape our scientific agenda, pilot strategic platforms, and mentor talent within an entrepreneurial environment where curiosity drives discovery.
  
  
In Research & Innovation, we combine over a century of scientific expertise with cutting-edge technology. Backed by our global community of over 4,000 researchers across 20 research centres, we invent sustainable, high-performance beauty rituals that move the world.
  
  
As our Senior Hair Colour Formulation Scientist, you will spearhead the design and development of breakthrough hair colour technologies, reporting to the Formulation Laboratory Manager. You will turn cutting-edge chemistry into visible, high-performance beauty experiences.

jobs.description:
**NULO IS:**

We are the fastest-growing U.S. pet food specialty brand and have recently begun our European expansion with major retail listings across Italy, Spain and the UK. We were named “Top 25 Most Innovative Consumer Brands” by Forbes Magazine, offering industry-leading dog and cat food products with a world-class sales team, in a multi-billion-dollar industry that’s ripe for innovation and change. Imagine inspiring pet parents to think differently about the experience of feeding their dogs and cats, to feed them like the little athletes they are - with foods high in meat protein, low in carbs and infused with viable probiotics. To learn more visit www.nulo.co.uk

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

After entering the market in late 2025, Nulo is entering an exciting phase of European growth - building our presence across existing markets while preparing to expand into a number of major new markets from 2027 onwards.

As Brand Manager Europe, you will play a central role in building Nulo into a distinctive, relevant and commercially successful brand across Europe, with primary responsibility for the UK, Spain and other key markets. Working closely with the Head of Marketing, local Marketing Managers, as well as wider European and global brand/commercial teams, you will translate Nulo’s global brand strategy into key European growth markets, driving the short and long-term success of the brand in Europe.

This is a hands-on brand management role with ownership across annual brand planning, marketing campaigns, consumer insight, brand health, proposition development and commercial performance. You will be the guardian of Nulo’s brand positioning and distinctive assets, developing and delivering the brand strategies and activation plans needed to drive sustainable growth in each market.

Fluent English and Spanish are essential with additional European languages useful. Frequent European travel is expected.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**

* **Own the Annual Brand Marketing Plan –** working closely with the European Head of Marketing, create and deliver the annual marketing plan in key priority markets, aligned to commercial priorities and long-term brand strategy
* **Lead Consumer Communications –** adapt and deliver compelling, locally relevant communications across paid, owned and earned channels
* **Build & Optimise the Nulo Demand Generation Engine –** working with the wider marketing team, develop and own a full-funnel demand generation programme that drives brand awareness, consideration and trial to recruit consumers at scale
* **Develop Consumer & Category Insight** - build a deep understanding of consumers, category dynamics, competitors and emerging trends, converting insight into clear actions for the brand and portfolio.
* **Drive Brand Health & Performance** - track brand, category and commercial performance across priority markets, identifying growth opportunities and actions to improve awareness, consideration and trial, driving brand penetration and equity.
* **Shape Local Brand Positioning** - act as a guardian of Nulo’s positioning, distinctive assets and brand codes, ensuring global consistency is combined with local relevance
* **Portfolio Strategy & Innovation** - Lead on product lifecycle including performance analysis, opportunity identification, working with global teams on innovation and renovation
* **Lead Integrated Brand Campaign Development** - work with local & global teams and agency partners to develop and execute local campaigns.
* **360 Customer Planning** – lead development and execution of joint customer marketing plans.
* **Support Pricing & Portfolio Architecture** - partner with Commercial and Finance to inform pricing, pack architecture, promotional strategy and portfolio choices that support brand equity and profitable growth.
* **Brand P&L management** - manage and report on full brand P&L including managing brand investment, setting priorities and evaluating activity effectiveness
* **Agency & Partner Management** - lead relevant agency and specialist partner relationships, setting clear briefs and ensuring high-quality, on-brand delivery against timings and budgets.
* **Cross-functional Brand Leadership** - act as a key connector across Marketing, Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, Regulatory and Global Teams to align priorities and deliver key initiatives

  

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

**Essential Experience & Skills**

* 5+ years of brand management or marketing experience in FMCG, food, pet, or a related consumer-goods sector.
* Strong experience developing annual brand plans and translating consumer and commercial insight into clear growth strategies.
* Strong analytical capability with experience using consumer, category and commercial data to identify opportunities and measure performance.
* Commercial mindset with an understanding of pricing, promotional strategy, portfolio architecture and brand P&L drivers.
* Experience developing integrated campaigns and working across the full funnel
* Demonstrable experience working with key customers including joint business planning and shopper activations.
* Strong agency and cross-functional stakeholder management experience.
* Excellent communication, presentation and influencing skills, with the ability to turn strategy into clear direction for others.
* Budget management experience and a strong focus on investment effectiveness.
* Fluent English and Spanish.

**Desirable Experience & Skills**

* Experience working across multiple European markets.
* Experience managing a portfolio, including innovation / NPD, renovation, proposition development and product launches.
* Experience within pet food, pet care, food, beverage or another premium FMCG category.
* Additional European languages are a plus.

**WHO YOU ARE:**

* **Brand Builder** - you care deeply about what makes brands distinctive and know how to build equity consistently over time.
* **Consumer Obsessed** - you are curious about people, culture and behaviour and use insight to inform brand strategy.
* **Commercially minded** – you are comfortable converting business objectives into marketing objectives and strategies
* **Analytical** - you are comfortable with data and use it to diagnose performance, challenge assumptions and make clear recommendations.
* **Hands-on** - you are equally comfortable shaping strategy, reviewing packaging, building a business case, briefing an agency and preparing a customer story.
* **Entrepreneurial** - you are a self-starter who thrives in a growing organisation where not every process or answer already exists.
* **Collaborative** - you build strong relationships across functions, markets and external partners
* **Fast & Pragmatic** - you maintain high standards without sacrificing pace of execution in the pursuit of perfection.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL GET:**

* Competitive salary and benefits, in line with the local market and experience.
* Full-time, permanent contract.
* Travel costs covered in line with company policy.

**Location**

This is a full-time, mostly remote position, with frequent European travel. We need this person to be willing to travel frequently around Europe.

**Salary Range:** €45K - €55K

**Ready to take on the challenge and have a little fun while doing it? We’d love to hear from you!**

We do not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, or any other status protected under applicable law.

jobs.title: R&D and Innovation Packaging Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**
At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
  
  
**Summary:**
The R&D and Innovation Packaging Manager builds and leads a new pre-development and innovation capability within Product Operations. This role develops, pilots and proves packs, platforms and technologies before the brief, for launches two to three years ahead, so launch teams start from proven solutions instead of discovering risks late. It turns technical scouting, regulatory change such as the EU PPWR, and recurring quality issues into tested, ready-to-use solutions handed over to Packaging Development.
  
  
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
:
  
  
**R&D Strategy & Portfolio**

* Build the packaging R&D roadmap for Y+2 and Y+3 launches from the Brand roadmap, consumer and retailer feedback, quality issues, COPQ and technical scouting.
* Select topics that help launches, fix what customers feel, make us different and can be ready in time.
* Manage the R&D portfolio, budget and timelines; stop topics that no longer create value.

**Platforms & Technology**

* Pre-develop functionally proven platforms in key categories (e.g., closures, applicators, mascara, gloss, compacts, pumps, airless).
* Run pilot molds, functional and compatibility tests on our formulas, then homologate with Quality.
* Prove supplier standard packs on our formulas before they are used in launches.
* Build and maintain the Packs Library: proven platforms and standards, with design rules and test files.

**Advanced Development & Innovation**

* Scout new materials, mechanisms, suppliers and manufacturing technologies in line with the roadmap.
* Take ideas to feasible concepts and prototypes, with early risk assessment and filling and assembly implications.
* Assess supplier technical and innovation capability; Procurement leads commercial terms.
* Document new technologies and flag intellectual property opportunities to Legal.

**PPWR & Sustainable Design**

* Translate PPWR design requirements (recyclability, recycled content, minimisation) into design rules, materials and platforms, with Regulatory owning the interpretation.
* Qualify recyclable, mono-material and recycled-content solutions on our formulas, for function and compatibility.
* Build PPWR-ready options into the Packs Library and the materials library for Y+2 and Y+3 launches.
* Track delegated and implementing acts with Regulatory, and update standards when they change.
* Provide technical evidence for conformity documentation; conformity sign-off for each launch sits outside R&D.

**Kaizen & Product Performance**

* Use complaints, reviews, quality trends and COPQ to target issues that repeat across products.
* Develop and test permanent improvements in application, dosing, closing, comfort and robustness.
* Turn each proven fix into updated specifications, design rules and standards

**Handover & Governance**

* Define readiness criteria for handover to Packaging Development: function proven, compatibility tested, homologated and documented.
* Hand over only proven solutions, and support the first launches that use them.
* Use our specification tool and the risk score at R&D stage, in proportion to novelty.
* Protect R&D capacity: support live launches through agreed handovers only, and escalate any trade-off to the Director.

**Leadership and Coaching**

* Build, lead and develop a small R&D team of packaging engineers and technical design support.
* Manage external partners: designers, prototyping houses, test labs and technology partners.
* Build a culture of curiosity, rigor and evidence.

**Cross-Functional Partnership & Strategic Exposure**

* Partner with Product Development, Marketing, Design, Quality, Packaging Development, Procurement and Regulatory.
* Present the R&D pipeline, business cases and recommendations to leadership.
* Build long-term technical partnerships with innovative suppliers.

**Requirements**

* Proven record of taking new packaging concepts or technologies from prototype to industrial launch.
* Hands-on experience of pilot tooling, functional testing and formula/pack compatibility.
* Strong knowledge of materials, mechanisms and processes (injection, blow molding, assembly, decoration).
* Experience building platforms, standards or design rules used by development teams.
* Working knowledge of the EU PPWR and design-for-recycling guidelines (e.g., RecyClass).
* Network of innovative packaging suppliers and technology partners in Europe and Asia.
* Track record of building business cases and prioritizing with clear criteria.
* Able to review CAD models; experience with 3D printing and rapid prototyping.
* Track record of building a new function from scratch, with a curious, rigorous and evidence-based approach.
* 8+ years in packaging development, including significant pre-development or innovation experience in beauty, fragrance or luxury.
* Bachelor's/Master's in Packaging, Mechanical, Materials or Plastics Engineering, or Industrial Design.

**Benefits**

* Monthly "Self Love Days" - at company discretion
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting

*Huda Beauty is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*

jobs.title: Venture Builder (General Manager) - F&B

jobs.description:
**Note: OVI is hiring on behalf of a confidential client. This role is not with OVI.**

  

**Venture Builder (General Manager)**

  

Abu Dhabi, UAE (On-site) | Full-time | Reporting to the Owner
  
Develop and grow an established healthy food brand to market leadership.

  

**Role purpose**

  

Take full ownership of an established healthy café and grab-and-go brand in Abu Dhabi and build it into a profitable, scalable business. You will run it as your own: first fix, then grow.
  
In the first phase you professionalise operations, restructure the menu and central kitchen workflows, and bring every outlet to strong unit economics. In the second you build what comes next: new revenue streams, a sharper concept and a model that is ready to multiply.
  
This is a role for a builder. You get a brand customers already know, a central kitchen, three locations, a team, and the freedom to decide.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

Operational leadership

  

• Build and implement scalable SOPs across the outlets and the central kitchen.
  
• Introduce KPI-based performance management and weekly operating routines.
  
• Improve labour scheduling, cost-of-goods discipline, waste control and speed of service.
  
• Simplify and standardise workflows, menu and ingredient use.
  
Turnaround and unit economics
  
• Remove operational bottlenecks and improve unit economics at the existing outlets.
  
• Deliver profitability at outlet and company level within a defined timeframe.
  
• Optimise the central kitchen and put its spare capacity to work.
  
P&L ownership
  
• Full responsibility for financial performance across all outlets and channels.
  
• Build reporting dashboards and operational transparency.
  
• Maintain budget discipline on operating and capital expenditure.
  
Growth and venture building
  
• Identify, test and launch new revenue streams, for example corporate catering, smart fridges, wholesale and subscriptions.
  
• Develop the next version of the concept: menu, pricing, format and customer experience.
  
• Build the business case and the operating model for expansion.
  
Team leadership
  
• Lead and develop the chef, the central kitchen team and the outlet teams.
  
• Hire and grow the key people a larger business will need.
  
• Build a culture of performance and accountability.

  

**Candidate profile**

  

Core experience

  

• 7+ years in F&B operations or high-growth ventures, including several in a leadership role.
  
• Proven multi-unit experience and full ownership of a P&L.
  
• Turnaround experience: you have fixed a struggling unit, business or system.
  
• Strong exposure to the GCC market; UAE experience required.
  
• Background in fast-casual/healthy food groups (e.g. Joe & the Juice, Pinza, Wild & the Moon, SALT), cloud/central kitchen operators (e.g. Kitopi, Kaykroo, Deliveroo Editions, Sweetheart Kitchen), or fast-growing food start-ups/venture building as a founder or early leader.
  
Operational skill set
  
• Playbook builder: SOPs, training, checklists and productivity systems.
  
• Central kitchen workflows, food preparation, yield and cross-utilisation of ingredients.
  
• Deep understanding of unit economics and F&B KPI dashboards.
  
• High-throughput formats: bowls, salads, smoothies, coffee, grab-and-go.
  
• Hands-on approach. This is not a corporate management role.
  
Leadership & personality fit
  
• Founder-like ownership: you treat the business and its money as your own.
  
• Structured, disciplined, fast in execution, decisive under pressure, high accountability, low ego, not political or hierarchical.
  
• Enjoys building, not maintaining.

  

**Why this role**

  

• Lead the transformation of an established brand and build its next chapter.
  
• Real autonomy: direct line to the owner and full decision-making authority.
  
• High-execution role where results are visible from the first month, with pay that grows with performance.

jobs.title: Project Lead

The Project Lead runs JOMARA's new product development (NPD) and commercial execution projects from first idea to delivery on shelf. You will own the plan for every new product, new and seasonal packaging, supermarket planograms and trade show participation. You will coordinate internal teams, suppliers and retail partners so every launch lands on time, on budget and to JOMARA's premium standard.

**Key Accountabilities:**

New Product Development (NPD)

**Packaging Development (new and seasonal)**

* Manage new packaging and redesign projects from brief to delivered stock: agency briefing, artwork, proofs, approvals, printing and supplier lead times.
* Plan and deliver seasonal and gifting packaging (Ramadan, Eid, Hajj & Umrah, National Day, year-end and international festive seasons) on a calendar that works back from in-store dates.

* Trade show checklists completed on time; leads generated and converted.

* Background in FMCG, food & beverage or consumer goods.
* Hands-on experience launching products, customers or markets (export or international expansion preferred).

* Fluent English.

**Preferred**

**Skills and Competencies**

**Required**

* Bachelor's Degree in Chemistry, Cosmetic Science, Chemical Engineering, Life Sciences or a related field.
* Proven experience in fragrance development, fragrance evaluation within the fragrance industry.
* Strong understanding of fragrance categories, consumer trends, and product development processes.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders in a fast-paced, international environment.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
* Commercially minded, customer-focused, and passionate about fragrances and innovation.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills in English.

**Preferred**

**Experience**

jobs.title: QC Manager
jobs.description:
QC Manager – Food Manufacturing

**Specialization: Sauces / Dairy Products**

**Location:** UAE  
**Industry:** Food Manufacturing  
**Experience:** 8–10 years in food manufacturing, including 3–5 years in a QC managerial role  
**Education:** Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Microbiology, or a related field.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced QC Manager to lead our Quality Control and Quality Assurance functions within our food manufacturing operations.

The ideal candidate must have strong hands-on experience in sauces or dairy product manufacturing, with a proven ability to manage quality systems, food safety compliance, laboratory operations, and production quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead and manage all QC and QA activities across production, processing, packaging, and storage.
* Ensure compliance with food safety standards, HACCP, GMP, ISO Food Cerifications, and applicable UAE food safety regulations.
* Establish, implement, and maintain quality management systems, SOPs, and food safety procedures.
* Monitor raw materials, in-process products, and finished goods to ensure compliance with approved specifications.
* Manage laboratory operations, product testing, sampling, and quality release procedures.
* Supervise quality inspections and ensure adherence to approved formulations, recipes, and manufacturing processes.
* Lead internal audits, external audits, customer inspections, and regulatory compliance activities.
* Investigate quality deviations, customer complaints, and non-conformities, and implement effective corrective and preventive actions.
* Oversee product traceability, shelf-life studies, product recalls, and food safety risk assessments.
* Lead, train, and develop the QC/QA team, including QC Inspectors and Laboratory Technicians.
* Coordinate with Production, R&D, Purchase, and Operations to ensure consistent product quality and continuous improvement.
* Prepare quality performance reports and monitor departmental KPIs.

Candidate Requirements

* Minimum 8–10 years of experience in food manufacturing, with at least 3–5 years in a QC/QA leadership position.
* Mandatory experience in sauces or dairy product manufacturing.
* Strong technical knowledge of food safety, microbiology, laboratory testing, and quality management systems.
* Experience in HACCP, GMP, ISO certifications, and relevant food safety certification requirements.
* Knowledge of UAE food safety regulations and regulatory inspection requirements.
* Proven experience in managing quality teams and handling audits, customer complaints, and product quality issues.
* Strong leadership, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience in a multi-product food manufacturing environment will be an advantage.

Product-Specific Experience

Candidates with experience in any of the following product categories are encouraged to apply:

**Sauces:** Ketchup, mayonnaise, tomato paste, chili sauce, dressings, and other condiments.

**Dairy Products:** Milk, yogurt, flavored milk, cream, cheese, and other dairy products

How to Apply:

Interested and qualified candidates are invited to submit their updated CV to hr **@royalfi.com** with the subject line:

**QC Manager – Food Manufacturing**

Please mention your current location, expected salary, and availability in your application.

Only candidates with relevant food manufacturing experience in sauces or dairy products will be considered.

Pay: AED1.00 per month

Work Location: In person

**Why Research and Development?**
---------------------------------

We are on a journey to A Better Tomorrow™ by Building a Smokeless World. A world where smokers who would otherwise continue to smoke, have migrated to smokeless alternatives. This is why we are always innovating, experimenting, and delivering new solutions. This is why our R&D and Science department is so important to the business, and we are investing and accelerating our activities to generate new science and innovation. Today, we operate in a broad spectrum of scientific fields including molecular biology, toxicology, and chemistry, and it is that breadth of expertise which fuels the relentless innovation and learning that sets us apart as an industry leader.

**Why BAT?**
------------

At BAT, we’re committed to more than just jobs, we’re dedicated to purposeful careers - It's one of the many reasons we have been named as a Global Top Employer for the eighth consecutive year.
  
  
We believe that Leadership shouldn’t be confined to titles. It’s a mindset and through our leading Learning and Development programmes, you’ll continuously develop your skills and experience. With our unwavering support, you’ll work in cross functional teams connecting with industry leaders and expanding your professional network.
  
  
Join us at BAT, where purpose meets possibility, and your career story unfolds.

**A Better Tomorrow**
---------------------

Building a Smokeless World is no small feat—it’s fueled by the collective efforts of talented individuals, each bringing their unique perspective. This is the most innovative chapter in BAT’s history, and you can help shape it.

Strategy and Purpose Brand and Innovation

**Scientific Engagement Manager**
---------------------------------

**BAT is evolving at pace into a global multi-category business. Our purpose is to create A Better Tomorrow™ by Building a Smokeless World.**  
**To achieve our ambition, we are looking for colleagues who are ready to join us on this journey! Tomorrow can’t wait, let’s shape it together!**

**ROLE SUMMARY**

**What are the key objectives and expectations from this role?**

The Scientific Engagement Manager APMEA West serves as the primary lead and coordinator for scientific engagement efforts in the Middle East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South Caucasus regions to promote uniform Tobacco Harm Reduction literacy and acceptance.

This individual will lead a proactive, regional outreach approach and engagement plan that quickly grows science-focused Key Opinion Leader (KOL) networks in the area. These include private and public research agencies, academic groups, and institutions in priority markets. They will improve connections among these groups, including managing relevant regional forums. The main purpose of this network is to support suitable engagement with regulators on THR, evidence-based public policy development, and scientific or technical regulatory issues. They will also direct scientific engagement with APMEA West South Health Care Professionals to promote Nicotine and THR education within this important partner group.

They will help develop local scientific initiatives and KOL engagement plans, including prioritizing activities for Global CORA. This role represents BAT as a scientific peer in the external scientific community and serves as the technical lead and coordinator for global scientific regulatory engagement within national and supranational regulatory processes in the APMEA West region. Responsibilities include participation in recurring global regulatory events, international treaty revisions, and ad hoc scientific consensus analyses.

**What is the direct impact of this role on the team or organisation?**

This position is vital for advancing Tobacco Harm Reduction acceptance with policy makers according to the CORA strategy and engaging the scientific community via KOLs and PHAs. It applies scientific evidence and advocacy materials to foster appropriate interaction with external scientists and regulators. The role helps develop evidence-based public policies and supports CORA on scientific and regulatory issues. It acts as BAT’s technical authority in relevant scientific regulatory activities. The role also guarantees that local APMEA West insights and evidence reach the distributed Scientific Affairs & CORA group.

**Role duties and accountabilities**
------------------------------------

* Define and deliver geographically-focused collaborator segmentation/mapping and scientific engagement strategy
* Establishing and implementing a worldwide scientific regulatory engagement strategy that actively recognizes and addresses regulatory opportunities and challenges on critical scientific topics
* Lead senior-level scientific and regulatory interactions with APMEA West authorities. Translate scientific evidence into clear positions and craft engagement strategies for tobacco harm reduction, product regulation, and relevant FMCG and pharmaceutical regulatory frameworks.
* Preparing the essential scientific materials to enable CORA to collaborate with political and regulatory organizations on BAT and third-party science to implement evidence-based regulation across the Group
* Bringing to bear the Global Scientific Evidence and Advocacy teams to develop the necessary scientific inputs. These inputs support engagement with Health Care Professionals in the area to educate them on Nicotine & THR.
* Ensuring THR adoption initiatives promote steady Tobacco Harm Reduction literacy and acceptance
* Leading and assisting APMEA West end markets in the creation of local scientific initiatives
* Improving networks of science-focused KOLs, covering private and public research agencies, academic groups, and institutions in priority markets. This involves overseeing pertinent regional forums to strengthen interactions among these groups. The network primarily supports engagement with regulators on tobacco harm reduction and the development of sound public policy based on evidence. It also deals with scientific and technical regulatory topics.
* Assisting in the localisation of scientific advocacy in layperson terms for political and third-party collaborators, taking into consideration regional sensibilities and cultural aspects
* Ensuring that adequate technical engagement assistance on product standards development to end markets and directly to national standards authorities is provided
* Working with the Scientific Evidence Team to disseminate BAT Science in the region and acting as a spokesperson, where appropriate
* Upskilling end-markets on scientific literacy and identifying scientific fora and opportunities to bring BAT Science and other research to bear within end markets. This allows it to be coordinated into their campaign and regulatory engagement plans.

The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing professional training programs, conducting on-site instrument validation, providing technical troubleshooting support, and delivering specialized training to clinical laboratories.

Working closely with Biomedical and the Commercial Team, the Clinical Specialist will translate strategic product priorities into practical clinical and technical solutions that address the evolving needs of the laboratory market.

Beyond individual instrument support, this role will champion a holistic, solution-oriented approach to laboratory diagnostics, positioning AKI-MEDLAB as a trusted technical and educational partner to clinical laboratories, healthcare professionals, and other key stakeholders.

The position will also play a key role in empowering the sales team with clinical expertise, product knowledge, and technical capabilities to strengthen customer engagement and drive sustainable business growth.

**1. Instrument Validation and Technical Support**

* Plan and implement on-site instrument validation services, including linearity, precision, accuracy, and cut-off verification, ensuring completion within agreed timelines.

* Deliver solution-oriented troubleshooting support for HPLC, ELISA, Multiplex, and other relevant laboratory methodologies.

* Support internal sales teams through product education, technical training, and clinical knowledge development.

* Assist laboratories in addressing and closing non-conformities (NCs) within agreed timelines.
* Provide technical guidance on proficiency testing, quality assurance, method verification, and validation requirements.
* Support laboratories in strengthening their quality management systems and maintaining regulatory and accreditation standards.

* Conduct regular customer visits to understand laboratory requirements, identify technical challenges, and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Identify new business opportunities through clinical engagement, technical consultations, and lead generation.

* Collaborate with Product Management and Sales to develop customer-focused solution campaigns aligned with the Integrated Marketing Plan.
* Contribute to the development of AKI-MEDLAB's clinical reputation as a trusted provider of laboratory diagnostic solutions.

* Bachelor’s degree in medical laboratory technology, Clinical Biochemistry, Medical Laboratory Science, or related discipline.
* A Master’s degree will be considered an advantage.
* 5–8 years of progressive experience in clinical laboratory operations, with demonstrated expertise in instrument validation, method verification, technical troubleshooting, and professional training.
* Proven experience in supporting laboratory accreditation, quality management systems, and proficiency testing.
* Strong knowledge of CAP, JCI, and ISO 15189 standards and their practical implementation within clinical laboratories.
* Experience working with modern laboratory diagnostic instruments and methodologies.
* Familiarity with the UAE healthcare and laboratory regulatory environment is essential; regional Middle East experience is highly desirable.
* Fluency in written and spoken English is essential.

**Technical and Professional Competencies**

* Strong understanding of laboratory quality control, method validation, verification protocols, and biostatistical principles applied in clinical laboratories.
* Demonstrated ability to lead laboratory validation and accreditation initiatives and deliver results within established timelines.
* Excellent technical training, presentation, and communication skills.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into practical solutions for laboratory professionals.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with a customer-focused and solution-oriented mindset.

**Leadership and Personal Attributes**

* Demonstrated leadership capabilities, with the ability to guide laboratory teams through validation, quality improvement, and accreditation processes.
* Strong collaboration and lateral leadership skills, with the ability to influence and align cross-functional teams and international stakeholders without direct reporting authority.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to establish trusted relationships with diverse stakeholders.
* Self-motivated, organized, adaptable, and capable of managing multiple priorities independently.
* Willingness to travel within the UAE and across regional markets as required.

At AKI-MEDLAB, you will have the opportunity to:

* Work with leading laboratory diagnostic technologies and innovative solutions.
* Make a meaningful contribution to improving laboratory quality and diagnostic excellence.
* Collaborate with experienced professionals and international stakeholders.
* Develop your technical, clinical, and leadership capabilities.
* Be part of an inclusive workplace where your expertise, individuality, and contributions are valued.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Skincare Ingredient Compatibility Specialist

**Location:**
United Arab Emirates (Remote)

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Work Arrangement:**
100% Remote — Work From Home

**Level:**
Senior

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Skincare Ingredient Compatibility Specialist to provide remote technical analysis, formulation assessment, and product stability support for skincare and personal care products. The role focuses on evaluating interactions between cosmetic ingredients, assessing formulation compatibility, reviewing stability data, and identifying potential risks affecting product performance, appearance, texture, and shelf life.

The successful candidate will collaborate remotely with cosmetic chemists, formulation scientists, research and development teams, analytical laboratories, suppliers, and quality assurance professionals. This is a fully remote position; physical formulation preparation, laboratory testing, sample handling, stability experiments, and instrument operation must be performed by qualified local personnel.

Key Responsibilities

* Review and assess ingredient compatibility across skincare formulations, including creams, lotions, serums, gels, cleansers, sunscreens, and other topical products.
* Evaluate interactions between active ingredients, emulsifiers, surfactants, preservatives, stabilizers, antioxidants, fragrances, and functional additives.
* Analyze formulation data to identify potential incompatibilities involving pH, solubility, oxidation, precipitation, discoloration, and phase separation.
* Review stability study results covering temperature exposure, light sensitivity, freeze-thaw cycles, packaging interactions, and storage conditions.
* Assess ingredient specifications, supplier technical data sheets, certificates of analysis, and supporting safety documentation.
* Evaluate the compatibility of skincare ingredients with different formulation systems, including oil-in-water, water-in-oil, anhydrous, and gel-based systems.
* Review analytical reports relating to pH, viscosity, particle size, emulsion stability, preservative performance, and other relevant product characteristics.
* Support remote investigations into formulation instability, changes in product texture, ingredient degradation, and unexpected sensory variations.
* Assess the effects of formulation concentration, processing parameters, and ingredient substitution on product stability and performance.
* Review formulation development records, laboratory protocols, compatibility studies, and product quality documentation.
* Prepare technical reports, ingredient compatibility assessments, stability summaries, and evidence-based formulation recommendations.
* Collaborate remotely with product development, procurement, regulatory, quality, and manufacturing teams.
* Monitor developments in cosmetic ingredient science, formulation technology, and applicable cosmetic product requirements.
* Maintain accurate technical records and protect confidential formulations, supplier information, and product development data.

Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Cosmetic Science, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Science, Chemical Engineering, Biochemistry, or a related discipline.
* Significant experience in skincare formulation, cosmetic ingredient compatibility, personal care product development, or formulation quality assurance.
* Strong understanding of cosmetic ingredients, their functional properties, and potential interactions within different formulation systems.
* Knowledge of emulsions, surfactants, preservatives, active ingredients, antioxidants, rheology modifiers, and formulation stabilization.
* Experience reviewing accelerated and real-time stability studies, compatibility assessments, and analytical laboratory reports.
* Familiarity with cosmetic testing methods, including pH measurement, viscosity analysis, emulsion stability assessment, and relevant chemical analysis techniques.
* Understanding of cosmetic product quality systems, ingredient specifications, and applicable regulatory frameworks.
* Ability to interpret technical data and translate findings into practical formulation improvement recommendations.
* Strong analytical, scientific writing, problem-solving, and documentation skills.
* Proficiency in spreadsheets, statistical analysis tools, digital laboratory systems, and remote collaboration platforms.
* High standards of scientific integrity, confidentiality, and evidence-based technical judgment.

What We Offer

* Fully remote, work-from-home employment arrangement.
* Full-time opportunity in a specialized skincare formulation and ingredient compatibility discipline.
* Competitive compensation based on qualifications and relevant experience.
* Opportunities to contribute to skincare innovation, formulation reliability, and product quality improvement.
* Professional collaboration with multidisciplinary cosmetic science, research, and product development teams.
* Ongoing learning and development in cosmetic chemistry, ingredient technology, and formulation science.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit an updated CV highlighting relevant experience in skincare formulation, cosmetic ingredient compatibility, stability evaluation, and technical product development.

Please include examples of formulation projects, ingredient compatibility studies, stability investigations, or product improvement initiatives where applicable.

**Application Subject:**
Application – Senior Skincare Ingredient Compatibility Specialist (UAE Remote)

Candidates should confirm applicable employment arrangements, residency requirements, and work authorization before accepting an offer.

* **Important Role Boundary:**
  This position is limited to remote technical analysis, formulation documentation review, laboratory data assessment, and virtual coordination. Physical ingredient handling, formulation preparation, laboratory experiments, chemical testing, stability trials, sample preparation, and instrument operation must be performed by qualified local laboratory personnel. Formal cosmetic safety assessments, clinical or dermatological judgments, regulated product claims, product compliance certifications, regulatory submissions, product release decisions, and statutory sign-offs must be completed by appropriately qualified and authorized professionals.

jobs.title: Technical Service and Nutrionist
jobs.description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**
At Novonesis, we believe solutions rooted in biology can help solve some of the world’s biggest challenges. In this role, you will bring deep animal nutrition expertise together with regional technical leadership to help customers across Middle East, India & Africa (MEIA) turn science and data into practical solutions.
  
  
**The role & your impact**
As Technical Service Specialist & Nutritionist, you will be the single regional owner for technical planning across MEIA, covering all three subregions.
  
  
You will translate commercial priorities and customer needs into disciplined technical plans, coordinate structured customer trials and registration support, mobilize specialist technical-service resources, and accelerate the resolution of advanced customer requirements.
  
  
You will also lead the establishment and continuous development of regional technical capabilities, including feed-analysis testing and service laboratories. Your work will help strengthen customer support, improve the quality and reuse of technical evidence, and accelerate evidence-based adoption of Animal Biosolutions across MEIA.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities In This Role**

* Own and actively manage an integrated technical-service plan across all three MEIA subregions, aligned with commercial priorities, product strategies and customer needs.
* Maintain visibility of technical projects, trials, registrations, capability-building initiatives, priorities, dependencies and resource requirements.
* Establish consistent ways of working, decision criteria, documentation standards and review routines across the subregions.
* Identify capability gaps and determine where regional expertise, external partners or global specialist support should be deployed.
* Design and coordinate customer trials with clear hypotheses, protocols, success criteria, responsibilities, timelines and data requirements.
* Ensure trial plans reflect customer production systems, feed materials, animal species, formulation practices and relevant local conditions.
* Guide data collection, analysis, interpretation and technical reporting to deliver credible, reproducible and decision-ready outcomes.
* Translate trial learning into reusable protocols, technical arguments, case studies and regional best practices.
* Coordinate technical inputs for product registrations in partnership with Regulatory Affairs and relevant internal experts.
* Connect customer and market requirements with the appropriate subject-matter experts, laboratories, application teams and global technical-service resources.
* Act as the regional focal point for complex or high-value technical customer requirements that go beyond routine local support.
* Triage technical escalations and lead root-cause assessment and resolution planning for advanced nutrition, feed-performance and application issues.
* Define the roadmap for regional technical capabilities, including feed-analysis testing, service laboratories, methods, equipment, partners and competencies.
* Lead the setup, qualification and continuous improvement of regional testing and service-laboratory capabilities in line with applicable quality, safety and compliance requirements.
* Establish appropriate test methods, sample-handling practices, data-integrity expectations, reporting standards and service levels.
* Build a practical network of internal and external laboratories to provide timely and reliable analytical support across MEIA.
* Provide expert guidance on animal nutrition, feed matrices, formulation principles, ingredient variability and the use of feed-formulation software.
* Build technical capability within sales and technical teams through coaching, training, field support and reusable technical tools.
* Monitor relevant technical, scientific, competitive and market developments and translate them into implications for the regional business.

**What You'll Need To Be Successful In This Role**

* A degree in Animal Nutrition, Animal Science, Veterinary Science, Feed Science or a related discipline.
* Typically 10–15 years of relevant experience in the Animal Health and Nutrition industry, with substantial exposure to technical service, animal nutrition, feed applications or related work.
* Strong knowledge of animal nutrition, feed ingredients, nutrient specifications, feed matrices and formulation principles.
* Demonstrated experience designing and executing structured commercial or research trials and translating results into customer recommendations.
* Practical experience with feed analysis, laboratory services, analytical methods and interpretation of nutritional data.
* Proficiency with feed-formulation software, including the ability to interpret formulation outputs, constraints and economic trade-offs.
* Ability to develop trial protocols, evaluate data quality, interpret results and prepare clear technical reports.
* Understanding of feed-analysis testing, sample management, laboratory methods and quality expectations.
* Ability to diagnose complex customer requirements and coordinate specialist support across organizational boundaries.
* Strong planning, prioritization and project-management skills, combined with disciplined follow-through.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem solving and sound judgment, including when working under time pressure.
* Clear and credible communication with technical experts, commercial teams, senior stakeholders and customers.
* Ability to work collaboratively and build trust across functions, cultures and geographies in a matrix organization.
* Fluency in English.
* Willingness and ability to travel across MEIA in line with business needs.

**Additional Skills & Interests We Value**

* An advanced degree in Animal Nutrition, Animal Science, Veterinary Science, Feed Science or a related discipline.
* Experience supporting product registrations, regulatory technical documentation or cross-functional registration projects.
* Experience working across culturally and commercially diverse markets within MEIA.
* Additional languages relevant to the MEIA region.

**What We Offer You**
You will have the opportunity to work at the intersection of science, customer needs and commercial priorities across a diverse international region.
  
  
The role offers extensive collaboration with regional and subregional Sales, Marketing and Business Development teams as well as Technical Service, R&D, Application, Laboratory, Product Management, Regulatory Affairs and Quality colleagues.
  
  
As a regional individual contributor, you will have significant ownership of how technical expertise, evidence and capabilities are coordinated and shared across MEIA, with opportunities to build knowledge, strengthen ways of working and contribute directly to customer outcomes.
  
  
**Working conditions**

* Primary location: Türkiye.
* Secondary location: Dubai.
* Hybrid work mode.
* Regional scope covering all three MEIA subregions.
* Travel requirement: approximately 40–50% across MEIA, in line with business needs.

**Relevant information**
This is an individual contributor position within Technical Service / Animal Nutrition, with responsibility across Middle East, India & Africa (MEIA).
  
  
**Our purpose guides the way**
In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**Opportunities for everyone**
We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**About Analog Sports**
Analog Sports is a training app built around Ana, an AI coach you can just talk to. She builds your training plan, reads the data from everything you train with, and explains what it means for your next session. Analog sponsors professional cycling teams, and they train on the same platform.
  
  
**The role**
You make Ana a great coach. Ana’s coaching is built on your judgement: you turn how an expert coach decides into rules, numbers and tests that Ana follows, and you check that she gets it right. You won’t coach athletes one to one. Your athletes are everyone who trains with Ana.
  
  
We’re a flat organisation, and you report directly to the CEO.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Define how Ana coaches: training load, form and fatigue, building toward an event, testing and recovery. You write each one as clear rules with thresholds and worked examples.
* Write up the coaching logic for the features you own: the problem, the rules, what good looks like, and how we’ll test it. Then work with design and engineering until it ships.
* Own the maths: every metric and calculation in the app is correct, explained in plain words, and reviewed regularly.
* Build the tests that tell us whether Ana coaches well: real athlete cases, the answers a good coach would give, and a score on every release.
* Review Ana’s work: plans, workout feedback and daily guidance. You find where she’s wrong and fix it with our product and AI engineers.
* Sign off the coaching side of every new feature, alongside product.
* Be the coaches’ voice in the product: how coaches work with their athletes in the app, from one athlete to a squad of 200.
* Work with the coaching staff of the professional teams we sponsor.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 10+ years as an expert coach in cycling, running or triathlon, with amateurs as well as elite athletes.
* Deep knowledge of training load and performance modelling: CTL, ATL and TSB, ramp rate, critical power and critical speed, power and pace zones, testing protocols, periodisation.
* Real experience working with AI. You’ve used AI assistants and models seriously in your work, not just tried them. You know what they do well, where they go wrong (confident answers that are wrong, following what’s written rather than what’s meant), and how to steer them. No coding needed.
* Clear writing. You can turn a judgement call into a rule someone else, or an AI, can follow, edge cases included.
* Comfort with data. You’d rather check a calculation against the raw file than trust the chart.

**Nice to have**

* Coaching swimming.
* Coaching strength and weightlifting for endurance athletes.
* An MSc or PhD in exercise physiology or sports science.
* Experience with a professional, continental or national team.
* Experience working on a training app or platform.

**By the end of your first three months**

* Ana’s coaching rules for load, form and testing are written down and in her hands.
* A coaching test set runs on every release.
* Dynamic training plans are working for running, swimming and weight training, alongside cycling.
* Every metric in the app has been checked and explained.
* You’ve written up the coaching logic for at least one new feature and seen it into the build.

jobs.title: Quality & Hygiene Coordinator

Purpose of the Position

The Quality & Hygiene Coordinator is responsible for supporting the implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of quality assurance, food safety, hygiene, and compliance standards across all Food & Beverage operations in Dubai. The role ensures adherence to HACCP requirements, Dubai Municipality regulations, company policies, and operational standards through regular inspections, audits, training, and compliance monitoring.

The position plays a key role in promoting a culture of food safety excellence, operational consistency, and continuous improvement while ensuring the highest standards of hygiene and customer satisfaction are maintained.

Key Responsibilities

Quality Assurance & Compliance

* Conduct routine quality and hygiene inspections across all operational areas.
* Monitor compliance with company SOPs, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Identify non-conformities and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
* Assist in reviewing, updating, and implementing quality management procedures.
* Support quality improvement initiatives and operational excellence programs.

Food Safety & Hygiene

* Monitor food handling, preparation, storage, transportation, and service practices.
* Ensure compliance with HACCP standards, food safety regulations, and hygiene requirements.
* Conduct regular inspections of kitchens, storage facilities, service areas, and food outlets.

Documentation & Reporting

Competencies & Skills

jobs.title: Scientific Engagement Manager
jobs.description:
**BAT is evolving at pace into a global multi-category business. Our purpose is to create A Better Tomorrow™ by Building a Smokeless World.
  
  
To achieve our ambition, we are looking for colleagues who are ready to join us on this journey! Tomorrow can’t wait, let’s shape it together!**
**Role Summary**
**What are the key objectives and expectations from this role?**
The Scientific Engagement Manager APMEA West serves as the primary lead and coordinator for scientific engagement efforts in the Middle East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South Caucasus regions to promote uniform Tobacco Harm Reduction literacy and acceptance.
  
  
This individual will lead a proactive, regional outreach approach and engagement plan that quickly grows science-focused Key Opinion Leader (KOL) networks in the area. These include private and public research agencies, academic groups, and institutions in priority markets. They will improve connections among these groups, including managing relevant regional forums. The main purpose of this network is to support suitable engagement with regulators on THR, evidence-based public policy development, and scientific or technical regulatory issues. They will also direct scientific engagement with APMEA West South Health Care Professionals to promote Nicotine and THR education within this important partner group.
  
  
The Scientific Engagement Manager (APMEA West) will offer mentorship and assistance to the East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South end markets. They will help develop local scientific initiatives and KOL engagement plans, including prioritizing activities for Global CORA. This role represents BAT as a scientific peer in the external scientific community and serves as the technical lead and coordinator for global scientific regulatory engagement within national and supranational regulatory processes in the APMEA West region. Responsibilities include participation in recurring global regulatory events, international treaty revisions, and ad hoc scientific consensus analyses.
  
  
**What is the direct impact of this role on the team or organisation?**
This position is vital for advancing Tobacco Harm Reduction acceptance with policy makers according to the CORA strategy and engaging the scientific community via KOLs and PHAs. It applies scientific evidence and advocacy materials to foster appropriate interaction with external scientists and regulators. The role helps develop evidence-based public policies and supports CORA on scientific and regulatory issues. It acts as BAT’s technical authority in relevant scientific regulatory activities. The role also guarantees that local APMEA West insights and evidence reach the distributed Scientific Affairs & CORA group.
  
  
Role duties and accountabilities
  
  

* Define and deliver geographically-focused collaborator segmentation/mapping and scientific engagement strategy
* Establishing and implementing a worldwide scientific regulatory engagement strategy that actively recognizes and addresses regulatory opportunities and challenges on critical scientific topics
* Lead senior-level scientific and regulatory interactions with APMEA West authorities. Translate scientific evidence into clear positions and craft engagement strategies for tobacco harm reduction, product regulation, and relevant FMCG and pharmaceutical regulatory frameworks.
* Preparing the essential scientific materials to enable CORA to collaborate with political and regulatory organizations on BAT and third-party science to implement evidence-based regulation across the Group
* Bringing to bear the Global Scientific Evidence and Advocacy teams to develop the necessary scientific inputs. These inputs support engagement with Health Care Professionals in the area to educate them on Nicotine & THR.
* Ensuring THR adoption initiatives promote steady Tobacco Harm Reduction literacy and acceptance
* Leading and assisting APMEA West end markets in the creation of local scientific initiatives
* Improving networks of science-focused KOLs, covering private and public research agencies, academic groups, and institutions in priority markets. This involves overseeing pertinent regional forums to strengthen interactions among these groups. The network primarily supports engagement with regulators on tobacco harm reduction and the development of sound public policy based on evidence. It also deals with scientific and technical regulatory topics.
* Assisting in the localisation of scientific advocacy in layperson terms for political and third-party collaborators, taking into consideration regional sensibilities and cultural aspects
* Ensuring that adequate technical engagement assistance on product standards development to end markets and directly to national standards authorities is provided
* Working with the Scientific Evidence Team to disseminate BAT Science in the region and acting as a spokesperson, where appropriate
* Upskilling end-markets on scientific literacy and identifying scientific fora and opportunities to bring BAT Science and other research to bear within end markets. This allows it to be coordinated into their campaign and regulatory engagement plans.

**Experience, Skills, Knowledge**
Experience Required
  
  

* 5-10 years of experience in relevant scientific field
* Proven expertise engaging with and mobilising scientific KOLs / PHAs and interest groups
* Knowledge and experience of BAT's New Category products, ingredients, and technologies
* Familiarity with BAT’s 9-step scientific risk assessment framework and Tobacco Harm Reduction principles
* Sound knowledge of tobacco, food, or pharmaceutical science complexities including chemistry, toxicology, pre-clinical, clinical, and behavioural science
* Understanding of the regulatory environment in the Middle East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South Caucasus, especially concerning tobacco, food, medicinal, and pharmaceutical sectors
* Proven experience interacting with regulatory authorities in the Middle East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South Caucasus, managing pharmaceutical regulations, regulatory pathways, and scientific requirements, with the capacity to apply this knowledge to complex scientific and policy discussions
* Experience in managing complex market-facing and regulatory dependent projects
* Understands World Health Organization’s political environment and public policy-making processes
* Experience of crafting and managing 3rd party networks
* Experience in regulatory rulemaking processes
* Proven ability to engage external and internal collaborators in an empathetic manner
* Skills in managing projects
* Outstanding communication abilities

**Technical / Functional / Leadership Skills Required**

* Proven ability to engage external and internal collaborators in an empathetic manner
* Skills in managing projects
* Strong communication capabilities

**Education / Professional Qualifications / Certifications Required**

* Educated to a post-graduate degree (PhD or equivalent experience, MD, or Pharmacist)
* Excellent written and spoken English

Beneficial
  
  

* Appreciation of challenges of working in a complex matrix environment and proven experience of delivering results
* Active interest in controversial regulatory control issues and skills for absorbing and applying knowledge to the debate

**What we offer you?**

* We offer a market leading annual performance bonus (subject to eligibility)
* Our range of benefits varies by country and includes diverse health plans, initiatives for work-life balance, transportation support, and a flexible holiday plan with additional incentives
* Your journey with us isn't limited by boundaries; it's propelled by your aspirations. Join us at BAT and become a part of an environment that thrives on internal advancement, where your career progression isn't just a statement – it's a reality we're eager to build together. Seize the opportunity and own your development; your next chapter
